BDTX.datum: All 43 patients started at 200 mg; the 150 mg pivotal dose derives from post-dose-reduction experience (grade 3+ TRAEs 28% after reduction). 23 of 43 remain on therapy; FDA meeting pending (May 21, 2026).
BDTX.why_underappreciated: Headline ORR 60% was at 200 mg start; tolerability at 150 mg start is untested.
BDTX.suggestion: Run a prospective 150 mg starting-dose cohort and report grade 3+ TRAEs, discontinuations and dose reductions before the FDA pivotal-plan meeting; tolerability, not funding, gates Phase 3 design.
BDTX.why: Pivotal dose was never a starting dose.

BLSM.datum: In 174 patients at expansion doses, TRAE discontinuation was 3% and dose reduction 9%, grade 3-4 TRAEs 22%, no grade 5; bilirubin elevation 45%, rash 43%. Median DOR and PFS not reported (WCLC, Sep 2026).
BLSM.why_underappreciated: Coverage focuses on 45% ORR; low discontinuation is secondary and durability remains unreported.
BLSM.suggestion: Release median duration of response and PFS for the 40 C797S patients, with bilirubin grades, at the Q4 end-of-Phase 1 FDA meeting; tolerability looks acceptable, durability is blank.
BLSM.why: Durability is the missing endpoint; tolerability looks acceptable.

BNTX.datum: Gotistobart (BNT316) PRESERVE-003 stage 1 in 2L squamous NSCLC: OS HR 0.46 vs docetaxel-class chemotherapy (ELCC, Mar 2026); first stage 2 interim expected in 2026. FY26 revenue guidance cut to EUR 1.6-1.9B.
BNTX.why_underappreciated: Pumitamig dominates the story; this secondary lung asset has a 2026 randomized interim.
BNTX.suggestion: Disclose PRESERVE-003 stage 2 event count and interim timing, and the dose used, so investors can value a second late-stage lung asset beside pumitamig.
BNTX.why: A 2026 randomized lung interim is unpriced.

BYSI.datum: Sep 29, 2026: FDA Fast Track for plinabulin plus docetaxel in post-PD-(L)1 non-squamous NSCLC; BeyondSpring sells its Chinese holding to Biolin, which funds China sites (~221 of 442 DUBLIN-4 patients); interim at 221 PFS events.
BYSI.why_underappreciated: Newer than analyst models; deal price undisclosed and cash gap for ex-China enrollment remains.
BYSI.suggestion: Quantify cash needed to reach the 221-PFS-event interim for the ex-China half, and use Fast Track rolling review to seek a US or EU funding partner.
BYSI.why: China half is funded; the ex-China half is not.

CBIO.datum: Kelun got China NMPA IND (May 2026) and started a ~206-patient China Phase 2 of CR-001 plus sac-TMT in NSCLC (ORR and safety primary), data mid-2027; pro forma cash $305.1M funds into 2H 2028.
CBIO.why_underappreciated: Dashboard centers on US ASCEND Q1 2027; partner-run China trials add earlier, larger human data.
CBIO.suggestion: Ask Kelun to share China monotherapy safety and response data alongside Q1 2027 ASCEND proof of concept, and state ORR bars versus ivonescimab for the 206-patient combination trial.
CBIO.why: Partner China data may arrive before US proof of concept.

CGEM.datum: REZILIENT3 (n=285, 1L EGFR ex20ins) met PFS at interim (Taiho, Aug 12, 2026) but control was platinum chemotherapy alone, not amivantamab plus chemotherapy; hazard ratio and median PFS undisclosed.
CGEM.why_underappreciated: Positive headline hides that approved 1L standard amivantamab plus chemotherapy was not the comparator.
CGEM.suggestion: Publish REZILIENT3 hazard ratio, median PFS and intracranial results, plus an indirect comparison with PAPILLON, before the 1L NDA completes at year-end; label breadth depends on it.

CHRS.datum: Randomized Phase 2 of casdozokitug plus toripalimab and bevacizumab in 1L HCC has completed enrollment; Coherus projected data disclosure in October 2026. Loqtorzi Q2 revenue $13.6M (+15% QoQ).
CHRS.why_underappreciated: Dashboard treats casdozokitug as unfunded idea; readout is weeks away and unmodeled.
CHRS.suggestion: With the HCC readout due, pre-specify the IL-27 biomarker subgroup and show cash net of $22.7M earmarked for transition-services payables, since runway is 3.5 quarters.
CHRS.why: Enrolled randomized readout is imminent; cash is partly earmarked.

CRBP.datum: CRB-913 oral CB1 inverse agonist, CANYON-1 (n=254, 12 weeks): mean weight loss 5.0% at 60 mg vs 0.0% placebo, no plateau; AE discontinuation 3.1-13.1% (Sep 14, 2026). ObesityWeek Nov 14-17.
CRBP.why_underappreciated: Tracked as a lung/HNSCC oncology name; obesity asset sits with EV below cash.
CRBP.suggestion: Seek an obesity partner for CRB-913 after the ObesityWeek presentation, with a Phase 2 start in H1 2027, to fund CRB-701 without relying on the $127.5M ATM.
CRBP.why: Obesity data are out; funding avoids ATM dilution.

CVM.datum: Saudi Amarox deal has no stated upfront payment; net revenue split 50/50 and Amarox's obligations are generally limited to 50% of SFDA registration fees. Cash was $6.5M at Jun 30, 2026 with going-concern doubt.
CVM.why_underappreciated: Partnership headline implies funding; the 10-Q shows no upfront and tiny partner obligations.
CVM.suggestion: Seek a funded partner with upfront payment for the 212-patient Phase 3; the Amarox deal does not fund it, and recent funding was $1.00-1.20 direct share sales.
CVM.why: Saudi deal has no upfront; going-concern doubt remains.

EIKN.datum: ESMO Oct 26, 2026: non-squamous (n=36) median DOR 11.2 mo equals KEYNOTE-189 pembro-chemo 11.2 mo (ORR 55.6% vs 48%); grade 3+ TRAEs 48.6% (n=72).
EIKN.why_underappreciated: Headline is 72% squamous ORR (n=29); the larger non-squamous cohort shows no duration edge.
EIKN.suggestion: Disclose TeLuRide-008 stratification and powering by histology and the non-squamous durability plan, since the largest cohort shows no duration advantage over KEYNOTE-189; report PFS at the next update.
EIKN.why: Squamous-only framing hides flat non-squamous durability

FHTX.datum: FHD-909 (SMARCA2) was ended with Lilly on 1 Oct 2026 after Phase 1 data: SMARCA2/4 synthetic lethality did not translate into sufficient efficacy; about 40% staff cut, runway into 2H 2029.
FHTX.why_underappreciated: Dashboard catalyst still lists FHD-909 first data; the termination is newer than models.
FHTX.suggestion: Pick one lead from the EP300/CBP degraders and I&I program, state its first-in-human timing, and confirm cash into 2H 2029 after the 40% cut.
FHTX.why: Lead program lost; investors need one funded priority.

INO.datum: FDA gave a preliminary comment on accelerated-approval eligibility in the file acceptance letter and has not yet given feedback on confirmatory trial design; PDUFA 30 Oct 2026, cash $36.7M plus $18.3M raised July.
INO.why_underappreciated: Market treats it as simple approve/reject; pathway and confirmatory-trial terms are unresolved.
INO.suggestion: Disclose FDA confirmatory-trial feedback and 52-week surgery-free data around the 30 Oct decision; runway into late Q1 2027 means label and trial terms drive financing.
INO.why: Pathway terms, not approval alone, set financing needs.

LTRN.datum: HARMONIC L858R mPFS 8.4 mo (CI 6.2-NE), below the 9.7 mo (5.9-11.3) amivantamab+chemo MARIPOSA-2 benchmark the company itself cites; HR 0.37 exploratory; n reported as 15 and 31 (Jun 2, 2026).
LTRN.why_underappreciated: Headline stresses HR 0.37 and tolerability; the company's own benchmark shows no PFS edge.
LTRN.suggestion: Reconcile the L858R n (15 vs 31) with PFS curves, then lead partnering with the amivantamab safety gap (SAE 3% vs 23%, cross-trial).
LTRN.why: Cleaner data and tolerability are what a partner will pay for

MAIA.datum: THIO-104 Phase 3: 29 patients dosed as of Jun 4, 2026 versus up to 300 planned; company targets 100 by year-end, so the 2027 OS interim rests on few events.
MAIA.why_underappreciated: Headline is Fast Track and Phase 3 start; enrollment pace versus the 300-patient design is rarely modeled.
MAIA.suggestion: Disclose THIO-104 event-count assumptions for the 2027 interim and current enrollment, and extend runway by regional license, since $34M cash must cover enrolling toward 300 patients.
MAIA.why: Interim credibility depends on enrollment pace and event timing

MGNX.datum: ESMO Oct 23, 2026 (cutoff Sep 1): SCCHN ORR 27% (6/22, only 4 confirmed, 18%), median 3 prior lines; grade 3+ TRAEs 48% (anemia 30%, neutropenia 26%); no ILD reported.
MGNX.why_underappreciated: Stage 1 passage was read as validation; confirmed responses are four patients, with high-grade cytopenias.
MGNX.suggestion: Present confirmed ORR with duration and ILD-free exposure in the Stage 2 update, then pursue a partner, as only 4 of 22 patients have confirmed responses.
MGNX.why: Confirmed responses, not Stage 1 passage, drive partner valuation

MOLN.datum: Cohort 1 dosed 75 MBq and cohort 2 105 MBq of 212Pb-MP0712 (up to four dose levels, per Aug 25, 2026 report); 2026 data will be early-dose, comprehensive efficacy in 2027.
MOLN.metric: MP0712 dose level at first data
MOLN.why_underappreciated: Investors may expect efficacy from 2026 data; only dose levels 1-2 of four will be reported.
MOLN.suggestion: Frame the 2026 MP0712 update as dose-level 1-2 safety and Pb-203 dosimetry, and state the planned efficacy dose level and 2027 timing.
MOLN.why: Sets expectations before low-dose data disappoint

NBTX.datum: Mar 17, 2025 J&J amendment: J&J funds nearly all remaining NANORAY-312 cost; $1.77B milestones for HNSCC and NSCLC, low-10s to low-20s% royalties; May 2026 amendment drops interim, readout timing set by J&J.
NBTX.why_underappreciated: Debate centers on Phase 3 odds; J&J carrying trial cost and royalty tiers are older, buried terms.
NBTX.suggestion: Disclose milestone split between HNSCC approval and first sales and the event-count trigger for NANORAY-312 final analysis, since $1.77B milestones and J&J-controlled timing set realized value.
NBTX.why: Milestone timing, not Phase 3 odds alone, sets realized value

NUVB.datum: GSK's Jideytro (zidesamtinib) was FDA-approved for TKI-pretreated ROS1+ NSCLC by Jul 22, 2026, before its Sep 18 goal: ORR 44% (n=117), 69% DOR at 12 months.
NUVB.why_underappreciated: Field still treats zidesamtinib as a pending Sep 2026 PDUFA; approval is already in market.
NUVB.suggestion: Show IBTROZI ORR and duration in TKI-pretreated patients against zidesamtinib's 44% ORR and 69% 12-month DOR, with new-start share, before the Jan 4, 2027 sNDA decision.
NUVB.why: Pretreated-setting share is now contested by an approved rival

PYXS.datum: Sep 9, 2026 (cutoff Aug 18): at capped 5.4 mg/kg, grade 3+ TRAEs 54.3% and TRAE discontinuation 14.3% (n=35); dose to be agreed at Q1 2027 FDA end-of-phase 2.
PYXS.why_underappreciated: Headline is 36% cORR; tolerability and the unresolved pivotal dose sit in secondary tables.
PYXS.suggestion: Present weight-band exposure-response and safety data to support dose selection at the Q1 2027 end-of-phase 2 meeting, ahead of a mid-2027 Phase 3 start.
PYXS.why: Dose choice now gates the pivotal design

SMMT.datum: FDA told Summit a statistically significant OS benefit is needed; HARMONi primary OS HR 0.79 (0.62-1.01, p=0.057) missed; later cuts nominal only; Western HR 0.76 (0.52-1.10, Jun 2026) crosses 1.
SMMT.why_underappreciated: Improving Western HR trend gets headlines; its interval still includes no benefit and the primary missed.
SMMT.suggestion: Lay out the benefit-risk case without significant OS: PFS gain, safety and a confirmatory-trial commitment, ahead of the Nov 14 PDUFA.
SMMT.why: Approval hinges on FDA flexibility, not trend direction

STRO.datum: STRIVE-01 (cutoff Jul 24, 2026, n=49, TF-unselected, 8 tumor types): partial responses in pancreatic, head and neck and NSCLC at 3-4 mg/kg; DLTs only at 5 mg/kg; grade 3+ anemia 14%.
STRO.why_underappreciated: Unselected responses across three tumor types sit behind headline revenue drop ($9.8M versus $63.7M).
STRO.suggestion: Report responder counts by tumor type and TF expression, choose 4 or 5 mg/kg, and pick expansion tumors from responder data before the 1H 2027 update.
STRO.why: Expansion choice should follow responders, not platform breadth

WHWK.datum: Cash and short-term investments $190.0M at Jun 30, 2026 (after $87.5M May placement) against about $190M market cap; runway into 2H 2028, past the 1H 2027 HWK-007 readout.
WHWK.why_underappreciated: Fields show older $123M cash; the May placement lifted cash to market-cap level, EV near zero.
WHWK.suggestion: Prespecify the PTK7 IHC cutoff and response criteria for HWK-007 before the 1H 2027 readout, so data are judged against a stated bar.
WHWK.why: Funded runway lets the biomarker bar be set before data

XLO.datum: Up to $31.0M AbbVie milestones/option fees possible through 1H 2027; Gilead efarindodekin option data package due 1H 2027; Q2 2026 collaboration revenue $18.7M vs $8.1M.
XLO.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on unproven XTX501; partnered masked programs already fund operations and have dated decisions.
XLO.suggestion: Disclose efarindodekin option terms (exercise fee, milestones) before the 1H 2027 data package, since partner decisions outweigh XTX501's unproven status at a $53M market cap.
XLO.why: Dated partner decisions are the near-term value drivers

ZLAB.datum: Zoci DLLEVATE Ph3 (2L+ SCLC) enrollment completes 1H 2027; a planned interim analysis could support a US accelerated approval filing in 2027 (Q2 2026 results, Aug 2026).
ZLAB.why_underappreciated: Stock trades on China portfolio sales (Q2 revenue $106.3M vs $110.0M); the early filing route is overlooked.
ZLAB.suggestion: Disclose the DLLEVATE interim analysis timing, endpoint and response-rate bar for a 2027 US accelerated approval filing, alongside the Amgen and Boehringer combination plans.
ZLAB.why: Filing route and bar decide when zoci can reach US patients.

LYEL.datum: PiNACLE-H2H is a randomized Ph3 versus axi-cel or liso-cel in 2L LBCL with EFS primary; 43 2L and 65 3L+ patients treated by May 5 2026 cutoff, yet Q2 release gave no ORR or CR.
LYEL.metric: H2H Ph3 EFS vs approved CAR-T
LYEL.why_underappreciated: Safety headlines dominate; efficacy is undisclosed and a head-to-head EFS test is pending.
LYEL.suggestion: Disclose ORR, CR and early durability for the 43 second-line patients with the 2H 2026 PiNACLE-H2H update, alongside the safety data.
LYEL.why: Efficacy parity with liso-cel, not safety alone, decides the H2H.

NRIX.datum: Roche deal (Jun 8 2026): $700M upfront, but Nurix funds 40% of development costs, shares US P&L 50/50, and earns only low- to high-teens ex-US royalties on bexobrutideg.
NRIX.why_underappreciated: Headline is $2.3B total; Nurix's ongoing cost burden and capped ex-US economics are less visible.
NRIX.suggestion: Guide Nurix's expected annual 40% share of CLL-306 and the planned CSU and MS Phase 2 spend, and the resulting runway.
NRIX.why: Shows how much of $1.1B cash is committed to Roche-shared trials.

AAPG.datum: H1 2026 release shows cash and bank balances of $279.4M (Jun 30 2026), down $73.8M since Dec; borrowings about RMB 2.09B; H1 net loss $120.4M. Our ~$2.5B cash is not in the release.
AAPG.why_underappreciated: Negative-EV view rests on cash that the filing does not show; fields likely overstated.
AAPG.suggestion: Reconcile cash against the filing, and fund or partner lisaftoclax and the POLARIS trials; $279M cash covers roughly a year at the H1 loss rate.
AAPG.why: Real cash is one-tenth of assumed; runway is about a year.

ADPT.datum: Q2 2026 clonoSEQ volume +43% but MRD revenue only +33% ($66.2M), implying revenue per test fell about 7%; FY MRD guide $268-278M implies H2 about $67-72M per quarter.
ADPT.why_underappreciated: Volume growth headlines hide falling revenue per test and flat sequential revenue.
ADPT.suggestion: Disclose clonoSEQ revenue per test and payer mix (Medicare, commercial, pharma) by indication, to show whether the per-test decline is mix or price.
ADPT.why: Per-test trend determines margin and valuation of separated MRD business.

ANTX.datum: Aug 11 2026 release: PV IND filing expected Q3 2026, enrollment Q4 2026, Part 1 is a single-arm 28-week hematocrit study, data periodic through 2027; no patient dosed yet.
ANTX.why_underappreciated: Fields assume first patient Aug 2026 and Q4 2026 data; both look stale.
ANTX.suggestion: File the PV IND and publish a data calendar with the sentinel-cohort timing; stop expecting human hematocrit data before mid-2027.
ANTX.why: Human PV evidence slips to 2027; timing sets expectations.

CCCC.datum: EHA 2026 cemsidomide ORR 40% (75ug) and 53% (100ug); across both doses only 1 stringent CR, 2 CRs and 2 MRD-negative patients, no drug-related discontinuations; patient numbers not disclosed.
CCCC.why_underappreciated: Headline ORR drives the thesis; shallow depth versus BMS CELMoDs is overlooked.
CCCC.suggestion: Disclose patient counts, VGPR-or-better rate and duration of response at 100ug, since the CR and MRD figures are so few.
CCCC.why: Depth and durability, not ORR, separate it from mezigdomide.

COGT.datum: PEAK (May 30 2026): bezuclastinib+sunitinib mPFS 16.5 vs 9.2 mo, HR 0.50; but grade 3+ ALT/AST 10.8% vs 1.4%, treatment-related discontinuation 7.4% vs 3.8%.
COGT.why_underappreciated: Narrative stresses a cleaner profile; hepatic signal in the combo is secondary to HR 0.50.
COGT.suggestion: Present PEAK liver-enzyme time-to-resolution and the proposed monitoring and dose-modification plan ahead of the Nov 30 GIST PDUFA.
COGT.why: Label hepatic language could blunt the combination's commercial edge.

CRBU.datum: Oct 6 2026: board to discontinue vispa-cel and CB-011 and explore sale or merger (Wedbush); cash $113.8M at 6/30/26 vs ~$49M market cap; no runway or wind-down cost disclosed.
CRBU.metric: Cash vs market cap; wind-down unsized
CRBU.why_underappreciated: Cash exceeds market cap, but wind-down costs and runway are undisclosed.
CRBU.suggestion: Disclose wind-down and severance costs and expected net cash at closing, and set a review timeline, favoring cash return unless a buyer values CB-011.
CRBU.why: Sizes true net cash and sets deadline for the review.

DMRA.datum: DMR-002 (Fc-enhanced anti-mutCALR) first regulatory filing 2H 2026 and DMR-003 CD3 engager 2027; DMR-001 showed 26-fold proliferation inhibition and 5-fold NHP half-life vs reference antibody (Q2 PR, Aug 10 2026).
DMRA.why_underappreciated: Valued as one Phase 1 antibody; second antibody and T-cell engager are newer than models.
DMRA.suggestion: Disclose what DMR-002 adds over DMR-001 (Fc effector function), whether it enters CLARITY-101, and pre-specify CALR allele burden and platelet endpoints.
DMRA.why: Shows whether pipeline depth justifies the valuation.

ELVN.datum: ENABLE-2 (FDA-aligned Oct 6 2026): ~450 pts, relcobatinib 80mg QD vs investigator-choice dasatinib/nilotinib/bosutinib; MMR at wk24 primary, sized for 10-point superiority; asciminib not a comparator; start before YE2026.
ELVN.why_underappreciated: FDA alignment is the headline; control arm omits asciminib, easing approval but not proving differentiation.
ELVN.suggestion: Report MMR in ENABLE-2 by prior-TKI line, including asciminib-pretreated and T315I patients, to show differentiation beyond the second-generation TKI control.
ELVN.why: Control arm leaves asciminib comparison unanswered.

GERN.datum: RYTELO Q2 2026 revenue $57.5M (+11% QoQ) but demand grew only ~5% and ordering accounts +8% to ~1,575; FY26 guide $220-240M reiterated (Aug 5 2026 release).
GERN.why_underappreciated: Headline is record revenue; underlying demand growth is under half of revenue growth.
GERN.suggestion: Report RYTELO vial demand, duration of therapy and ordering-account depth quarterly, so investors separate true demand from inventory timing before the IMpactMF interim.
GERN.why: Tests whether revenue growth reflects durable demand.

IMMX.datum: BLA timing slipped: Mar 30 2026 PR planned BLA after Q3 2026 NEXICART-2 topline; Sep 29 2026 PR gives final readout and BLA mid-2027, with no median follow-up or CRS grades for 40/45 CRs.
IMMX.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on 89% CR; BLA delay and missing follow-up and safety detail get less attention.
IMMX.suggestion: Publish median follow-up, CRS and cytopenia grades, and treatment-related deaths for all 45 NEXICART-2 patients, and commit to a dated BLA submission.
IMMX.why: Fills safety and durability gaps behind the BLA timeline.

KPTI.datum: SENTRY OS hazard ratio 0.43 has a 95% CI of 0.19-1.00 (deaths 4.7% vs 10.2%); the symptom co-primary missed and Grade 3+ AEs were 70.1% vs 50.0%.
KPTI.why_underappreciated: OS HR 0.43 is the headline; the interval reaching 1.00 and immature events get less weight.
KPTI.suggestion: Agree with FDA what OS maturity and symptom data support accelerated approval, and raise financing or a partner before review; cash $91M covers about 4 quarters.
KPTI.why: Runway is shorter than the review.

KURA.datum: Kyowa Kirin collaboration: $195M milestones paid Q4 2025, with ~$894M further potential milestones remaining per a secondary Q2 2026 summary, against EV of ~$372M.
KURA.why_underappreciated: Remaining partner milestones far exceed EV; attention is on Revuforj's revenue lead.
KURA.suggestion: Disclose which remaining Kyowa Kirin milestones depend on KOMET-017 or approvals, with expected timing, to show non-dilutive cash against the Q4 2027 runway.
KURA.why: Clarifies size and timing of non-dilutive cash.

LEGN.datum: LB2501 in vivo CD19/CD20 CAR-T at dose level 2: ORR 6/6 (100%), CR 5/6 (83%), responses ongoing, no DLT, ICANS or deaths (Q2 2026 6-K, n=6).
LEGN.metric: LB2501 in vivo CAR-T early data
LEGN.why_underappreciated: Market prices Carvykti; in vivo CAR-T data are six patients and newer than models.
LEGN.suggestion: Report LB2501 follow-up duration, patients per dose level and dosing logistics, plus the US IND date, to show in vivo CAR-T can extend beyond Carvykti.
LEGN.why: Small n; durability decides if it matters.

RIGL.datum: Cash fell $59.7M in H1 2026 to $95.3M after a $70M VEPPANU upfront (license effective Jun 11 2026), while FY26 revenue guidance rose to $285-295M excluding VEPPANU.
RIGL.why_underappreciated: Cash fell sharply on in-licensing; launch spend and milestone obligations are not yet sized.
RIGL.suggestion: Quantify VEPPANU launch spend and Arvinas/Pfizer milestone obligations against $95M cash, and state whether R289 Phase 2 will be self-funded or partnered.
RIGL.why: Launch costs and milestones unsized against thin cash.

SLS.datum: REGAL pooled deaths: 72 at Dec 26 2025 (company PR) but only 78 of 80 by early July 2026, about 6 deaths in 6.5 months, so unblinding date is open-ended.
SLS.why_underappreciated: Market expects imminent readout; event accrual has slowed and no date is guided.
SLS.source: SELLAS PR Dec 29 2025: https://ir.sellaslifesciences.com/news/News-Details/2025/SELLAS-Life-Sciences-Provides-Update-on-Pivotal-Phase-3-REGAL-Trial-of-Galinpepimut-S-GPS-in-Acute-Myeloid-Leukemia-AML/ ; Stocktwits Q2 summary (78/80)
SLS.suggestion: Announce the 80th event and unblinding timetable when reached, and disclose how $138M cash funds the SLS009 Phase 2 follow-on whatever REGAL shows.
SLS.why: Open-ended timing prolongs binary risk at a high valuation.

SNDX.datum: Revuforj Q2 2026 net revenue $54.7M (+91% YoY) on ~1,500 prescriptions (+121%); growth attributed to longer treatment duration, mainly post-transplant; 12/19 post-transplant SAVE patients resumed revumenib.
SNDX.why_underappreciated: Market watches frontline combos; post-transplant duration already drives current revenue.
SNDX.suggestion: Disclose median duration of Revuforj therapy and share of patients on post-transplant maintenance, to quantify revenue durability beyond the frontline combos.

VRXA.datum: Jun 2026 listing financing: $27.5M senior secured notes plus up to $50M purchase agreement against ~$40M cash; fields show debt $0, and a press source reports no human data.
VRXA.why_underappreciated: Secured debt ranks ahead of equity and is missing from the debt field.
VRXA.source: Rallies.ai Veraxa listing financing: https://rallies.ai/news/veraxa-biotech-begins-nasdaq-trading-secures-275m-note-and-50m-financing ; pharmaphorum SPAC article
VRXA.suggestion: Disclose note interest, maturity, security and conversion terms, and confirm VXA-901/VXA-101 clinical status with dosed-patient counts, since sources conflict on whether human data exist.
VRXA.why: Debt terms and clinical status are unverified.

XCUR.datum: Nasdaq equity-compliance deadline is Dec 2 2026 (extension granted Sep 10) against ~$2-3M cash; the Apr 2026 Adbiotech agreement discloses no payments and awaits a definitive agreement.
XCUR.why_underappreciated: Co-development headline implies funding; no payments disclosed and listing deadline falls within weeks.
XCUR.suggestion: Sign the definitive Adbiotech agreement with upfront cash before December 2, or announce an equity raise sized to restore the $2.5M stockholders' equity minimum.
XCUR.why: Deadline precedes any financing; delisting risk is imminent.

APLM.datum: Asia ex-China rights to vebreltinib plus EGFR inhibitor in NSCLC already licensed to LaunXP (Mar 2025; $8.5M upfront booked as 2025 revenue); China rights sit with Avistone. Only US/EU/rest-of-world remain.
APLM.why_underappreciated: Buried in licensing revenue line; narrows partnering options the current thesis assumes.
APLM.suggestion: Seek a US/EU partner for vebreltinib to fund the H1 2027 2L MET-amplified IND; China and Asia ex-China are already licensed, so $3.3M cash needs new territory deals.
APLM.why: Only US/EU rights remain; cash is $3.3M.

AVBP.datum: Oct 6 2026: FURVENT missed PFS vs chemotherapy; 240mg HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.55-1.02, p=0.0654), median PFS 11.0 vs 9.5 months; ORR 60% vs 33%.
AVBP.why_underappreciated: Dashboard still shows overdue topline; near-miss with doubled ORR is not yet reflected.
AVBP.suggestion: Seek FDA feedback on whether ORR 60% versus 33% and PFS HR 0.75 support filing, and update plans for the PACC mutation trial.

BBOT.datum: 21 of 28 (75%) BBO-8520 monotherapy patients eligible for six-month follow-up stayed on treatment beyond six months (cutoff Jun 1, 2026); PFS not reported; expanded pembrolizumab-combination data now mid-2027.
BBOT.why_underappreciated: Market keys on ORR; durability sits in the release body and PFS is unreported.
BBOT.suggestion: Report median PFS and duration of response for monotherapy and the pembrolizumab cohort, and set the post-G12C-inhibitor registrational design, since combination data now slip to mid-2027.
BBOT.why: Durability and PFS are missing; next combo data is mid-2027.

BCAX.datum: FORTIFI-HN01 is randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled with pembrolizumab; 1500 mg QW dose chosen; enrollment substantially complete end-2026; interim analysis mid-2027 tied to a potential accelerated filing (Jan 2026 release).
BCAX.why_underappreciated: Dashboard shows mid-2026 data; the real randomized interim and filing option are a year later.
BCAX.suggestion: Disclose the interim endpoint, the response threshold FDA accepted for accelerated filing, and event timing, so mid-2027 can be judged against the single-arm 54% response rate.
BCAX.why: Interim endpoint and FDA threshold are undisclosed.

AGIO.datum: RISE UP (Nov 2025): no drug-induced hepatocellular injury pattern in either arm, unlike ENERGIZE/ENERGIZE-T; serious TEAEs 20.3% mitapivat vs 29.0% placebo; Hb response 40.6% vs 2.9%.
AGIO.why_underappreciated: Headline was the missed pain-crisis endpoint; clean liver signal sits in safety text.
AGIO.suggestion: Before the Nov 1 PDUFA, present RISE UP liver-enzyme data and Hb-responder fatigue (post hoc -5.19 vs -2.55) to support a label with light liver monitoring.
AGIO.why: Clean liver profile and responder benefit support label and uptake.

COAG.datum: HMB-002 150 mg single dose (ISTH Jul 2026): VWF and FVIII up at least 2.4x with no serious TEAEs, no thromboembolic events, none related to drug; 8/9 had zero treated bleeds in 28 days (descriptive).
COAG.why_underappreciated: Attention is on bleed reduction; thrombosis risk of raising VWF/FVIII is the key unknown.
COAG.suggestion: At the next update, report repeat-dose VWF/FVIII peaks with D-dimer and thromboembolic events, and bleeds by VWD subtype, to show the rise is safe and predicts fewer bleeds.
COAG.why: Thrombosis safety at repeat dosing decides the prophylaxis case.

ETRA.datum: S-1/424B4 (Sep 2026): off-label sHLH agents are generally available at low cost, emapalumab is approved only for primary HLH and Still's MAS, and sHLH patient counts rest on one internally commissioned claims analysis.
ETRA.why_underappreciated: Buried in prospectus risk factors; narrative stresses 'no approved sHLH therapy'.
ETRA.suggestion: Commission and publish an independent sHLH incidence and treatment-cost analysis, and disclose COMPASS cohort size and matching method, before SURPASS enrollment completes in 2H 2027.
ETRA.why: Replaces a single internal claims estimate with checkable market evidence.

MGX.datum: Cash and marketable securities $120.7M at Jun 30 2026, funding operations through 4Q 2027 per company; MGX-001 IND still targeted 4Q 2026, GLP toxicology due by end of Q3 2026.
MGX.why_underappreciated: Market value (~$30M per dashboard) sits far below cash and the runway covers the IND and first dosing.
MGX.suggestion: Cash already covers the IND and first dosing; partner MGX-001 or the platform only above cash value, and disclose GLP toxicology completion.
MGX.why: Runway removes forced dilution; deal terms should reflect cash.

XFOR.datum: FDA Type C (Sep 8 2026): 126 patients keeps adequate power for both co-primaries (infection rate, ANC), and the proposed safety database is acceptable to support a supplemental NDA; company said 176 was overpowered.
XFOR.why_underappreciated: Market reacted to the sample-size cut; sNDA pathway and safety database acceptance are secondary.
XFOR.suggestion: Disclose the 4WARD power assumptions (assumed infection-rate reduction and power) and Ph2 ANC-to-infection link so investors can judge the 126-patient size against G-CSF benchmarks.
XFOR.why: Transparent powering resolves doubt from the sample-size cut.

ACTU.datum: Actuate-1801 randomized Ph2 (n=286, 2:1; ASCO GI Jan 2026): 24-month survival 12.9% vs 2.6% with GnP alone; 1-year 44.4% vs 22.3%; grade 3+ TEAEs stopping drug 16.8% vs 21.8%.
ACTU.why_underappreciated: Market quotes median OS and 1-year survival; the long-term tail is rarely cited.
ACTU.suggestion: Lead partnering talks with the 24-month survival tail (12.9% vs 2.6%) and close financing now; the 10-Q says cash of $4.4M lasts only to September 2026.
ACTU.why: Cash runs out before any registration study can start.

ADAG.datum: Muzastotug+pembro MSS CRC (Aug 12 2026): 20 mg/kg load then 10 mg/kg Q3W (n=14) ORR 36%, mPFS 15.4 mo vs 0/10 ORR at 10 mg/kg Q6W; randomized Ph2 arms use different regimens.
ADAG.why_underappreciated: Buried in a cohort table; headline 13% ORR at 10 mg/kg dominates.
ADAG.suggestion: Explain why the loading-then-Q3W regimen (n=14, mPFS 15.4 mo) is not a randomized arm, and report its OS and grade 3 rate before the 1H 2027 readout.
ADAG.why: Dose choice drives the registration-trial regimen and the PoS of the readout.

AGEN.datum: ROBBIN (n=850, 1:1, primary EFS): interim pathologic response 2H 2027, interim EFS 2H 2029, final EFS 2H 2030; Agenus stopped metastatic Ph3 BATTMAN after ~3 months for strategic focus, not stated futility.
AGEN.why_underappreciated: Market watches 2027 pathologic response; the approval-grade EFS readouts are 3-4 years out.
AGEN.suggestion: Seek an ex-US partner to fund ROBBIN to its 2029 interim EFS, and disclose the FDA-agreed pathologic-response criteria that would allow earlier action.
AGEN.why: EFS data arrive years after current cash and financing run out.

CMPX.datum: COMPANION-002 ITT OS was flat: median 8.9 vs 9.4 months (HR 1.05, p=0.78); FDA advised a new trial showing survival benefit before BLA (Sep 22 2026); crossover post hoc HR 0.54 is exploratory.
CMPX.metric: ITT OS HR vs FDA request
CMPX.why_underappreciated: Narrative blames crossover, but ITT OS hazard ratio is above 1 and FDA wants a new trial.
CMPX.suggestion: Seek a Type A discussion on the smallest OS-powered confirmatory design, citing PFS HR 0.44, and fund it plus CTX-8371 from cash; disclose post-FDA cash and timing.
CMPX.why: Defines confirmatory-trial cost against cash near market value.

CRDF.datum: Nerviano (NMS) alleges Cardiff materially breached the onvansertib license (notice Feb 24 2026) over joint inventorship on two patents; Cardiff sued May 19 2026 for a declaratory judgment and injunction.
CRDF.why_underappreciated: Buried in an 8-K; headline is the ORR 72% vs 42% randomized signal.
CRDF.suggestion: Resolve the NMS license dispute by settlement or declaratory judgment before partnering, since any Ph3 partner will diligence license rights; disclose status and expected timing.
CRDF.why: Partner and Ph3 financing depend on clean license rights.

CTMX.datum: Varseta-M 10 mg/kg confirmed ORR 32% is 6/19; 8.6 mg/kg is 20% (4/20); 7.2 mg/kg 6% (1/17). Grade 3+ diarrhea in 19 of 80 patients (Jan 16 2026 cutoff).
CTMX.why_underappreciated: Pitch cites pooled 26% and 32%; per-dose cohorts are about 20 patients with notable diarrhea.
CTMX.suggestion: At dose selection, show 8.6 vs 10 mg/kg response, PFS and Grade 3+ diarrhea side by side, with EpCAM-level subgroups, to justify the registrational dose.
CTMX.why: Dose choice trades a 12-point ORR gain against tolerability.

ELTX.datum: AMPLIFY-7P ESMO (Oct 2026): ITT DFS HR 0.85 (missed); HR 0.51 in ctDNA-negative (n=93) and 0.57 in ctDNA-positive (n=26), despite baseline ctDNA positivity 20.8% vs 12.5% against vaccine.
ELTX.why_underappreciated: Market anchored on missed ITT primary and R0 post hoc; ctDNA strata are newest.
ELTX.suggestion: Stratify the Ph3 by baseline ctDNA and R0 status (ctDNA HR 0.51 and 0.57 in AMPLIFY-7P) and pursue a partner; cash funds operations only into Q4 2026.
ELTX.why: Consistent ctDNA-stratum benefit supports a Ph3, but cash ends in Q4.

EXEL.datum: STELLAR-303 non-liver-metastases subgroup missed OS (reported Jun 22 2026): HR 0.83, p=0.1185, median 15.9 vs 12.7 months; the NDA (PDUFA Dec 3 2026) rests on ITT HR 0.80.
EXEL.why_underappreciated: Subgroup was the best-case population; the miss is secondary to the positive ITT headline.
EXEL.suggestion: Before the Dec 3 PDUFA, show OS by liver-metastasis status and tolerability versus regorafenib to support an ITT-based label; do not lean on the non-significant NLM subgroup.
EXEL.why: Label rests on ITT; subgroup framing could backfire.

IMRX.datum: FDA approved daraxonrasib Aug 26 2026 for previously treated mPDAC (RASolute 302, n=500: mOS 13.2 vs 6.7 mo, HR 0.40); MAPKeeper-301 (~510 pts, OS primary) will enroll against it in 1L.
IMRX.why_underappreciated: Approval is newer than models; it lets post-progression patients get daraxonrasib, blurring OS.
IMRX.suggestion: Prespecify an interim OS look and an analysis adjusting for post-progression daraxonrasib use in MAPKeeper-301, since approved second-line RAS(ON) therapy can dilute the OS difference.
IMRX.why: Protects the OS readout from second-line daraxonrasib dilution.

JAZZ.datum: LAGOON Ph3 (Jun 12 2026): Zepzelca monotherapy median OS 8.7 vs 10.7 months control (HR 1.19); with irinotecan 10.9 (HR 0.90). Jazz will discuss 2L SCLC accelerated-approval requirements with FDA.
JAZZ.why_underappreciated: Company said guidance unaffected; the 2020 2L accelerated approval is now exposed.
JAZZ.suggestion: Disclose FDA's decision on the 2L SCLC accelerated approval and the share of Zepzelca revenue from 2L versus 1L maintenance, to size exposure.
JAZZ.why: Sizes label-withdrawal risk in a diversified portfolio.

NBP.datum: NovaBridge held $215.9M cash and investments at Jun 30 2026 ($190.6M cash alone), funding givastomig to the 2028 Ph3 interim; supplied fields show $30M cash and ~$147M market cap.
NBP.why_underappreciated: Supplied cash looks stale; H1 report shows cash above the quoted market cap.
NBP.suggestion: Publish PD-L1 CPS-stratified ORR and randomized Ph2 dose selection before the Q4 2026 Ph3 start, since FDA accelerated eligibility covers only PD-L1-positive, CLDN18.2-positive disease.
NBP.why: Narrow eligible population, not funding, is the open question.

ONCY.datum: FDA feedback Aug 18 2026 on REO 033 is written, not a formal agreement; FDA suggested an End-of-Phase meeting; Part A is randomized n=60; ORR/DOR for accelerated, PFS for full approval.
ONCY.why_underappreciated: Headline reads 'FDA aligned'; release says final agreement needs an End-of-Phase meeting.
ONCY.suggestion: Request the End-of-Phase meeting to lock endpoints and Part B size, and fund the Part A interim through a partner given about $5M cash.
ONCY.why: Converts written feedback into binding terms before the interim.

PDSB.datum: Cash $5.6M at Jun 30 2026 (from $26.7M at YE25), stockholders' equity -$3.6M, going-concern doubt; registration covers 110.0M resale shares for the pivot financing plus 13.3M for a $6M note and warrants.
PDSB.why_underappreciated: Dilution sits in registration filings, newer than analyst models and the 71% ORR headline.
PDSB.suggestion: Disclose the cash runway date and share count after the resale shelf, and close milestone-linked PDS0301 Ph2b funding or a PDS0101 partner before more dilution.
PDSB.why: Runway under two quarters with large pending share issuance.

RNXT.datum: TIGeR-PaC: 72 deaths by Mar 24 2026 and 78 by Aug 11 2026 against 86 needed for final analysis, about 1.3 events a month, implying the 86th event around early 2027 (our arithmetic).
RNXT.why_underappreciated: Event-driven readout may land before the Sep 2027 catalyst date.
RNXT.suggestion: Publish the quarterly event count and expected 86th-event date, and secure financing sized to an earlier final analysis, since cash was about $13M at Mar 30 2026.
RNXT.why: Event timing may pull the readout forward ahead of funding.

RVMD.datum: Rasonque label (Aug 26 2026): rash in 86% (grade 3 10%), yet only 2.9% permanently discontinued, 0.8% for rash; RASolute-302 dose interruptions 69%, reductions 37%.
RVMD.why_underappreciated: Headline is survival HR 0.40; tolerability burden sits in label tables, relevant to 1L combinations.
RVMD.suggestion: Publish exposure and efficacy by dose level after reduction, plus rash-management data, to support 1L combination dosing with chemotherapy or vopimetostat.

RXRX.datum: REC-4881 FAP: week-13 efficacy rests on 12 evaluable patients; grade 3 TRAEs 3/19 (15.8%); FDA registrational-design feedback undisclosed, update guided 2H 2026 (Q1 2026 report).
RXRX.why_underappreciated: Platform story dominates; registrational path and tiny sample are in footnotes.
RXRX.suggestion: Disclose the FDA-agreed endpoint and design for REC-4881 plus age-18+ cohort data before committing pivotal spend; keep the pipeline narrowing.
RXRX.why: Small-n data make FDA alignment the key unknown.

TNGX.datum: Vopimetostat+daraxonrasib 92% ORR is 11/12 evaluable (9/11 confirmed; 20 treated); zoldonrasib combo is 52% (14/27), 74% 6-month PFS; cutoff May 28 2026.
TNGX.why_underappreciated: Headline 92% rests on 12 evaluable patients; the larger zoldonrasib cohort shows 52%.
TNGX.suggestion: Report confirmed ORR for all 20 treated and finalize the Ph3 with a RevMed supply agreement covering both daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib backbones.
TNGX.why: Denominators and partner supply gate the Ph3 plan.

TVRD.datum: Q2 2026 release: cash $15.8M (6/30/26) now guided to fund operations through HCC topline 'into Q3 2027', versus Q4 2026 runway in our fields; market cap $12M.
TVRD.why_underappreciated: Newer than analyst models; stock sits below cash despite lengthened runway.
TVRD.suggestion: Disclose REVERT enrollment, evaluable patient count and endpoint definitions, and the spend plan reaching Q3 2027, so the HCC topline can be priced against $15.8M cash.
TVRD.why: Runway claim differs from earlier tight-cash view.

ZYME.datum: Theravance deal (Jun 29 2026): 75% of YUPELRI profit share is assigned to the $350M OMERS note; deal yields ~$60M annualized cash flow; $100M TRELEGY milestone expected Q1 2027.
ZYME.why_underappreciated: Headline is $250M Ziihera milestone; debt assignment and Q1 2027 milestone timing are in deal footnotes.
ZYME.suggestion: Disclose YUPELRI profit-share cash retained after OMERS service and the conditions for the $100M TRELEGY milestone, separately from zanidatamab royalties.
ZYME.why: Retained deal cash is far below headline flows.

AKTS.datum: Lilly agreement is a discovery collaboration on radioconjugates outside Aktis' own pipeline (Q2 2026 collaboration revenue $3.4M); the release names no Lilly role in AKY-1189; efficacy data due Q1 2027.
AKTS.why_underappreciated: 'Lilly-backed' label implies validation of AKY-1189; release describes platform research revenue only.
AKTS.suggestion: Disclose Lilly deal terms (milestones, options) and, with Q1 2027 NECTINIUM-2 data, tumor-to-kidney absorbed dose versus enfortumab vedotin benchmarks.
AKTS.why: Clarifies whether Lilly validates AKY-1189 itself.

ATNM.datum: Immedica told Actinium it would not pursue Iomab-B approval; $35.0M upfront recognized as revenue (H1 2026 net income $22.4M) while cash fell from $48.0M to $36.5M (6/30/26).
ATNM.why_underappreciated: Reported profit is accounting recognition; cash declined and the partner walked away.
ATNM.suggestion: Disclose how much of the $35M was previously received, and partner Actimab-A ('Phase 2/3 ready') rather than fund ATNM-400 alone from $36.5M cash.
ATNM.why: Cash is falling despite reported profit.

BCYC.datum: Duravelo-2 cohort 1 (zelenectide 6mg + pembrolizumab, untreated mUC): ORR 65% (17/26), BICR-confirmed 58-62%; sensory neuropathy 33%; company reports regulatory alignment on 6mg dose (Q2 2026 release).
BCYC.why_underappreciated: Restructuring headline hides response data comparable to EV+pembro; neuropathy rate is the offset.
BCYC.suggestion: Run a dated partner process for zelenectide using the 65% ORR and 6mg dose alignment; fund Duravelo-2 only if a partner pays.
BCYC.why: Strong response data sit unused after deprioritization.

CADL.datum: Ph3 CAN-2409: overall prostate-cancer-specific DFS HR 0.62 (p=0.0046), but conventional EBRT (~72% of patients) HR 0.76, 95% CI 0.53-1.07, not significant; hypofractionated HR 0.52 (Nov 2025 release).
CADL.why_underappreciated: Headline is the overall result; the majority radiation regimen's CI crosses 1 in a subgroup table.
CADL.suggestion: Agree the label population with FDA before the Q4 2026 BLA and show a radiation-regimen interaction analysis; secure non-dilutive launch financing.
CADL.why: Label may hinge on radiation-regimen subgroup.

CGON.datum: PIVOT-006 (intermediate-risk NMIBC Ph3) has accrued 'the vast majority' of target events; topline 'soon' per Q2 2026 release; BLA for BCG-unresponsive CIS completes Q4 2026; cash $1.0B funds through 2029.
CGON.why_underappreciated: Valuation debate centers on the BCG-unresponsive label and Anktiva; a larger-population Ph3 is near.
CGON.suggestion: Give PIVOT-006 event count, analysis trigger and expected topline date, with the recurrence-free survival assumptions, so investors can size the intermediate-risk opportunity.
CGON.why: Binary Ph3 in a larger population is close.

ENGN.datum: LEGEND cohort 1: 54% CR any time (67/124); at Apr 21 2026 cutoff 21 patients still pending 6/9/12-month assessments and no 12-month durability disclosed; ~50% workforce cut, cohorts 2a/2b/3 paused (Jun 15 2026).
ENGN.why_underappreciated: Dashboard's ~25% 12-month figure is unsupported by company disclosure; restructuring and pending data are newer.
ENGN.suggestion: Release per-patient 12-month CR including the 21 pending before the FDA meeting; seek a label on 6-month CR only if durability is mature.
ENGN.why: Durability data decide label and reimbursement.

IBRX.datum: FDA accepted the papillary-only sBLA (QUILT-3.032 cohort B, n=80, 12-month DFS 58.2%); PDUFA Jan 6 2027. The BCG-naive QUILT-2.005 expansion is not this action.
IBRX.why_underappreciated: Jan 2027 date is read as BCG-naive expansion; it covers a narrower papillary-only label.
IBRX.suggestion: Separate the papillary-only Jan 6 2027 decision from BCG-naive filing timing in guidance, and give the cash plan against $1.19B debt and 5.4-quarter runway.
IBRX.why: Narrower catalyst than the $9.1B valuation implies.

JANX.datum: Cash and investments $970.9M at 6/30/26 against EV about $117M; Q2 2026 net loss only $22.0M with $10.3M collaboration revenue; next JANX007 data H1 2027.
JANX.why_underappreciated: Fields-only but striking: four PSMA programs priced near cash after mixed March 2026 update.
JANX.suggestion: Add a controlled arm in taxane-naive mCRPC with darolutamide before the H1 2027 update; cash covers it and rPFS 7.9-8.9 months needs a comparator.
JANX.why: Cash allows randomized evidence the market wants.

KYNB.datum: Roxadustat low-risk MDS Phase 3 protocol finalized, start targeted 4Q 2026 with Kyntra holding US rights; post hoc MATTERHORN (EHA 2026) transfusion-independence gain similar in ring-sideroblast positive and negative (Aug 13 2026 release).
KYNB.why_underappreciated: Market prices only the weak prostate ADC; roxadustat is treated as a legacy royalty asset.
KYNB.suggestion: Seek a roxadustat MDS Phase 3 partner or ex-US royalty monetization before the 4Q 2026 start, so cash funds only the FG-3246 interim.
KYNB.why: Roxadustat Phase 3 cost could consume cash worth far more than market cap.

LNTH.datum: Curium CVR pays up to $12 only on 2030 sales: $8 from prostate diagnostics thresholds ($950M to $1.75B), $3 neurology diagnostics, $1 DEFINITY over $400M.
LNTH.why_underappreciated: Headline cites up to $8B; two-thirds of CVR needs prostate sales above $950M.
LNTH.suggestion: Value the CVR by tranche against 2030 PYLARIFY-led prostate diagnostics sales, and have the board publish the Adjusted Sales definition and LNTH-2501 remediation plan.
LNTH.why: CVR is mostly prostate diagnostics sales above $950M in 2030.

ORIC.datum: Ph1b 400 mg rinzimetostat + ARPI: rPFS 85% at 5 months, but PSA50 only 47% (7/15), confirmed PSA50 33% (5/15); Himalayas-1 (n~600) control is physician's-choice ARPI or docetaxel (Mar-Jul 2026).
ORIC.why_underappreciated: Headline is 84-85% landmark rPFS; small PSA response denominators sit in secondary reporting.
ORIC.suggestion: Disclose cohort size and follow-up behind the 85% 5-month rPFS and confirmed PSA50, beside matched post-abiraterone controls, and show how Himalayas-1's mixed control arm sets the bar.
ORIC.why: Investors cannot size the effect Phase 3 must beat.

RCUS.datum: ARC-20 (Oct 20 2026): late-line monotherapy n=121 median PFS 13 mo, ORR 36%; 2L +cabozantinib n=30 mPFS 14.5 mo; 1L n=30 ORR 50%, 12-mo PFS 69%.
RCUS.why_underappreciated: Dashboard still cites 15-18 month PFS and 45% ORR from earlier cohorts.
RCUS.suggestion: Present ARC-20 by cohort with follow-up and anemia, hypoxia and dose-reduction rates versus belzutifan labeling; those rates were not reported in coverage.
RCUS.why: Updated cohorts are below the earlier 15-18 month PFS.

RLMD.datum: Company says FDA aligned on two registration pathways; Phase 3 RESCUE is open-label single-arm, primary endpoint complete response at any time, one reinduction allowed; IND still YE2026; cash $217.7M funds through 2029 (Aug 2026 call).
RLMD.why_underappreciated: Market sees pre-IND status, not a single-arm registrational design with funding through 2029.
RLMD.suggestion: Publish the FDA-aligned RESCUE protocol (endpoint definition, sample size, reinduction rule) and GMP batch dates; the 2029 runway lessens the need to sell sepranolone first.
RLMD.why: Endpoint definition and IND timing decide whether 80% 12-month CR counts.

TARA.datum: BCG-unresponsive CIS CR was 68.2% at 6 months (15/22) but 33.3% at 12 months (5/15); BCG-naive 57.9% at 12 months (11/19) (Jan 28 2026 cutoff, Feb 23 2026 release).
TARA.why_underappreciated: Headline was the 68% six-month CR; the 12-month figure is a small-n secondary line.
TARA.suggestion: Report 12-month durability on a larger BCG-unresponsive cohort before enrollment completes, and put the 2H 2026 ADVANCED-3 BCG-naive registrational start first for capital.
TARA.why: BCG-unresponsive durability is the weak point in approvability.

TLX.datum: Oct 21 2026 6-K: US ProstACT Global Part 2 awaits an FDA IND amendment, ex-US Part 2 enrolling in 7 countries; Q3 revenue $245M, down 1% vs Q2 $247M.
TLX.why_underappreciated: ITM deal and imaging growth overshadow no US Part 2 start date and flat quarter.
TLX.suggestion: Give a US Part 2 start date and readout window after the December 1 ITM vote, and show TLX591-Tx funding is protected from the $1.25B share issuance.
TLX.why: Pivotal timing is undisclosed and the ITM deal adds dilution.

TYRA.datum: BridgeBio's oral infigratinib met PROPEL 3 in achondroplasia: week-52 height velocity 5.96 vs 4.22 cm/yr placebo, no serious AEs; filing talks 2H 2026. Tyra BEACH301 efficacy (~25 children) not until end Q1 2027.
TYRA.why_underappreciated: Pitch calls oral achondroplasia the big prize; a rival's Phase 3 win leaves Tyra a year behind.
TYRA.suggestion: State the BEACH301 growth-velocity bar needed to differ from infigratinib and the path to Phase 3, and say whether bladder spending continues once the $250M ATM is available.
TYRA.why: Achondroplasia is the value case and a competitor is already ahead.

URGN.datum: At June 30 2026 ZUSDURI had 1,444 activated sites and 452 prescribers, 204 repeat (~45%), up from 972 sites and 256 prescribers in Q1; UGN-103 full launch awaits a unique J-code with no timing given.
URGN.why_underappreciated: Revenue headlines dominate; repeat-prescriber depth and the J-code dependency are in release detail.
URGN.suggestion: Disclose Pharmakon principal, rate and maturity and UGN-103 J-code timing, then arrange non-dilutive financing against ZUSDURI sales before the 2027 FDA decision.
URGN.why: Debt terms and J-code timing set runway through the UGN-103 launch.

XNCR.datum: Alexion settlement (Jul 29 2026): $105M in two $52.5M payments (Aug 2026, Aug 2027); Alexion owes no further US Ultomiris royalties; ex-US royalties continue.
XNCR.why_underappreciated: Cash receipt is visible; permanent end of the US royalty stream is not.
XNCR.suggestion: Show Xencor's remaining royalty run-rate without US Ultomiris, and report XmAb819's 45.5% ORR at 400 ug/kg separately from the all-dose 25% ORR.
XNCR.why: Royalty value now rests on ex-US sales and platform deals.

ACRV.datum: Phase 3 confirmatory ACR-368 trial to start 1H 2027, but cash $90.0M (Jun 30 2026) funds only into 4Q 2027; Arms 3+4 interim now guided 2H 2026, not October (Aug 2026 release).
ACRV.why_underappreciated: Negative EV hides that the registrational Phase 3 start is unfunded within current runway.
ACRV.suggestion: Pair the interim with a funded Phase 3 plan: a partner or financing for ACR-368, and report OncoSignature-positive response separately from all-comer arms.
ACRV.why: Phase 3 cost likely exceeds runway; the interim is the financing window.

ALXO.datum: ASPEN-09-Breast (n=80, topline mid-2027) tests evorpacept with trastuzumab plus chemotherapy, while CD47-high predictive breast data (Jan 2026) came from an exploratory evorpacept + zanidatamab (Jazz) study; no collaboration disclosed.
ALXO.why_underappreciated: Dashboard treats CD47-high breast signal as the basis for ASPEN-09; the combinations differ.
ALXO.suggestion: State whether ASPEN-09 enrolls CD47-high patients only and the response rate that would justify Phase 3; seek zanidatamab-combination clarity or partner terms before the mid-2027 topline.
ALXO.why: Biomarker evidence and the running trial use different combinations.

ANAB.datum: About $299M of Sagard non-recourse royalty monetization remains, with paydown expected 2H 2027, against Q2 2026 Jemperli net sales $331M (+26%) and $164.1M cash; Delaware reversion ruling due Q4 2026-Q1 2027.
ANAB.why_underappreciated: Pure-royalty framing ignores that royalties are largely pledged to Sagard until 2H 2027.
ANAB.suggestion: Publish a royalty model showing royalties retained after Sagard repayment, the Delaware reversion scenarios, and the December 12 imsidolimab PDUFA milestone, to value the stream.
ANAB.why: Retained royalty cash differs from GSK-guided peak sales.

ANIX.datum: Five lira-cel patients survived over one year (about 28, 20, 17, 17, 13 months) with no objective responses reported; Cohort 5 (1e7 cells/kg) first patient treated Jul 6 2026; cash $13.9M at Jul 31 2026.
ANIX.why_underappreciated: Market dismisses it as promotional with no RECIST responses; survival durations are buried.
ANIX.suggestion: Report overall survival for all dosed patients against matched platinum-resistant controls, not selected survivors, before further sales under the $95M ATM.
ANIX.why: Selective survival anecdotes cannot support a raise without full-cohort data.

ATOS.datum: EVANGELINE enrollment completed June 30 2026 but no efficacy readout date is given; cash $26.1M vs Q2 opex $8.7M; June direct offering added warrants worth up to $12M (Aug 2026 release).
ATOS.why_underappreciated: December 2026 is assumed as a data catalyst; the company has not guided one.
ATOS.suggestion: Guide a dated EVANGELINE readout and primary endpoint; narrow spend to it and I-SPY2, and state whether June warrants exercise (up to $12M) covers the gap.
ATOS.why: A readout date decides whether cash lasts to data.

CELC.datum: VIKTORIA-1 PIK3CA-mutant cohort vs alpelisib + fulvestrant: triplet HR 0.50, median PFS 11.1 vs 5.6 months; discontinuation for AEs 5.2% vs 19.1% on alpelisib; sNDA Q3 2026.
CELC.why_underappreciated: Focus is the wild-type HR 0.24 vs fulvestrant; mutant data beat an active comparator.
CELC.suggestion: Lead mutant-sNDA and Q4 conference messaging with the head-to-head alpelisib data, and report first REVTORPYK shipments and payer coverage at the Q3 print.
CELC.why: An active-comparator win widens the label beyond wild-type.

CGEN.datum: Cash $145.6M at 12/31/25, no debt, funded into 2029; AZ rilvegostomig has 10 Ph3 trials, up to $195M milestones ($25M at BLA acceptance), tiered royalties to mid-single digits.
CGEN.why_underappreciated: Buried in a partner's pipeline; headline story is COM701 Phase 1.
CGEN.suggestion: Publish a rilvegostomig scenario table: $25M on BLA acceptance, up to $195M milestones, tiered royalties, set against an enterprise value near $52M.
CGEN.why: Partnered economics are priced near zero.

CNTX.datum: Grade 1 CRS in 1/9 PROC patients at active doses (140-280ug), no higher grade; 29% ORR is only 2/7 evaluable PROC patients (data cutoff May 29, 2026).
CNTX.why_underappreciated: Headline is ORR; CRS, the main T-cell-engager risk, is buried in the release.
CNTX.suggestion: Report CRS and response for Q3W dosing in less pretreated PROC (data now Q2 2027); seek a CLDN6 partner since $43.0M cash lasts only into Q4 2027.
CNTX.why: Next data slipped to Q2 2027; cash ends Q4 2027.

CORT.datum: Lifyorli Q2 2026, its first quarter: $47.6M sales, over 1,300 patients started, NCCN preferred regimen (April); Korlym plus generic $208.6M, up 7%. Q2 SG&A $156.9M vs $103.9M.
CORT.why_underappreciated: Narrative anchors on Korlym generic erosion; launch uptake and NCCN status are newer than models.
CORT.suggestion: Disclose Lifyorli patient persistence, treatment duration and new-patient starts monthly, with SG&A trajectory, so investors can model launch economics ahead of the EC and December 17 Cushing's PDUFA.
CORT.why: Persistence drives ovarian revenue; SG&A rose 51% year over year.

FTH.datum: Ph1b endometrioid cohort: 4 of 5 patients responded (3 complete, 1 partial) with paclitaxel plus PIKTOR; Ph2 FTH-PIK-201 is single-arm, ORR primary, Fast Track limited to pathway-altered tumors.
FTH.why_underappreciated: Buried in a 5-patient cohort; the headline cites the 15-patient 47% ORR.
FTH.suggestion: Before the year-end Ph2 topline, prespecify the ORR and complete-response bar versus gedatolisib, and report response by PI3K/AKT/mTOR alteration so a mixed result stays interpretable.
FTH.why: Single-arm ORR readout needs a stated bar.

GLSI.datum: 2025 burn about $9.5M against year-end cash about $6M; roughly $7M raised via ATM in the first three weeks of January 2026; management calls large financing less likely (Jan 27, 2026).
GLSI.why_underappreciated: Ph3 narrative dominates; cash is thin and funded by continuous share sales.
GLSI.suggestion: Disclose current event count versus the 28-event design and ATM usage monthly; seek a non-dilutive partner before the first interim, since cash is about $9M.
GLSI.why: Cash is thin; ATM dilution continues.

GMAB.datum: Rina-S RAINFOL-01 Part C (n=109): all-grade neutropenia 57.8% and anemia 57.8%, serious AEs about one-third, 5.5% stopped for AEs; grade 3+ rates not reported (Oct 3, 2026).
GMAB.why_underappreciated: Release highlights absent ocular/ILD signals; grade 3+ hematologic toxicity is not disclosed.
GMAB.suggestion: Publish Part C grade 3+ neutropenia and anemia, dose reductions, and ORR by FRa level to show tolerability supports a broad label beyond FRa-high.
GMAB.why: Tolerability decides the label breadth and RAINFOL-02 edge.

GNLX.datum: After an FDA Type D meeting, Genelux believes OnPrime (n/a, open-label vs physician's-choice chemo plus bevacizumab) could support traditional approval if PFS improves meaningfully without an OS decrement (Nov 5, 2025).
GNLX.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on repeated delays and open-label design, not the FDA-discussed approval bar.
GNLX.suggestion: Fund OnPrime to topline: cash of $26M lasts about 3.7 quarters. Pre-commit the final-analysis date and publish the PFS and OS decision rules agreed with FDA.
GNLX.why: Short runway and slipped dates; FDA bar is PFS without OS harm.

KZIA.datum: FDA agreed with Kazia on a pivotal Ph3 population, primary endpoint and comparator for newly diagnosed unmethylated GBM, with OS able to support traditional approval; GBM-AGILE secondary OS gain 3.8 months (Dec 31, 2024).
KZIA.why_underappreciated: Market sees a missed GBM primary and a pivot to breast cancer.
KZIA.suggestion: Publish a costed GBM Ph3 protocol and partner plan alongside TNBC data; the FDA-agreed registrational path is the least-used asset, and August 2026 financing is about $40M upfront.
KZIA.why: FDA-agreed GBM path is unused value.

LONA.datum: Q2 2026 net cash used in operations $37.9M versus $21.7M a year earlier; cash $51.1M at June 30, 2026; ELAINE-3 topline not until 2H 2027; warrants could add up to $146M.
LONA.why_underappreciated: Net loss of $19.0M understates cash use; runway versus 2H 2027 topline is short.
LONA.suggestion: Give explicit runway guidance and warrant exercise triggers; at Q2 cash use, $51.1M covers under two quarters, far short of the 2H 2027 topline.
LONA.why: Cash use outpaces reported loss; runway undisclosed.

OKUR.datum: Cash and securities $176.4M at June 30, 2026, funding operations into 2029, versus market cap about $105M; OKI-345 IND planned H1 2027, no human data (Q2 2026 release).
OKUR.why_underappreciated: Preclinical reset overshadows an unusually large cash cushion; stated here because the fact is itself striking.
OKUR.suggestion: Consider a buyback or tender while shares trade below cash, and publish OKI-345 IND-enabling milestones and a partnering plan ahead of the H1 2027 IND.

OLMA.datum: OP-3136 (KAT6 inhibitor) showed anti-tumor activity across multiple dose levels at ASCO 2026; Ph1b/2 with darolutamide in mCRPC to start enrolling Q4 2026. OPERA-01 topline now Q1 2027.
OLMA.why_underappreciated: Valuation debates OPERA-01 and class contagion; the second asset's prostate expansion is overlooked.
OLMA.suggestion: Disclose OP-3136 response data by dose and the OPERA-01 ESR1-mutant subgroup size and analysis plan, so the Q1 2027 topline and second asset are valued separately.
OLMA.why: Second asset adds value independent of OPERA-01.

PBYI.datum: Q2 2026 operating cash flow was $1.6M versus $14.1M a year earlier, with R&D up to $18.9M on alisertib; debt repaid May 4, 2026; H1 GAAP net income $4.4M versus $8.8M.
PBYI.why_underappreciated: Headline is raised guidance and revenue beat; cash conversion weakened sharply.
PBYI.suggestion: Set explicit alisertib go/no-go criteria for the Q4 2026 ALISCA-Breast1 update, and hold the buyback until operating cash flow recovers from Q2's $1.6M.

PMVP.datum: PYNNACLE ovarian: ORR 46% (35/76), median DoR 10.0 months on confirmed responses (cutoff May 14, 2026; Aug 31 release), longer than the 8.2 months in our fields.
PMVP.why_underappreciated: Updated duration is newer than models; EV is about $1M.
PMVP.suggestion: Seek an ex-US partner or royalty financing before the Q1 2027 NDA, citing the 10.0-month DoR; cash roughly equals market cap.
PMVP.why: Funds launch without dilution at a cash-level price.

PRLD.datum: PRT13722 (KAT6A degrader) Phase 1 start is expected only in Q4 2026 pending IND clearance; PRT12396 first-data timing and Incyte option terms are undisclosed (Q3 2026 release).
PRLD.why_underappreciated: Fields assume ongoing dose escalation; the second pillar has no human dosing yet.
PRLD.suggestion: Confirm PRT13722 IND clearance and first-dosing date, and give PRT12396 first-data timing plus Incyte option window; neither is disclosed.
PRLD.why: Undisclosed timing makes catalysts and partner value unmodelable.

RLAY.datum: Zovegalisib+fulvestrant mPFS 11.2 mo in kinase-domain PIK3CA mutants (n=33) vs 11.0 mo in non-kinase-domain (n=24); overall 11.1 mo, n=57, cutoff Jan 13 2026 (Mar 16 2026 release).
RLAY.why_underappreciated: Buried in a secondary table; supports true pan-mutant activity, which capivasertib lacks evidence for.
RLAY.suggestion: Mutation-class PFS is already public. Instead disclose all-grade hyperglycemia incidence, dose reductions and discontinuations at 400mg fed, benchmarked to capivasertib, before the 2027 ReDiscover-2 interim.
RLAY.why: Release gave no overall hyperglycemia rate; safety is the open comparator gap.

TELO.datum: Telomir-Zn IND submitted Mar 31 2026 and reported cleared by Apr 30 2026 for TELO-001, a ~76-patient open-label Ph1/2 (3+3 then Simon two-stage, ORR) in TNBC; fields still list IND as pending.
TELO.why_underappreciated: Our fields treat IND as pending; trial size versus ~$6M cash is overlooked.
TELO.suggestion: Announce funding sized to the ~76-patient TELO-001 and the first-site activation date; $6M cash cannot complete it.
TELO.why: Cleared IND is unfunded; dosing date and money decide credibility.

VSTM.datum: VS-7375 900mg monotherapy in 2L+ KRAS G12D pancreatic cancer (n=22): 41% confirmed ORR, 86% DCR, 6-mo OS 80%; grade 3 TRAEs 10%, AE discontinuation 2% (n=48), cutoff Sep 29 2026.
VSTM.why_underappreciated: Newer than models; market prices Verastem on LGSOC and runway, not oral G12D asset.
VSTM.suggestion: Disclose FDA feedback on the VS-7375 PDAC Phase 3 design and 900 vs 1200mg dose choice, and ring-fence Oberland proceeds for the 1H 2027 start.
VSTM.why: Ph3 design and dose decide whether this outweighs LGSOC.

ZNTL.datum: DENALI Part 1b median OS 15.8 months in Cyclin E1-positive (n=48) versus 7.5 months Cyclin E1-negative (n=46); Oct 18, 2026 release; data cutoff Sep 2, 2025.
ZNTL.why_underappreciated: First OS figure; ORR headline dominated prior view and competitor relacorilant.
ZNTL.suggestion: At ESMO on Oct 23, show OS and response by Cyclin E1 level against relacorilant's HR 0.65, stating the Sep 2025 cutoff and cross-trial limits.

ADCT.datum: LOTIS-5 (Jun 3, 2026): PFS HR 0.73 (p=0.008) but OS HR 0.96; Grade 5 TEAEs 27 (13.2%) versus 9 (4.6%), mostly in patients aged 75 or older.
ADCT.why_underappreciated: Age concentration of deaths sits in the release body, not the PFS headline.
ADCT.suggestion: Analyze LOTIS-5 outcomes without patients aged 75 or older and discuss an age-restricted 2L label with FDA, alongside LOTIS-7 glofitamab data.
ADCT.why: Age-concentrated deaths may allow a narrower label.

ALLO.datum: ALPHA3 futility analysis (first 24 pts, Apr 2026): no CRS, ICANS or GVHD; no treatment-related hospitalizations; 10 of 12 cema-cel patients treated fully outpatient; about one-third of sites were community centers.
ALLO.why_underappreciated: Market debates MRD-to-EFS; outpatient logistics and community-site feasibility drive commercial reach.
ALLO.suggestion: Report MRD-negativity durability beyond day 45 and ctDNA kinetics, plus community-site outpatient infusion share, to link the safety edge to relapse prevention and uptake.
ALLO.why: Durable clearance plus outpatient access underpins EFS case and launch.

ATRA.datum: Pierre Fabre resubmitted tab-cel BLA Sep 30 2026 (FDA acceptance headline Oct 14); Atara's $31M milestone is payable only on approval, versus $9.9M cash at Jun 30 funding into mid-2027.
ATRA.why_underappreciated: Milestone is about 3x cash; Pierre Fabre, not Atara, controls the BLA.
ATRA.suggestion: Disclose the revised PDUFA date and resubmission class, then arrange financing or royalty-backed capital timed to it, since cash lasts only to mid-2027.
ATRA.why: Milestone arrives only at approval; cash ends before likely launch.

CTOR.datum: LYMPHIR vial orders +31% q/q to 926 (708 prior), July record 383 vials, 44 institutions; but fiscal Q3 revenue only $1.49M and cash $16.6M (Jun 30, 2026).
CTOR.why_underappreciated: Revenue lags wholesaler orders, so launch demand looks weaker than it is.
CTOR.suggestion: Report monthly vials and institution reorder rates with the next financing, and draw the remaining $15M term loan tranche to extend the short runway.

ESLA.datum: Cash $0.15M at Jun 30, 2026 versus $9.3M current liabilities, while Ph2 expansion dosed its first patient Jul 24 (11 patients dosed in total); market cap $41M.
ESLA.why_underappreciated: Efficacy headline (100% CR) hides near-zero cash and large liabilities.
ESLA.source: Company dashboard fields (Q2 2026 balance sheet, STARLIGHT-1)
ESLA.suggestion: Negotiate conversion or deferral of the $9.3M liabilities and secure financing before more Ph2 enrollment; disclose the funded patient count.
ESLA.why: Survival, not data, is the value driver.

IPHA.datum: Sobi deal (effective Sep 16, 2026): $75M upfront, about $40M near-term Sezary milestones, about $465M option milestones, tiered double-digit royalties; EV about $19M.
IPHA.why_underappreciated: Deal terms are new; headline asks about small Sezary market.
IPHA.suggestion: Publish milestone timing and royalty tiers, plus TELLOMAK Sezary data by KIR3DL2 expression and prior mogamulizumab exposure (ORR 43%, mDOR about 26 months).
IPHA.why: Milestone clarity supports value against a $19M EV.

AURA.datum: Cash $323.8M at 6/30/26 funds operations into 1H 2029 after the ~20% layoff; CoMpass Ph3 topline (108 patients, SPA) is due 2H 2027, leaving over a year of runway past readout.
AURA.why_underappreciated: Headline is the restructuring; funded runway beyond the pivotal readout is overlooked.
AURA.suggestion: Use the funded runway past the 2H27 readout to pursue an ex-US ocular partner and commercial-readiness work, avoiding new equity before topline.
AURA.why: Runway already covers topline, so partnering adds optionality without forced dilution.

DRTS.datum: Tolmar deal (Jun 2026) covers US prostate, not cSCC: $20M equity at $11.99 plus $15M facility funding at closing, up to $161.5M milestones, Tolmar pays Alpha Tau 60% of net sales.
DRTS.why_underappreciated: Coverage centers on the cSCC pivotal; the prostate partnership and 60% net-sales share are overlooked.
DRTS.suggestion: Before ReSTART topline, publish the cSCC duration-of-response bar and the prostate milestones that trigger Tolmar's $96.5M development and regulatory payments, so both value sources are visible.
DRTS.why: Two separate value sources are priced as one cSCC binary.

EVAX.datum: 3-year EVX-01 Ph2 follow-up (PR Oct 19, 2026): all patients kept their 2-year responses with no progression; 6 of 12 responders continued EVX-01 alone in year 3 after pembrolizumab.
EVAX.why_underappreciated: n=16 and cancer-vaccine skepticism hide that responses persisted after pembrolizumab was dropped.
EVAX.suggestion: Use the six monotherapy-maintained responders to open EVX-01 partnering talks now; the company calls the data a partnership foundation, and about 5 quarters of runway limits delay.
EVAX.why: Short runway makes a deal the only route to Ph3.

HURA.datum: Cash was $1.0M at 6/30/26; funding is a $50M credit line from the largest shareholder at 12%, principal due Apr 2031, only $5.7M drawn; Phase 3 enrollment now guided to 2H 2027.
HURA.why_underappreciated: Market cap near $134M rests on shareholder-funded monthly draws, not cash on hand.
HURA.suggestion: Disclose the draw schedule and covenants of the $50M shareholder facility, plus a funded plan for Phase 3 enrollment through 2H27.
HURA.why: Single-lender funding is the binding constraint.

IDYA.datum: OptimUM-02 (n=313): median DOR 6.8 months at 7.4-month median follow-up; OS immature at Jan 23 2026 cutoff with no OS hazard ratio reported; PFS HR 0.42 is the headline.
IDYA.why_underappreciated: PFS hazard ratio dominates; short follow-up leaves durability and survival untested.
IDYA.suggestion: Report timing of the OS interim and longer-follow-up DOR for OptimUM-02, plus the size of the HLA-A*02:01-negative pool, to support peak sales beyond a 6.8-month DOR.
IDYA.why: Durability and OS are the open questions.

IMCR.datum: About $120M of sales-related rebate accruals are payable in 2H 2026, against $880.2M cash and $394.2M loans at 6/30/26; TEBE-AM enrollment was still nearing its 540-patient target in August.
IMCR.why_underappreciated: Cash headline omits the rebate outflow; TEBE-AM timing is event-driven, not fixed.
IMCR.suggestion: Publish net cash after the $120M rebates and loans, and the TEBE-AM event count needed for topline, so balance sheet and readout timing are visible together.
IMCR.why: Cash and readout timing both differ from headline figures.

IMTX.datum: Aug 2026: SUPRAME interim and final PFS analyses replaced by one final analysis on a lower event count, as PFS events accrue slower than modeled; enrollment raised to about 450; topline H1 2027.
IMTX.why_underappreciated: Buried in the Q2 release; the cash runway into 2028 headline dominates.
IMTX.suggestion: Disclose the new PFS event target, current event count and control-arm PFS assumptions, so the H1 2027 readout date and risk can be judged.
IMTX.why: Slow events delay timing and change interim-look assumptions.

IOVA.datum: Company states $297.7M cash at 6/30/26 funds operations into 2H 2028; Q2 revenue $99.3M (up from $60.0M), gross margin 56% excluding D&A, Q2 net loss $47.3M.
IOVA.why_underappreciated: Runway models using 4.5 quarters miss the company's own 2H28 guidance and falling loss.
IOVA.suggestion: Report quarterly cash burn with Amtagvi gross margin so investors can verify the 2H28 runway and profitability path; sequence NSCLC sBLA spend (planned 2027) accordingly.
IOVA.why: Dilution risk is lower than a 4.5-quarter runway implies.

OBX.datum: Aug 3 2026 closing: about $350M pro forma cash after the $350M PIPE is guided to fund operations into 2H 2028; registrational melanoma topline by YE2027; PIPE investors own 47.2%.
OBX.why_underappreciated: Focus is on the 67% ORR; funded runway and PIPE ownership go unmentioned.
OBX.suggestion: Report durability and depth at SITC: DOR, CR rate and time on treatment in the ICI-resistant melanoma cohort, since the 67% ORR rests on n=15.
OBX.why: Durability separates 67% ORR from Amtagvi; runway covers registration.

REPL.datum: Tudriqev accelerated approval (Aug 6, 2026) rests on 24.2% ORR in 91 patients; confirmatory IGNYTE-3 reads out about 2030; list price about $450,000 per course vs Amtagvi $563,000.
REPL.why_underappreciated: Approval headlines hide a roughly four-year gap before confirmation; the price below Amtagvi is newer than models.
REPL.suggestion: Report realized net price per course and patients treated each quarter, and give IGNYTE-3 enrollment pace, because launch revenue must fund the roughly four years until confirmation.
REPL.why: Launch revenue must bridge four years to confirmation.

SLGL.datum: The Sun Pharma license (Apr 2026) covers TWYNEO in India, not patidegib; patidegib (Orphan, Breakthrough) is unpartnered. Cash $52.8M at Mar 31, 2026, funding into Q1 2028.
SLGL.why_underappreciated: Sun deal is widely read as patidegib validation; full economics remain with Sol-Gel.
SLGL.suggestion: Before the late-November topline, pre-state the month-12 new facial BCC count bar for success (102 of 113 completed), and open patidegib partnering after data.
SLGL.why: A defined bar and unpartnered rights frame the topline.

TCRX.datum: After the 9/2/26 cut (about 75% of staff), cash is guided to last only into Q4 2027, when Phase 1 for in vivo PRAME/MAGE-A4 is planned, after a Q3 2027 first IND.
TCRX.why_underappreciated: Below-cash valuation assumes cash persists; runway ends as first human dosing begins.
TCRX.suggestion: Partner or sell TSC-101 and the HLA-B*27 autoimmune program now, and seek an in vivo platform partner, since cash lasts only into Q4 2027.
TCRX.why: Cash does not reach first human data without partnering.

VRCA.datum: Cash fell to $11.2M at 6/30/26 from $30.1M at year-end; runway into 2028 depends on a $27.5M credit facility from an entity controlled by Chairman Manning being fully available; Q2 net loss $13.2M.
VRCA.why_underappreciated: Related-party facility, not cash on hand, carries the runway claim.
VRCA.suggestion: Pursue a VP-315 BCC partnership or out-license, since Phase 3 cannot be funded from $11.2M cash and a chairman-controlled $27.5M facility.
VRCA.why: Related-party facility is the sole funding bridge.

ANL.datum: AN0025 (EP4 antagonist) passed the Ph2 rectal cancer futility analysis in March 2026; topline due 1H 2027 (H1 2026 6-K). Cash $231.9M at Jun 30, 2026.
ANL.why_underappreciated: Market treats ANL as a no-data pan-RAS lottery ticket; AN0025 is a second, nearer readout.
ANL.suggestion: Guide AN0025 rectal Ph2 endpoint and success threshold before the 1H 2027 topline, alongside AN9025 expansion plans; $231.9M cash covers both.
ANL.why: Nearer AN0025 readout precedes any AN9025 human data.

ERAS.datum: FDA approved Revolution Medicines' daraxonrasib Aug 26, 2026 for 2L+ metastatic PDAC: median OS 13.2 vs 6.7 months (RASolute 302), about 6.5 months before PDUFA.
ERAS.why_underappreciated: Valuation leans on ERAS-0015's 57% uORR in PDAC; an approved RAS drug now sets the bar.
ERAS.suggestion: At ENA on Nov 20, show ERAS-0015 PDAC response depth and durability versus daraxonrasib's 13.2-month median OS, and define the 1L PDAC Ph3 comparator.
ERAS.why: An approved comparator reshapes the PDAC trial design.

FENC.datum: NCCN gives PEDMARK a 2A recommendation for adolescent and young adult use beyond the pediatric label; US patent protection to 2039 plus orphan exclusivity; Q2 2026 net income $2.0M on $17.2M sales.
FENC.why_underappreciated: Label-expansion framing misses that guideline support already exists for older patients.
FENC.suggestion: Report the share of eligible AYA cisplatin patients now treated since the NCCN 2A listing, and payer coverage wins, to show growth beyond $17M quarterly sales.
FENC.why: Guideline support may widen use before any label change.

IMMP.datum: Cash A$68.9M at 6/30/26 (A$29.2M above budget); runway guided well into H1 CY28; US$10M of the Dr. Reddy's US$20M upfront was repaid in June, with up to US$349.5M milestones still eligible.
IMMP.why_underappreciated: Stock trades on the failure headline; company-guided runway far exceeds the two-quarter dashboard figure.
IMMP.suggestion: Cut costs and narrow to the sarcoma and HNSCC path using the contracted 200L manufacturing run, and seek a partner for IMP761; runway is guided into H1 CY28.
IMMP.why: Runway allows a focused re-launch without near-term dilution.

IMNM.datum: RINGSIDE: worst pain intensity improved significantly at week 12 with clinically significant difference from week 4; confirmed ORR 56% vs 9%; PFS benefit consistent across prespecified subgroups.
IMNM.why_underappreciated: Market anchors on HR 0.16; symptom relief, a patient-facing differentiator, gets less attention.
IMNM.suggestion: Present RINGSIDE pain and GI/ovarian safety data versus nirogacestat, with once-daily dosing, to defend peak sales that look high for a second-to-market drug.
IMNM.why: Symptom benefit differentiates against the incumbent at Apr 2027 PDUFA.

INBX.datum: ChonDRAgon: treatment-related hepatic adverse events 11.8% on ozekibart vs 4.5% placebo, mostly Grade 1-2; one hepatotoxicity-related death occurred before mitigation (BLA acceptance PR, Jun 15, 2026).
INBX.why_underappreciated: Headline is HR 0.479 for PFS; the liver signal and early death sit in safety text.
INBX.suggestion: Before the April 14, 2027 PDUFA, disclose the liver-enzyme monitoring and exclusion criteria proposed for the label, and hepatic events after mitigation.
INBX.why: Liver safety is the most likely label constraint.

NTHI.datum: Cash was $2.0M at 6/30/26 against about $8.4M Q2 opex excluding stock compensation; Sep 9 2026 raised $15M at market with 3.57M warrants at $4.20 after NEO100 data (6-month PFS 48.9% vs 20%).
NTHI.why_underappreciated: Strong Phase 2a headline hides near-zero cash and dilutive financing.
NTHI.suggestion: Request the Type B meeting and define NEO100's single-arm registrational path, and disclose dilution from the $44.5M Mast Hill facility and $4.20 warrants before further draws.
NTHI.why: Financing terms gate the registrational path.

OSTX.datum: Cash was $205,035 at Jun 30, 2026 vs about $24.0M of expected 2026 costs; 10-Q flags going-concern doubt; Aug 10 financing netted only about $4.7M.
OSTX.why_underappreciated: Fields-only striking gap: $58M market value sits on a cash balance covering days of spending.
OSTX.suggestion: Secure about $24M of non-dilutive or partner funding before completing the BLA; the Aug 10 raise netted $4.7M against $24.0M of expected 2026 costs.
OSTX.why: Going-concern doubt leaves little room to finish the filing.

PBLS.datum: Aug 2026 release: FDA alignment on the registrational zolucatetide Phase 3 has not occurred and is expected Q4 2026, with Phase 3 start 1H 2027; ESMO oral uses a February data cut.
PBLS.why_underappreciated: Cross-trial 74% ORR draws attention; the unconfirmed Phase 3 design is overlooked.
PBLS.suggestion: Show the 74% desmoid ORR with larger n and longer follow-up and the proposed Phase 3 endpoint once FDA aligns, not a cross-trial comparison with nirogacestat.
PBLS.why: Phase 3 design is unconfirmed while valuation assumes it.

PLRX.datum: Updated PLN-101095 monotherapy Ph1 biomarkers (Q2 2026 PR): IFN-gamma, CXCL9 and granzyme-B rose in responding patients and in no non-responders; cash $159.6M, runway into 2H 2028.
PLRX.why_underappreciated: Focus is on n=16 response counts; a separating biomarker could enrich patients and is newer.
PLRX.suggestion: State whether FORTIFY will use early IFN-gamma, CXCL9 or granzyme-B rise to select or stratify patients, and report it with 2027 interim data.
PLRX.why: A usable biomarker would make small-n responses credible.

RADX.datum: Siemens Healthineers will manufacture and distribute F-18 RAD101 doses for the US Phase 3 (Aug 17 2026 announcement); Phase 3 readiness targeted year-end 2026 after the FDA end-of-Phase-2 meeting.
RADX.why_underappreciated: Manufacturing and distribution partnership lowers execution risk but draws little attention.
RADX.suggestion: After EOP2 minutes, convert Siemens' supply role into a commercial partnership and secure Phase 3 funding through licensing, since runway is short.
RADX.why: Supply is secured; pivotal-trial funding is not.
