ENTX.datum: Single ~750-woman placebo-controlled Phase 3, primary endpoint 12-month total hip BMD change (no fracture endpoint), 505(b)(2) bridge to Forteo; start late 2026, topline 2H 2028; funded into 2030 (Q2 2026 release).
ENTX.why_underappreciated: Debate centres on cash; BMD-only single-trial path and 2H 2028 topline are newer than models.
ENTX.suggestion: Disclose Phase 3 site activation and first-patient-dosed timing, and fully diluted shares including 11.8M pre-funded warrants, since topline is not until 2H 2028.
ENTX.why: Long gap to topline makes enrolment pace and dilution the checkable items.

FBIO.datum: 3,427,138 Series A 9.375% preferred outstanding (10-Q, Aug 10 2026) at $25 liquidation preference is ~$85.7M senior claim, ~$8.0M/yr dividends, versus $153.8M parent cash.
FBIO.why_underappreciated: Cash-over-market-cap headline ignores the senior preferred; net of it, parent cash roughly equals market cap.
FBIO.source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001429260/000110465926095964/fbio-20260630x10q.htm; $25 preference: 2020 Series A free writing prospectus
FBIO.suggestion: Publish a sum-of-the-parts net of the $85.7M Series A preferred and Oaktree note, and state whether PRV cash will redeem the preferred.
FBIO.why: Net-of-preferred value is the real discount to close.

IRON.datum: APOLLO (n=183) read out Oct 19 2026: dizziness in 50% on bitopertin (mostly mild/moderate), alongside PPIX -41.4% and +12.2 h/month pain-free light; discontinuations not reported.
IRON.why_underappreciated: Headline is 'success on all endpoints'; tolerability and dropouts sit in the release body.
IRON.suggestion: Present full APOLLO tolerability at a medical meeting: dizziness by severity, dose reductions, discontinuations and adolescent subgroup, before the year-end NDA resubmission.
IRON.why: Dizziness rate and discontinuations are the open question for label and uptake.

KMDA.datum: First three-year plasma supply agreement worth ~$50M, first sales Q4 2026, included in 2026 guidance of $200-205M revenue; Q2 2026 revenue $54.9M, +23% (Q2 6-K).
KMDA.why_underappreciated: Market frames Kamada as a failed inhaled-AAT story; contract line is newer than analyst models.
KMDA.suggestion: Disclose the plasma contract's annual volume, counterparty tenure and Texas collection capacity needed, and rank bolt-on hyperimmune targets against the $70M cash balance.
KMDA.why: Contract terms show whether plasma supply is a durable second leg.

KRRO.datum: ANCHOR first cohort dosed Oct 5 2026 at 2 mg/kg in healthy volunteers (up to 50, Australia; safety/PK only); UCD patient dosing starts 1H 2027, interim readout 2H 2027.
KRRO.why_underappreciated: "First human data" framing implies activity; release names only safety and PK, no ammonia or editing measure.
KRRO.suggestion: State which healthy-volunteer biomarkers (RNA editing in liver, ammonia challenge) will be reported from SAD/MAD in 2026, and the dose at which UCD patients start.
KRRO.why: Healthy-volunteer part may show target engagement; otherwise proof waits until 2H 2027.

MBX.datum: Ascendis YORVIPATH Q2 2026 revenue EUR 252M versus EUR 103M in Q2 2025, available in more than 35 countries with full reimbursement; canvuparatide Phase 3 started Aug 2026.
MBX.why_underappreciated: Analysts compare Phase 2 responder rates; incumbent's 2.4x revenue growth sets the access bar for a later entrant.
MBX.suggestion: Show weekly canvuparatide's composite-responder edge (calcium normal, no active vitamin D, supplements 600 mg/day or less) against YORVIPATH outcomes and payer value, since YORVIPATH is scaling fast.
MBX.why: Later entry needs a defined advantage over a scaling incumbent.

MNPR.datum: FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease designation to ALXN1840 on Jun 30 2026, allowing a pediatric priority review voucher on approval; rolling NDA began Jul 22, completion expected 'within the next few months'.
MNPR.why_underappreciated: Coverage focuses on pooled neuro data; the voucher is conditional on approval and newer than models.
MNPR.suggestion: Specify prespecified versus post hoc neurologic results and FDA's view of them, with a dated NDA completion target; the PRV depends on approval.
MNPR.why: Approval, not designation, unlocks the voucher; evidence level drives it.

MREO.datum: Despite missing the fracture-rate primary, FDA is open to alternative approaches to fracture analysis; Orbit/Cosmic showed significant BMD, vertebral-fracture and PRO gains; path update due by year-end 2026 (Q2 2026 release).
MREO.metric: FDA open to alternative fracture analysis
MREO.why_underappreciated: Market anchors on 'missed primary'; FDA flexibility and secondary wins are in a corporate-update paragraph.
MREO.suggestion: Disclose the alternative fracture analyses proposed to FDA and Ultragenyx's BLA stance by year-end, and date Sentynl's option decision, worth $40M against $30.1M cash.
MREO.why: FDA analysis acceptance decides whether setrusumab has any value left.

PLYX.datum: Cash $11.5M at Jun 30 2026 funds operations only through Q1 2027, with going-concern doubt; 49.8M shares; PIPE averaged $4.00/share; SOTERIA enrolment raised from 18 to 24 in July 2026.
PLYX.why_underappreciated: Dashboard cash of $3M is stale, but real runway still ends before any SOTERIA efficacy data.
PLYX.suggestion: Secure non-dilutive or partner funding for the enlarged 24-patient SOTERIA basket and publish its cost, since cash lasts only to Q1 2027.
PLYX.why: Going-concern language and larger trial make funding the binding constraint.

PRME.datum: FDA granted RMAT designation to PM359 (prime-edited CGD) on Jun 22 2026 on Phase 1/2 data, plus Fast Track and Orphan; Beam arbitration found no breach and no damages owed.
PRME.why_underappreciated: Valuation centres on Wilson PM577a; the CGD asset is labelled 'earlier' and RMAT is recent.
PRME.suggestion: Disclose PM359 patient numbers, DHR conversion data and the FDA-agreed registrational path, then use RMAT to seek non-dilutive funding before cash of $109M runs out in 2027.
PRME.why: RMAT asset may be nearer approval than Wilson; data shows it.

RARE.datum: FAYUVI priced at $3.95M and GENGLYCOS at $2.7M per patient (Sep 2026); company cites pre-approval Medicaid talks; Q2 2026 Crysvita royalties were $94M US/Canada plus $8M Europe.
RARE.why_underappreciated: Attention is on the Angelman miss; launch pricing and payer talks for two approvals are newer than models.
RARE.suggestion: Guide quarterly patient starts and payer approvals for FAYUVI and GENGLYCOS, since 2027 breakeven rests on launch uptake as much as Angelman cost cuts.
RARE.why: Launch pace at these prices drives breakeven more than cuts.

SEPN.datum: Observed human elimination half-life of SEP-479 is ~3-4 days in the Phase 1 SAD/MAD (company says it supports once-daily dosing); MAD extended to 14 days; data Q1 2027; cash $516.5M into 2029.
SEPN.why_underappreciated: Narrative is oral versus injectable; accumulation and calcium-overshoot risk of a long half-life is buried.
SEPN.suggestion: Disclose steady-state accumulation ratio and any serum calcium excursions from the 14-day MAD cohorts, and define the dose-interval choice, before the Q1 2027 data.
SEPN.why: A 3-4 day half-life makes daily dosing accumulate; safety margin is untested.

NERV.datum: MIN-101C19 Phase A: 12 weeks, n=380, roluperidone 64 mg vs placebo, primary Marder NSFS, key secondary PSP; Phase B 52-week active-controlled relapse study reads out 2H 2028. No SPA disclosed (Q2 2026 release).
NERV.why_underappreciated: Headline is 2H 2027 topline; the 2H 2028 Phase B and absent FDA agreement are in the details.
NERV.suggestion: State whether FDA agreed in writing that Phase A Marder NSFS plus PSP suffices for filing, or whether Phase B (2H 2028) must read out first.
NERV.why: Filing timeline sets whether $75.4M cash reaches an NDA.

NRXP.datum: Going-concern doubt in the 10-Q for June 30, 2026 despite $26.7M cash; warrant liabilities $18.6M (up from $12.3M); six-month net loss $17.95M; HOPE clinics revenue $2.17M.
NRXP.why_underappreciated: Fields show 4.1 quarters runway; filing's going-concern language and warrant liability are newer than models.
NRXP.suggestion: Disclose how KETAFREE launch and NDA filing are funded after the Nov 10 GDUFA date, and the terms of the warrants behind the $18.6M liability.
NRXP.why: Going-concern doubt makes funding terms the first thing to clarify.

RVPH.datum: Cash $19.9M at June 30, 2026 against 13.1M shares and a roughly $5M market cap; going-concern doubt; cash lasts into July 2027; delisted from Nasdaq to OTCQB May 14, 2026.
RVPH.why_underappreciated: Fields-only striking fact: cash is a multiple of market cap, masked by OTC delisting and going-concern label.
RVPH.suggestion: Seek a regional licensing or co-development partner to fund RECOVER-2 rather than equity raises, using the −10.1 point PANSS result at Day 28 as the pitch.
RVPH.why: Partner funding avoids dilution at a market cap below cash.

SPTX.datum: GlyphAllo healthy-volunteer driving simulation trial topline due 2H 2026, before BUOY-1 (1H 2027); cash $427.3M funds operations into 2029 (Q2 2026 release). Zurzuvae carries a driving-impairment warning.
SPTX.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on BUOY-1 placebo risk; this earlier safety readout tests differentiation versus Zurzuvae.
SPTX.suggestion: Publish the driving-simulation design, doses and comparator now; a clean result before BUOY-1 is the nearest evidence of differentiation from Zurzuvae.
SPTX.why: Nearest catalyst tests the one label feature rivals carry.

VNDA.datum: Fanapt Q2 2026 net sales $36.0M (+23%), TRx +31%, H1 $65.5M; BYSANTI data exclusivity to Feb 20, 2031. Cash $170.0M, company says funded through at least end 2027.
VNDA.why_underappreciated: Hetlioz down 66% dominates headlines; Fanapt growth and company runway guidance contradict burn narrative.
VNDA.suggestion: Disclose BYSANTI launch spend and the plan to move Fanapt patients to it; Q2 cash fell $32.3M, not $30M a month, so burn is the lesser issue.
VNDA.why: Fanapt base and cash guidance, not burn, drive launch economics.

VTGN.datum: PALISADE-4 (n=238) missed: difference 1.9, p=0.427. Post-hoc LSAS>=95 subgroup (n=123) p=0.036 rests on placebo change of -3.7 versus -11.4 overall, after excluding 21 patients (Jun 30, 2026).
VTGN.why_underappreciated: Subgroup headline is nominal; exclusions and placebo-response gap sit in footnotes.
VTGN.suggestion: Ask FDA whether a prespecified LSAS>=95 enrichment would be accepted, given the placebo gap and exclusions, before spending remaining $31.7M cash on a new Phase 3.
VTGN.why: Enrichment is only worth funding if FDA accepts the subgroup.

XBIT.datum: 150-patient randomized placebo-controlled Ph2 (400 mg SC weekly x16, ASAS40 at week 16) launched Jun 15 2026; no readout date given, so a Dec 2026 'first data' catalyst looks early.
XBIT.why_underappreciated: Catalyst date in our model precedes a 16-week treatment period just started.
XBIT.suggestion: Publish V-SPINE topline timing and prespecify an IL-1alpha/CRP-enriched subgroup analysis; use the cash above the $56M market cap for buybacks.
XBIT.why: Enrichment tests unvalidated IL-1 biology; cash exceeds market cap.

ZBIO.datum: FDA accepted the obexelimab IgG4-RD BLA in Aug 2026 with PDUFA May 27 2027, no priority review; approval unlocks $75M Royalty Pharma milestone and $75M Pharmakon debt.
ZBIO.why_underappreciated: Approval is about five months later than a Dec 2026 review catalyst implies.
ZBIO.suggestion: Set SLE Phase 3 go/no-go criteria before SunStone Phase 2 data in Q4 2026, and avoid further ATM sales near $27 ahead of the May 2027 PDUFA.
ZBIO.why: SunStone readout drives value; ATM dilution is optional with funding to Q2 2029.

ARMP.datum: Sep 23 2026 US Department of War added $3.7M, the first money specifically for AP-SA02 Phase 3; cumulative non-dilutive support is $32.4M, with trial size and total need undisclosed.
ARMP.why_underappreciated: Breakthrough headlines overshadow how little Phase 3 funding is actually committed.
ARMP.suggestion: Disclose Phase 3 trial size and total cost, then pursue pharma co-funding or ex-US partnership using Breakthrough status rather than discounted equity on about three quarters of runway.
ARMP.why: $3.7M covers little; funding gates Phase 3 start.

CRMD.datum: Medicare Advantage contracting is excluded from 2026 DefenCath guidance ($175-195M); management sees volume effect early 2027, while smaller dialysis providers show attrition. Q2 DefenCath sales $66.1M.
CRMD.why_underappreciated: Upside sits outside guidance; headlines focus on Melinta acquisition and total revenue.
CRMD.suggestion: Disclose DefenCath post-TDAPA unit price and Medicare Advantage contract timeline, with segment margins for DefenCath ($66.1M), Melinta ($35.8M) and REZZAYO.
CRMD.why: MA volumes and segment margins decide earnings power.

INVA.datum: Three customers accounted for 26%, 23% and 21% of first-half 2026 net product sales (about 70%); ZEVTERA sold only $0.35M in Q2 2026.
INVA.why_underappreciated: Buried in 10-Q notes while headlines stress 46% product-sales growth.
INVA.suggestion: Publish sum-of-parts with IST sales by customer and ZEVTERA trajectory, and prefer buybacks over new product spending until concentration eases.
INVA.why: Concentration and weak ZEVTERA sales widen holding-company discount.

MCRB.datum: Jul 8 2026: MSK trial of SER-155 in checkpoint-inhibitor enterocolitis, 12 of 15 (80%) immunosuppressive-free response at day 15, no related SAEs; single-arm.
MCRB.why_underappreciated: Secondary indication; headline story is the unfunded transplant Phase 2.
MCRB.suggestion: Offer SER-155 to checkpoint-inhibitor franchise holders on irEC data alongside the transplant Breakthrough package, seeking partner-funded Phase 2 before cash ends Q1 2027.
MCRB.why: Two indications widen partner pool; runway ends Q1 2027.

PYPD.datum: Azurity partnership (Jul 17 2026) paid $30M upfront and near-term milestones including $15M on NDA acceptance; PDUFA Nov 28 2026 under priority review, a quarter early.
PYPD.why_underappreciated: Deal postdates the Jun 30 balance sheet; royalty terms undisclosed.
PYPD.suggestion: Report pro forma cash including the $30M Azurity payments and disclose royalty and sales-milestone terms before the Nov 28 PDUFA; avoid raising equity on approval.
PYPD.why: $30M may not be in the $11M cash figure.

SCYX.datum: Q1 2026 private placement netted about $37.2M, with up to $52.2M more if warrants are exercised; shares outstanding rose to 62.1M from 43.5M (+43%).
SCYX.why_underappreciated: Dilution overhang sits behind headline EV below cash.
SCYX.suggestion: Disclose warrant strikes and expiries and report SCY-247 IV Phase 1 topline (guided Q3 2026); $52.2M potential proceeds exceed the $38M market cap.
SCYX.why: Warrant terms decide whether cash or dilution dominates.

VALN.datum: VALOR second prespecified analysis (from 1 day after dose 4) showed 74.8% efficacy, 95% CI 21.7-93.9, clearing the >20% bound; first analysis was 73.2%, CI 15.8-93.5.
VALN.why_underappreciated: Headlines say primary endpoint missed; second prespecified analysis cleared it.
VALN.suggestion: Ask Pfizer to disclose Lyme case counts and FDA feedback on the analysis 2 result before filing; extend runway via travel-vaccine financing.
VALN.why: Filing risk hinges on which analysis regulators accept.

ABUS.datum: Jul 2026: Arbutus and Genevant sued Pfizer and BioNTech over lipid nanoparticle patents in 21 countries; Arbutus owns about 16% of Genevant and expects a material Q3 dividend.
ABUS.why_underappreciated: Newer than models focused on Moderna cash and imdusiran.
ABUS.suggestion: Disclose litigation cost and timelines for the Pfizer/BioNTech suits, and size the $230M buyback after funding the FDA-agreed imdusiran Phase 2b design.
ABUS.why: Further patent income competes with buyback and trial funding.

ALGS.datum: B-SUPREME (n about 200, 48 weeks) primary endpoint is HBV DNA below 10 IU/mL versus tenofovir, not HBsAg loss; DSMB may re-estimate sample size at interims (Jan 21 2026).
ALGS.why_underappreciated: Functional-cure pitch contradicts a primary endpoint tenofovir already meets.
ALGS.suggestion: Prespecify HBsAg-decline thresholds as key secondaries and disclose interim analysis outcomes; seek partner funding because $55M cash covers about 2.4 quarters against a late-Q3 2027 topline.
ALGS.why: DNA parity wins little; partner needed before 2027 topline.

ASMB.datum: Sep 8 2026: Assembly opted into 40% of US development costs and profits for GS-1179/GS-5366; runway 'into 2029' relies partly on a $75M Gilead payment, cost-share impact unquantified.
ASMB.why_underappreciated: Opt-in cost burden not quantified against the runway guidance.
ASMB.suggestion: Quantify the 40% US cost share by year and its effect on the 2029 runway, and state whether Phase 2 includes the HIV PrEP combination.
ASMB.why: Opt-in costs could erode runway; undisclosed.

AMLX.datum: LUCIDITY Ph3 (Aug 18 2026): 55% fewer Level 2/3 events, p=0.000003, but only 78 Roux-en-Y patients, 90 mg daily, 16 weeks; arm event rates and secondary-endpoint numbers undisclosed.
AMLX.why_underappreciated: Headline quotes 55%; small single-surgery population and undisclosed absolute rates shape label breadth.
AMLX.suggestion: Publish absolute event rates and Level 3 data before the year-end NDA, request priority review citing Breakthrough designation, and partner ex-US PBH rights while retaining US sales.
AMLX.why: Label breadth hinges on undisclosed rates and non-bypass patients.

AMPH.datum: Q2 2026 BAQSIMI net sales $45.5M (-3%): lower net price cut sales about $8.1M, volume added about $6.9M. Contract-year sales hit $175.0M, triggering the $100.0M Lilly payment due Q3.
AMPH.why_underappreciated: Headline is declining sales; price-driven erosion offset by volume gains is in the bridge, and Lilly payment follows.
AMPH.suggestion: Report BAQSIMI gross-to-net by channel (340B, rebates, chargebacks) and the timing of the insulin biosimilar and ANDA filings; show post-Lilly-payment cash and debt paydown plan.
AMPH.why: Separates price erosion from volume and shows liquidity after the $100M payment.

BMEA.datum: COVALENT-111 52-week (ATTD, Mar 14 2026): efficacy set was 163 of 267 dosed; severe insulin-deficient subgroup only n=10, HbA1c -1.2% at Wk52 (p=0.01); Arm B n=6, -1.5%.
BMEA.why_underappreciated: Durability headline rests on tiny exploratory subgroup, the exact population COVALENT-211 now tests.
BMEA.suggestion: Fund through COVALENT-211 topline (Q1 2027) with a non-dilutive option or regional deal rather than another discounted raise; the n=10 subgroup signal limits leverage, so pursue before data.
BMEA.why: Runway into Q2 2027 against a binary Q1 readout; subgroup basis is thin.

GUTS.datum: REMAIN-1 pivotal 6-month topline (Oct 16 2026): regain 5.1% Revita vs 8.2% sham (p=0.0023, N=308); post hoc ablation >=20 cm 3.8% (n=47) vs 12-18 cm 4.7%; no device-related SAEs.
GUTS.why_underappreciated: Dose-dependence is post hoc and below the headline; the topline already published, unlike supplied fields.
GUTS.suggestion: Use the ablation-length dose response to define the labeled technique in the De Novo submission, and report 12-month durability and Medicare pass-through status against resuming a GLP-1.
GUTS.why: Topline is out; submission design and reimbursement now drive value.

PLX.datum: H1 2026 net income $22.1M includes a one-time $25.0M Chiesi milestone (EU E4W approval); Q2 net income was $3.8M. 2026 Elfabrio sales guidance $33-35M, Elelyso $20-23M.
PLX.why_underappreciated: Reported profitability is milestone-driven; underlying quarterly profit is far smaller than the H1 headline implies.
PLX.suggestion: Report earnings excluding milestones and Elfabrio quarterly sales against the $33-35M guide; disclose PRX-115 Phase 1 anti-drug antibody rate beside Krystexxa before RELEASE data in 2H27.
PLX.why: Shows true run-rate profit supporting PRX-115 funding.

PTN.datum: BMT-801 Ph2 (n=96 randomized, 8 weeks): combo 4.4% vs placebo 1.6% weight loss (primary vs placebo); vs tirzepatide alone only >=5% loss 40% vs 27%, >=7% p<0.1; nausea rates not reported.
PTN.why_underappreciated: Primary endpoint compared with placebo; benefit over tirzepatide alone is modest and tolerability unreported.
PTN.suggestion: Release combination versus tirzepatide-alone mean weight loss and nausea rates before seeking a BMT-801 partner; with $7.5M cash, pair any licensing with immediate bridge financing for IND work.
PTN.why: Partner interest depends on unreported tirzepatide-alone and tolerability data.

RDY.datum: Jul 9 2026 BSE filing: semaglutide batches out of spec from an API impurity; supply unavailable in India and disrupted in Canada until at least late October. Aspen's Canadian launch depends on RDY API.
RDY.why_underappreciated: Market focus is Nov launch; the API impurity also constrains partner Aspen's Canadian launch.
RDY.suggestion: Disclose the API root cause, remediation, and restart date, plus volume committed to Aspen and Canada versus India, before quantifying Nov launch markets and margin.
RDY.why: Launch volume depends on API fix; partner supply is exposed.

RYTM.datum: IMCIVREE >400 acquired hypothalamic obesity start forms from ~300 prescribers by Jun 30 2026 (3.5 months after Mar 19 approval); Q2 revenue $71.3M, +19% sequentially, US $51.0M.
RYTM.why_underappreciated: Launch uptake sits in a Q2 release while debate centers on the EMANATE failure.
RYTM.suggestion: Report HO patients on therapy, conversion from start forms, persistence and net price, split from genetic indications, with bivamelagon Phase 3 start by year-end.
RYTM.why: Converts start-form enthusiasm into measurable revenue durability.

RZLT.datum: upLIFT interim (Jun 2 2026): 6/8 responders (>=50% IV glucose cut); one non-responder died in hospice; planned n=16, single-arm, open-label; release states FDA alignment only for congenital HI.
RZLT.why_underappreciated: Topline rests on 16 patients; no stated FDA agreement on tumor-HI endpoint, and sunRIZE review has no timeline.
RZLT.suggestion: Before the mid-Dec topline, request a Type B meeting to confirm single-arm n=16 supports a tumor-HI BLA, and ask about priority review voucher eligibility.
RZLT.why: FDA acceptance of tiny single-arm data is unconfirmed.

VERU.datum: Novo Nordisk's June 2026 PLATEAU clinical supply agreement is terminable for convenience on 60 days' notice, no financial terms disclosed; cash $23.9M at Jun 30 2026.
VERU.why_underappreciated: Collaboration headline reads as partner validation; the filing shows no commitment and no payments.
VERU.suggestion: Secure an alternate semaglutide supply or comparator source and disclose Novo agreement terms; reaffirm 32-week DXA interim (Q1 2027) funding with $23.9M cash.
VERU.why: PLATEAU depends on semaglutide supply that Novo can end quickly.

VOGX.datum: Key PBH Ph2 (VGX-001-012, n=15): glucose nadir +18.0 mg/dL (p=0.028) in the 9 hypoglycemic on placebo; -7.97 (p=0.24) in 9 others; two Ph2s total 24 patients; EMERGE is startup, 'subject to funding'.
VOGX.why_underappreciated: Underlying evidence is small crossover dosing with 7-day periods, while valuation implies Phase 3-like confidence.
VOGX.suggestion: Enrich EMERGE for patients with documented Level 2/3 events and CGM nadir below 70 mg/dL, and fund the trial before adding GIP-dependent Cushing's.
VOGX.why: Effect concentrated in hypoglycemic patients; enrichment raises odds.

ALT.datum: RECLAIM Ph2 AUD (n=100, 24 weeks) met primary on heavy drinking days (Aug 12 2026 8-K) but no effect size or p-value released; EOP2 meeting not yet requested.
ALT.why_underappreciated: Market treats AUD as positive, yet magnitude and FDA registrational path are unquantified.
ALT.suggestion: Disclose RECLAIM effect size, p-values and safety at a meeting, request the AUD end-of-Phase 2 meeting, and consider partnering so value does not rest on 2029 MASH.
ALT.why: Quantified AUD data are needed to price or partner the indication.

SPRB.datum: Feb 18 2026 Type B: FDA wants one drug-product PPQ batch at BLA submission, second batch's data before midcycle; PPQ delayed BLA to Q4 2026, and confirmatory study starts during review.
SPRB.metric: FDA PPQ batch requirement gates BLA
SPRB.why_underappreciated: Headline is cognition data; manufacturing validation, not the comparator, now sets filing timing.
SPRB.suggestion: Disclose PPQ batch completion dates and confirmatory-study design before the Q4 2026 BLA; PRV request secondary. Cash $96M covers about 6 quarters.
SPRB.why: PPQ batches, not comparator, now gate filing date.

XERS.datum: Keveyis (Q2 revenue $11.7M, +2%) received USPTO Notice of Allowance for a patent extending protection to at least 2039 (Aug 6 2026 release).
XERS.why_underappreciated: Buried in earnings release; narrative focuses on Recorlev growth and XP-8121.
XERS.suggestion: Report Recorlev ($56.8M, +81%), Gvoke ($22.5M, -4%) and Keveyis ($11.7M) as separate profit pools, with Keveyis exclusivity dates, so investors value each.
XERS.why: Gvoke is shrinking while Recorlev grows; blended view hides both.

ZVRA.datum: Q2 2026: EAP net reimbursements were $9.0M from 132 EAP patients, against only 14 new MIPLYFFA enrollment forms (184 cumulative); EAP is about 23% of $39.7M revenue (my calc).
ZVRA.why_underappreciated: Revenue acceleration headlines mask EAP dependence; EU CHMP negative opinion could affect EAP.
ZVRA.suggestion: At the Nov 3 print, separate commercial new starts and persistence from EAP reimbursements, and state when EAP patients convert to paid supply.
ZVRA.why: EAP is about 23% of revenue; 14 enrollments per quarter.

BNTC.datum: Oct 5 2026: FDA asked for additional data including from Benitec's existing OPMD Natural History Study; data to FDA 'in coming weeks'; pivotal design final Q1 2027, enrollment mid-2027.
BNTC.why_underappreciated: Request is for data already held, not a new study; newer than most models.
BNTC.suggestion: Submit the existing natural-history data to FDA now and publish how matched controls compare with the treated patients' baseline, to lock the single-arm design by Q1 2027.
BNTC.why: Natural-history study already exists; speed of submission sets design date.

CAPR.datum: Aug 24 2026: FDA extended PDUFA from Aug 22 to Nov 22 as a major amendment; Capricor filed 24-month HOPE-3 open-label data and robustness analyses for an upper-limb indication.
CAPR.why_underappreciated: Adcom 9-3 was on cardiomyopathy; FDA now reviewing new data for narrower claim.
CAPR.suggestion: Before Nov 22, disclose FDA feedback on the upper-limb label and whether 24-month open-label data satisfy the prior adcom concerns on fragility and missing data.
CAPR.why: Narrowed indication plus new data changes the review beyond adcom.

CPIX.datum: Apotex paid $100M cash for the branded portfolio; Cumberland kept ifetroban (FIGHT-DMD +5.4% LVEF, Fast Track Feb 2026) while market cap ($74M) sits below ~$90M cash.
CPIX.why_underappreciated: Brand sale converted an operating company into cash-backed pipeline; fields-only, EV is negative.
CPIX.suggestion: After the Type B meeting, publish the agreed Phase 3 design and cost, and seek a co-development partner, since 3.5 quarters of runway cannot fund it.
CPIX.why: Phase 3 cost versus runway decides whether a partner is needed.

DYN.datum: DM1 asset z-basivarsen: 71-patient registrational expansion enrolled June 2026, topline Q1 2027, accelerated-approval BLA Q3 2027, launch H1 2028 (Q2 2026 release); DMD PDUFA Jan 21 2027.
DYN.why_underappreciated: Market frames DM1 as option; filing timeline is within 12 months.
DYN.suggestion: Disclose the FDA-agreed DM1 surrogate endpoint and success threshold for the Q1 2027 readout, and note cash funds operations only into Q2 2028.
DYN.why: DM1 readout lands before DMD launch settles; thresholds undisclosed.

KROS.datum: Rinvatercept Phase 2 in DMD is an open-label multi-cohort basket trial; primary endpoint is safety/tolerability, efficacy only secondary; first data H1 2027, cash $257.6M funds into H1 2028.
KROS.why_underappreciated: Called a binary efficacy readout, yet design cannot give controlled efficacy proof.
KROS.suggestion: Pre-specify which body-composition and function secondaries count as success, and the controls used, before H1 2027 data; open-label basket results alone will not support Phase 3 value.
KROS.why: Uncontrolled safety-primary readout limits what H1 2027 can prove.

MSLE.datum: BASECAMP Ph2 (1:1:1, 60mg/120mg/placebo, 12-week placebo-controlled then 36-week active); primary safety and dynamometry muscle force; topline moved to Q1 2027 to compile a fuller dataset.
MSLE.why_underappreciated: Market cites open-label Ph1b grip gains; this randomized readout is the real test.
MSLE.suggestion: Pre-state the 12-week placebo-controlled dynamometry effect size that counts as success, and secure non-dilutive funding before topline; cash $61.8M runs through 2027.
MSLE.why: Randomized 12-week comparison, not open-label grip data, decides value.

PEPG.datum: Mar 2026 FDA partial hold on FREEDOM2-DM1 cites only preclinical pharmacology/toxicology questions, none about Phase 1 clinical data; no U.S. patients enrolled, dosing 10 mg/kg in UK and Canada.
PEPG.metric: Hold is preclinical-only; no US patients
PEPG.why_underappreciated: Hold seen as clinical overhang; actual issue is preclinical, resolution date undisclosed.
PEPG.suggestion: Disclose the hold-resolution timeline and tox study response, plus 10 mg/kg splicing and vHOT versus placebo; partner before 5.9 quarters of cash forces dilution.
PEPG.why: Hold gates US enrollment; resolution date is unknown.

RGNX.datum: AbbVie paid $100M milestone (received July 2026) on sura-vec diabetic retinopathy trial start; wet AMD pivotal topline Q4 2026; royalty monetization liability $181.5M at Jun 30 2026.
RGNX.why_underappreciated: DMD dominates coverage; partnered sura-vec readout and royalty liability drive more value.
RGNX.suggestion: Disclose remaining sura-vec milestones and royalty terms, and confirm RGX-202 BLA initiation; runway into Q4 2027 excludes partner milestones and trails 2H27 approval.
RGNX.why: Partner milestones and royalty liability sit outside DMD narrative.

SLDB.datum: March 2026 financing issued 14.9M shares plus 27.8M pre-funded warrants ($226M net); cash $377.7M at Jun 30 2026, runway to mid-2028; fully diluted ~155M shares versus ~107M basic.
SLDB.why_underappreciated: Basic-share market cap understates dilution; secondary summary, cash exceeds stale field.
SLDB.suggestion: Seek written FDA agreement on whether SGT-003 micro-dystrophin (~100% at Day 360) supports accelerated approval, and report valuation on fully diluted shares.
SLDB.why: Per-share value must use ~155M fully diluted shares.

NSRX.datum: The Phase 2 behind the 1.69 vs 3.47 min T100 headline enrolled only 12 patients and was not powered for significance; the pivotal plan costs $18-22M against about $15M cash (20-F, Mar 2026).
NSRX.why_underappreciated: Headline speed comparison overshadows the tiny sample and funding gap, both in 20-F footnotes.
NSRX.suggestion: Disclose FDA agreement on the pivotal protocol and the 505(b)(2) bridge to EpiPen before the Q4 start, and line up funding for the $18-22M plan.
NSRX.why: Protocol must be agreed with FDA first; cash covers only through Q2 2027.

NTLA.datum: Intellia says the highest liver transaminase elevations on nex-z occurred in patients carrying one specific HLA allele; it will share HLA genotyping with investigators and enrolled patients (Q2 2026 release; enrollment reinitiated).
NTLA.metric: HLA allele linked to liver enzymes
NTLA.why_underappreciated: Buried in the Q2 business update; implies a screenable, not random, liver risk.
NTLA.suggestion: Publish the HLA allele frequency and the genotype-screening rule for nex-z, plus any FDA alignment, so investors can size the risk and the nex-z option.
NTLA.why: Quantifies whether nex-z liver risk is screenable.

PHVS.datum: Deucrictibant XR prophylaxis NDA is planned only for 1H 2027 (Sep 2026 CHAPTER-3 release), after the Apr 23 2027 on-demand PDUFA, so prophylaxis revenue is unlikely before 2028.
PHVS.why_underappreciated: Headline 83% attack reduction draws attention; the NDA date sits in forward-looking text.
PHVS.suggestion: Pull the XR NDA forward toward the on-demand PDUFA, or add an ex-US partner for XR to extend the 7.4-quarter runway without dilution.
PHVS.why: Earlier two-indication launch lifts peak sales and cuts dilution.

SPRY.datum: Q2 2026 partner supply revenue was $7.4M of $33.7M total revenue (22%), alongside $26.2M US neffy net product sales; US sales of $26.2M still hold only about 5% share (Q2 release).
SPRY.why_underappreciated: Analysts track US payer wins; ex-US partner supply is a separate, steadier line.
SPRY.suggestion: Show US, partner supply and cash-pay revenue separately, and consider partnering the CSU Ph2b to protect the 2.7-quarter runway on the path to breakeven.
SPRY.why: Runway and breakeven matter more than a speculative second indication.

BHVN.datum: Ono license (Oct 8 2026): $80M upfront plus $20M near-term milestone and about 20% royalty for BHV-1300, BHV-1310, BHV-1320 in Japan, Korea, Taiwan, ASEAN; US, Europe, China retained.
BHVN.why_underappreciated: Newer than analyst models; upfront equals about 30% of $268M cash and BHV-1300 Asia is already taken.
BHVN.suggestion: Seek a similar partner for BHV-1300 in Europe or China, the rights Ono did not take, to fund the Phase 3 given 3.1 quarters of runway.
BHVN.why: Non-dilutive cash addresses runway and going-concern language.

IMVT.datum: Argenx's two Phase 3 efgartigimod Graves' studies (VitaliThy, about 230 patients each) started Jun-Jul 2026; study 3002 primary completion is June 2028, versus Immunovant Graves' registrational topline guided for 2027.
IMVT.why_underappreciated: Contradicts the 'no timing edge' view; registry dates show a possible one-year lead.
IMVT.suggestion: Prioritize Graves' enrollment speed to protect the lead over efgartigimod, and defer CIDP and Sjogren's start-up until the 2027 readouts if budgets allow.
IMVT.why: Lead is worth protecting; no Phase 3 efficacy exists yet.

IPSC.datum: Cash and investments of $197.2M at Jun 30 2026 (funds operations into 1Q 2029) against a $64M enterprise value, with IND due 4Q 2026 and first clinical data 2H 2027.
IPSC.why_underappreciated: Fields-only but striking: EV is a third of cash and funds past first human data.
IPSC.suggestion: Submit the IND in Q4 and disclose the first-in-human design; with cash into 1Q 2029, any partnering can wait for human data.
IPSC.why: Cash outlasts first clinical data, so partnering from strength is possible.

MNKD.datum: Q2 2026 Afrezza net sales fell 7% to $17.0M while FUROSCIX added $22.2M; total revenue $109.4M (+43%), with term loan $319.1M and royalty-sale liability $147.8M (Q2 8-K).
MNKD.why_underappreciated: Pediatric-label enthusiasm hides that Afrezza is shrinking and FUROSCIX is the larger product.
MNKD.suggestion: Report Afrezza pediatric uptake and prescription trends separately from FUROSCIX and royalties so investors can see whether the May 2026 label reverses the decline.
MNKD.why: Afrezza trend decides the sum-of-parts value.

SABS.datum: Phase 3 PRISE-hATG (NCT07670650): 108 patients aged 5-40 in new-onset, recent-onset and up-to-2-year-established T1D cohorts, primary endpoint 12-month stimulated C-peptide; Breakthrough T1D grant-funded.
SABS.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on SAFEGUARD new-onset; this extends use to established T1D with outside funding.
SABS.suggestion: Disclose the SAFEGUARD primary endpoint and FDA alignment, and show how PRISE-hATG cohorts feed a label covering established T1D, noting the n=4 super-responder limit.
SABS.why: Endpoint and FDA alignment are missing from the release.

SANA.datum: As of the Q2 2026 release, SC451 still needs to finish GLP toxicology, transfer manufacturing to a contract manufacturer and prepare clinical sites before the IND, guided 'as early as this year'.
SANA.why_underappreciated: Attention is on 14-month UP421 data; IND steps are in guidance text, not milestones.
SANA.suggestion: Give a dated SC451 IND timeline as GLP toxicology and manufacturing transfer finish, and pursue partner funding since runway ends mid-2027, before any Ph1/2 data.
SANA.why: Open IND steps plus mid-2027 runway raise dilution risk.

VRDN.datum: Amgen's subcutaneous Tepezza on-body injector (every 2 weeks x12) hit 76.7% proptosis responders vs 19.6% placebo at Week 24 (Apr 2026 Phase 3), above elegrobart's 54% monthly in REVEAL-1.
VRDN.why_underappreciated: Market prices elegrobart as the SC edge; Amgen's SC data erode that differentiation.
VRDN.suggestion: Lead the elegrobart BLA with the Q8W regimen (63% responders, lower hearing impairment) and, at the Nov 4 print, report LUMVOA chronic versus active mix.
VRDN.why: Differentiation now rests on chronic label and dosing convenience.

VTVT.datum: CATT1 randomized 166 adults, all using CGM, to cadisegliatin 800 mg daily, 800 mg twice daily or placebo for six months; primary endpoint level 2/3 hypoglycemia; DKA is a secondary; topline mid-2027 (Oct 5 2026).
VTVT.why_underappreciated: Readout slipped from 2H 2026; design tests benefit on top of CGM, answering the main threat.
VTVT.suggestion: Pre-specify the DKA analysis and use the Ph2a hybrid closed-loop study to show hypoglycemia benefit on top of automated insulin delivery.
VTVT.why: DKA safety and closed-loop benefit determine commercial role.

ANRO.datum: ALTO-207's strongest efficacy evidence is Oxford's PAX-D pramipexole-alone trial (Cohen's d 0.87 at 12 wks); the May 13 2026 release names no selection biomarker for the ~178-patient Ph2b.
ANRO.why_underappreciated: Pitch sells EEG precision selection; the release only describes the platform, not an ALTO-207 biomarker.
ANRO.suggestion: Name the ALTO-207 selection biomarker and its prospective cutoff in the Ph2b/Ph3 design, and confirm it with FDA before the early-2027 Ph3 start.
ANRO.why: The biomarker rule is the unproven part of the case.

AYTU.datum: EXXUA scripts rose 138% (1,398 to 3,323) Q3 to Q4 FY26 but net revenue only 63% ($2.4M to $3.9M): net revenue per script fell about 32% (own calculation). Gross-to-net 'still evolving'.
AYTU.why_underappreciated: Headlines cite script growth; revenue per script and gross-to-net are undisclosed.
AYTU.suggestion: At FQ1 results (Nov 13) report EXXUA gross-to-net, net revenue per script, refills and payer coverage alongside script counts.
AYTU.why: Price realization decides whether script growth becomes revenue.

CING.datum: The Jun 2 2026 CRL (PDUFA May 31) cites only CMC information requests at an unnamed manufacturing partner; no inspection findings, no clinical concerns, and no resubmission class or date disclosed.
CING.why_underappreciated: Market reads CRL as rejection; the wording points to a document fix, but timing is unstated.
CING.suggestion: State the resubmission date and class (2- or 6-month review) and the open CMC items; line up non-dilutive funding, since cash covers about 3.5 quarters.
CING.why: Review clock length and funding set time to launch.

COLL.datum: AZSTARYS prescriptions grew only 1.9% year on year in Q2 2026 (revenue $12.9M for May 12-Jun 30), while FY guidance was raised to $65-75M; JORNAY PM scripts +13.1%.
COLL.why_underappreciated: Headline is the JORNAY PM +41% growth and the guidance raise, not flat acquired-asset scripts.
COLL.suggestion: Publish a net-debt bridge ($1.09B debt, about $962M net) and AZSTARYS monthly scripts against the $65-75M guide so growth and deleveraging can be tracked.
COLL.why: Flat scripts must support the raised guide and debt paydown.

DFTX.datum: Definium's Q2 2026 release lists DEA or state rescheduling of lysergide as a risk that could affect US marketing; the three positive Ph3s do not remove this step.
DFTX.why_underappreciated: Headlines focus on Ph3 wins and Breakthrough status; scheduling timing sits in risk factors.
DFTX.suggestion: Open DEA scheduling talks now and state the expected timeline from NDA approval to launch alongside the rolling NDA and REMS plan.
DFTX.why: Launch date depends on DEA action after approval.

GHRS.datum: In July 2026 FDA written responses said GH001's CMC and device plans 'appear Phase 3 ready' (hold lifted Jan 5 2026); FDA agreement on pivotal design is not yet confirmed.
GHRS.why_underappreciated: Market still prices IND/CMC overhang; the remaining open item is design, not manufacturing.
GHRS.suggestion: Announce FDA agreement on the pivotal design (replicating Ph2b) with a Ph3 start month; CMC and device are already cleared.
GHRS.why: Design alignment is the last gate to Ph3 start.

HELP.datum: HLP003 NDA is guided to 'potentially' 2028 because second pivotal EMBRACE is still enrolling; APPROACH topline (Q4 2026) alone does not support filing. Cash $166M versus $148M FY26 net loss.
HELP.why_underappreciated: Market treats Q4 APPROACH as the filing event; the second Ph3 and funding gap are less visible.
HELP.suggestion: Disclose EMBRACE enrollment pace and funding to reach a 2028 NDA, plus how APPROACH handles functional unblinding, before the Q4 topline.
HELP.why: Second pivotal and funding gate the filing, not APPROACH.

INDV.datum: The $1.0B aggregate special dividend (about 24% of market cap) is funded by a $650M Citi term loan plus cash; pro forma net debt about $878M, leverage below 1x (Aug 3 2026).
INDV.why_underappreciated: Dividend is read as a cash windfall; funding comes mainly from new debt, with fixed 1.5401 exchange ratio.
INDV.suggestion: Disclose term loan pricing and post-close paydown targets, and SUBLOCADE trend versus Brixadi, since the dividend is mostly debt-funded.
INDV.why: Debt-funded payout makes deleveraging pace the key check.

LBRX.datum: NOVA-1 Day 28 placebo-adjusted PANSS fell 5.0 (50 mg, d=0.61) and 4.7 points (75 mg, d=0.41), with average placebo-adjusted weight gain of 2 kg.
LBRX.why_underappreciated: Headline is 'positive Ph2' and faster NOVA-2; modest effect size and weight gain undercut the tolerability pitch.
LBRX.suggestion: Prespecify weight, prolactin and EPS endpoints in NOVA-2 and publish full NOVA-1 metabolic data; a 2 kg gain weakens the tolerability case.
LBRX.why: Tolerability, not efficacy, must justify entry against generics.

LPCN.datum: In the failed Ph3, about 40% of LPCN 1154-treated patients at one high-enrolling site had no detectable drug in blood; excluding the site, symptoms improved rapidly (exploratory, Sep 14 2026).
LPCN.why_underappreciated: Market sees an ITT miss and subgroup salvage; the one-site exposure failure is buried in exploratory analyses.
LPCN.suggestion: Publish the site-excluded effect size and PK data, and show BLOOM exposure checks at every site; then seek a partner.
LPCN.why: Credible miss explanation is needed before BLOOM data.

MPLT.datum: Only 210/3 mg BID hit the ZEPHYR primary (PANSS -6.0, p=0.002, d=0.37 mITT); the 330/6 mg QD arm missed significance. TEAEs 74.7% vs 48.1% placebo (Jul 27 2026).
MPLT.metric: One of two doses hit primary
MPLT.why_underappreciated: 'Hit primary' headline hides the failed second dose and a 26-point adverse event gap.
MPLT.suggestion: Explain at EOP2 why the QD arm missed, lock the Ph3 dose, and disclose GI adverse event rates versus Cobenfy.
MPLT.why: Dose choice and tolerability decide Ph3 design and edge.

NBIX.datum: CRENESSITY Q2 2026 net sales were $184M (+247% from $53M) with about 80% of dispensed scripts reimbursed; INGREZZA guidance was raised to $2.825-2.875B.
NBIX.why_underappreciated: Valuation conversation centers on INGREZZA and the depression pipeline, not a second commercial growth leg.
NBIX.suggestion: Report CRENESSITY patients on therapy and persistence, and frame osavampator Ph3 (2027 readout) against adjunctive standards of care.
NBIX.why: Second growth leg and pipeline both need clearer disclosure.

AVLN.datum: PureTech ELEVATE-IPF Ph2b (Aug 20, 2026): deupirfenidone 825 mg cut 26-week FVC decline 91 mL vs placebo (P=.02); oral pirfenidone 61 mL (P=.13); GI events 53% vs 52%.
AVLN.why_underappreciated: Buried in a rival's Ph2b; shows the oral pirfenidone GI burden Avalyn must beat.
AVLN.suggestion: Report MIST GI adverse-event and discontinuation rates against the ~52% GI and 17.5% discontinuation seen with oral pirfenidone in ELEVATE-IPF, plus systemic exposure versus oral.
AVLN.why: Tolerability is the measurable edge over generics.

CTNM.datum: PIPE-791 PET trial (Sep 18, 2025; 12 healthy volunteers, 4 PrMS): lung occupancy not measurable, brain occupancy used as surrogate; over 90% trough coverage at planned Ph2 doses is a company projection.
CTNM.metric: PET occupancy is a brain surrogate
CTNM.why_underappreciated: Headlined as positive PET data; lung occupancy was never measured.
CTNM.suggestion: Publish the exposure-response and dose-selection analysis supporting PROPEL-IPF doses, including lung-tissue exposure data, since lung occupancy was inferred from brain PET in 16 subjects.
CTNM.why: Lung-dose rationale rests on a brain surrogate.

EDSA.datum: Cash was $10.3M at Jun 30, 2026 (10-Q), not $33M; nine-month net loss $11.9M; going-concern doubt stated; $3.5M private placement June 2026. Cap $36M implies EV near $26M, not $3M.
EDSA.why_underappreciated: Supplied cash of $33M is wrong; filing shows going-concern language and under 30% cash/cap.
EDSA.suggestion: Prioritize a partner or non-dilutive grant for the registrational ARDS trial; $10.3M cash and going-concern language leave little time to use the 24% vs 33% mortality data.
EDSA.why: Runway, not data, is the binding constraint.

INKT.datum: Q2 2026 release: randomized ALI/ARDS Ph2 (NCT07615010) dosing only in Lviv, Ukraine; sample size and primary endpoint undisclosed; data now 'early 2027', not 2H 2026; cash $8.8M at Jun 30.
INKT.why_underappreciated: Screens still show 2H 2026; trial size and endpoint are undisclosed.
INKT.suggestion: Disclose the ARDS trial's sample size, primary endpoint and readout date, and fund through early 2027; $8.8M cash at about $2.1M quarterly operating burn is thin.
INKT.why: Undisclosed design leaves the catalyst unvalued.

INSM.datum: Q2 2026 call: about 7,000 new Brinsupri patient starts in Q2, guided flat at about 7,000 per quarter for the rest of 2026; 'ready and waiting' backlog exhausted; 26,350 starts since launch.
INSM.why_underappreciated: Q/q revenue growth of 49% masks flat new starts after backlog cleared.
INSM.suggestion: Disclose patients on therapy, persistence rates and the new-start trend into 2027, since flat 7,000 quarterly starts imply growth now depends on retention and prescriber depth.
INSM.why: Growth now hinges on retention, not backlog.

IXHL.datum: RePOSA Ph2: AHI reduction over 50% in only 13.9% (low dose) and 14.7% (high dose); over 30% in 33.3% and 41.2% (FY2026 10-K).
IXHL.why_underappreciated: Headline is up to 83% AHI reduction; responder rates are far lower.
IXHL.suggestion: Use DReAMzz to show a dose lifting over-50% AHI responders well above 15%, and seek a partner for the 440-patient Ph3.
IXHL.why: Responder rate decides competitiveness against the leader.

RNTX.datum: 12.2M Series X preferred convertible into 12.23M common (85.8M outstanding), 4.5M warrants at $1.00-$1.50 exercisable from Oct 27, 2026; cash $43.6M funds into Q1 2028 (10-Q, Jun 2026).
RNTX.why_underappreciated: Buried in note disclosures; screens show basic shares only.
RNTX.suggestion: Disclose RENEW interim design (n, endpoints, timing) and the conversion schedule for preferred and warrants before the Q4 2026 interim, so investors can size dilution against the readout.
RNTX.why: Dilution schedule is needed to value the interim.

SION.datum: SION-719 Ph2a miss (-1.0 mmol/L, p=0.7, Aug 10, 2026) came from a 15-patient, 14-day crossover; company cites high variability and Trikafta exposure differences between periods and is assessing impact.
SION.why_underappreciated: Market reads mechanism failure; the release itself discloses design confounders.
SION.suggestion: Decide by the Q3 report: run SION-451+SION-2222 in a larger Ph2a with controlled Trikafta exposure, or return capital, since $268M cash exceeds the $175M market cap.
SION.why: Cash exceeds cap; confounded miss keeps combo option.

TRVI.datum: LAKE Ph2b (refractory cough) sample-size re-estimation due Q4 2026, topline 2H 2027; OCEAN-2 (12-week) topline 2H 2027, OCEAN-1 (52-week) 1H 2028; cash $318.9M funds into 2030 excluding launch.
TRVI.why_underappreciated: Interim sizing event and 1H 2028 pivotal date missing from screens.
TRVI.suggestion: Disclose LAKE re-estimation criteria and OCEAN sample sizes and endpoints; the Q4 2026 sizing decision is the nearest event, and OCEAN-1 now reads out 1H 2028.
TRVI.why: Nearest catalyst is a sizing decision, not efficacy.

UTHR.datum: Q2 2026: nebulized Tyvaso, the formulation in the IPF NDA, fell 18% to $126.0M; Tyvaso DPI rose 4% to $326.6M; total Tyvaso fell 4%; DPI IPF filing follows later.
UTHR.why_underappreciated: IPF filing is for nebulized, the declining formulation; DPI IPF comes later.
UTHR.suggestion: Give the Tyvaso DPI IPF filing timeline and nebulized-to-DPI patient mix, since the April 2027 IPF action covers only the shrinking nebulized product.
UTHR.why: IPF sizing depends on DPI, not nebulized.

VCRE.datum: ASPIRE Ph2b enrolled over 360 patients (completed Apr 2026) vs about 270 planned at Sept 2024 start; 52-week randomized, 100 and 50 mg BID vs placebo; topline mid-2027.
VCRE.why_underappreciated: Original plan was about 270; the upsizing sits in filings, not headlines.
VCRE.suggestion: Publish ASPIRE's statistical analysis plan, including the FVC effect size the 360-patient trial can detect, and the AIR external-control match criteria.
VCRE.why: Power clarity lets investors judge the mid-2027 readout.

AARD.datum: Cash and short-term investments were $73.9M at Jun 30, 2026 (down from $91.2M in March), runway into late 2027, vs about $28M market cap; HERO/OLE unblinded review, next steps promised Q3 2026.
AARD.why_underappreciated: Fields carry March cash; June filing is lower but still 2.6x market cap.
AARD.suggestion: Publish the unblinded HERO and QRS findings with the promised next-step decision, and return cash if ARD-101 cannot resume; $73.9M exceeds the $28M cap.
AARD.why: Cash well above market cap; decision pending.

ACIU.datum: 25 treated vs 9 placebo in VacSYn Part 1 (wk-100, Sep 23 2026); CSF antibody and total alpha-syn signals are qualitative, no NfL result; FDA Part 2 meetings only early 2027.
ACIU.why_underappreciated: Headline is 100% responders; tiny n, no quantitative CSF or NfL numbers disclosed.
ACIU.suggestion: Release CSF antibody titers and NfL for the 25 treated patients, and take a clinically powered Part 2 to FDA in early 2027 with a partner lined up.
ACIU.why: Quantified biomarkers de-risk Part 2 and partnering.

ACOG.datum: Q2 2026 ZUNVEYL revenue $6.04M (+71% QoQ), 94% gross margin, 1,347 prescribers; but contracted payer book only ~16% of lives; cash fell to $41.4M from $66.0M.
ACOG.why_underappreciated: Market anchors on generic donepezil; Q2 coverage ramp and margin are newer than models.
ACOG.suggestion: Sign further Part D PBM contracts to lift covered lives above 16% and report persistence by facility, so growth reaches 2027 profitability before the $41.4M cash runs down.
ACOG.why: Coverage, not demand, is the stated growth limiter.

ALEC.datum: Oct 2026 Genentech AL050 license: $100M upfront, up to $1.17B milestones, royalties; Alector says runway now extends into 2029 and it keeps the ABC platform.
ALEC.why_underappreciated: Models still carry ~4-quarter runway; cash plus upfront exceeds market cap.
ALEC.suggestion: Spend the upfront only on AL137 to multi-cohort Alzheimer's data and ABC platform work; seek a second ABC platform partner after first-in-human.
ALEC.why: Focus extends runway and proves the platform.

ANVS.datum: Phase 3 (n=850, pTau217+) gives a 6-month symptomatic topline in Q1 2027 but the 18-month disease-modifying readout only in Q1 2028; cash ~$14M, under one quarter of runway.
ANVS.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on near-term enrollment news, not the year-long gap to the pivotal readout.
ANVS.suggestion: Secure funding to reach the Q1 2027 readout, and state which primary endpoint (ADAS-Cog13 or ADCS-iADL) carries the 6-month and 18-month analyses.
ANVS.why: Cash ends long before the 2028 readout.

ARVN.datum: Rigel vepdegestrant license (May 11 2026): $70M upfront, up to $320M milestones, mid-teens to mid-20s% royalties, all split evenly with Pfizer; Arvinas booked a $50M approval milestone in Q2.
ARVN.why_underappreciated: Royalty and milestone stream is a secondary asset beside the LRRK2 story and sits inside the cash.
ARVN.suggestion: Use the $568M cash plus Rigel receipts to start an ARV-102 Phase 2 in LRRK2 carriers, and seek a CNS partner only on terms above current cash value.
ARVN.why: Cash and royalties cover the burn; mechanism proof is the gap.

ATHE.datum: FDA EOP2 minutes: one ~200-patient, 12-month, 50 mg-only pivotal trial (11-item UMSARS I) plus Phase 2 as confirmatory evidence can support approval; no committed Phase 3 funding.
ATHE.why_underappreciated: Imaging miss and 75 mg failure dominate the story; FDA still accepts Phase 2 as confirmatory.
ATHE.suggestion: Close a partner or structured funding for the single 200-patient 50 mg pivotal trial using FDA's confirmatory-evidence statement; the company reports talks with several pharma companies.
ATHE.why: Funding is the only gate to a Phase 3 start.

AVXL.datum: Rett Phase 3 (RS-005, ~170 adults, 16-week double-blind) is moving forward; blarcamesine holds FDA Orphan, Rare Pediatric Disease and Fast Track designations; cash $118.3M, runway to mid-late FY2028.
AVXL.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on the failed EU Alzheimer's filing; the Rett program is a separate, defined path.
AVXL.suggestion: File the overdue 10-Qs, appoint a permanent CEO, and start Rett RS-005 with FDA-agreed pediatric inclusion before spending on a new Alzheimer's Phase 3.
AVXL.why: Rett has a nearer, designated path than Alzheimer's.

AXSM.datum: Auvelity new-to-brand prescriptions in patients 65+ rose 126% in first eight weeks after the June 2026 AD agitation launch; payer coverage 89% of lives; Q2 Auvelity sales $180.3M (+51%).
AXSM.why_underappreciated: Launch uptake is only eight weeks old and sits beside a large, mature MDD base.
AXSM.suggestion: Report AD agitation prescriptions, persistence and discontinuation separately from MDD at Q3 results on Nov 2, to show the launch adds to the $180M quarterly base.
AXSM.why: Launch split is not yet disclosed.

CGTX.datum: Cash $34.8M (Jun 30 2026) plus $21.6M of remaining NIA grant funds; runway into Q4 2027 versus mid-2027 Phase 3 start with an improved tablet formulation.
CGTX.why_underappreciated: Models use cash alone; $21.6M undrawn grant is newer than the five-quarter runway figure.
CGTX.suggestion: Agree the Phase 3 endpoint with FDA, then sign a partner before mid-2027 so the improved tablet trial starts without relying on the NIA grant alone.
CGTX.why: Grant extends time, not Phase 3 cost.

COYA.datum: ALSTARS fully enrolled (120, 1:1:1 two regimens vs placebo) Oct 5 2026; primary is Week-24 ALSFRS-R change; topline early Q2 2027, later than a Q1 2027 model date.
COYA.why_underappreciated: Catalyst dates in models predate the 24-week primary and enrollment completion.
COYA.suggestion: State the statistical plan for two dose regimens versus placebo on Week-24 ALSFRS-R, including multiplicity handling, before topline in early Q2 2027.

CRVO.datum: RewinD-LB Ph2b (n=159) primary endpoint result attributed by company to Alzheimer's co-pathology and an underperforming drug batch; low-pTau181 subgroup CDR-SB +0.70 vs placebo (p=0.054).
CRVO.why_underappreciated: Headline 54% risk-reduction figure rests on exploratory analyses, not the primary endpoint.
CRVO.suggestion: Design the 50 mg TID Phase 3 to enrich for low plasma pTau181 and confirm trough exposure; show partners this plan before cash runs out in Q3 2027.
CRVO.why: Enrichment is the credible path after the primary miss.

DSGN.datum: The +6.4 mFARS improvement comes from 4 patients at 1 mpk, single-arm with no placebo; 3 patients had transient ALT elevations; 16 treated in total (May 2026).
DSGN.metric: mFARS gain from n=4, no placebo
DSGN.why_underappreciated: Valuation rests on a within-patient change in four patients; liver signal is minor in coverage.
DSGN.suggestion: Show 12-week mFARS against FA natural-history controls with per-patient ALT data, and propose a placebo-controlled registrational design in the Q4 2026 update.
DSGN.why: Four-patient single-arm data underpin the valuation.

YARW.datum: GenSci's China Phase 1 of YB-101 (GS-098) in thyroid eye disease showed dose-dependent early responses (no numbers); TED MAD data and Graves Ph2a (~32 pts, 24 wks) both due 2H 2027 (Jul 27 2026).
YARW.why_underappreciated: Market prices Graves only; TED evidence comes from a China partner, described qualitatively.
YARW.suggestion: Publish GenSci's quantitative Phase 1 TED and Graves data (TRAb, thyroid hormones, proptosis) before 2H 2027. The Ph2a is blinded, so partner data are the only efficacy evidence.
YARW.why: Only human efficacy evidence until 2H 2027 is unquantified.

ACET.datum: FDA aligned on a single-arm pivotal in lupus nephritis patients failing 2+ immunosuppressants: double-digit patients, primary endpoint complete renal response at 12 months, start-up Q4 2026 (Sep 28 2026 release).
ACET.why_underappreciated: Headline is Ph1 remission rates; a small, cheap registrational path is buried in the pivotal paragraph.
ACET.suggestion: Cost out the single-arm pivotal and pair it with a partner or non-dilutive funding, since cash was guided only into 2H 2027; disclose lymphodepletion regimen and infection detail.
ACET.why: Cheap registrational path, but runway ends before a 12-month CRR readout.

AUPH.datum: Teva settled the voclosporin ANDA case Aug 19 2026: generic launch no earlier than Dec 7 2036; patents run to Dec 2037. Five other ANDA litigations (DifGen, Dr. Reddy's, Hikma, Sandoz, Zydus) remain open.
AUPH.why_underappreciated: Patent settlement is not in the revenue or buyback story; five other ANDA suits remain unresolved.
AUPH.suggestion: Settle the five remaining ANDA cases on Teva-like terms and disclose entry dates, to fix LUPKYNIS exclusivity into the mid-2030s that underwrites the $2.3B market cap.
AUPH.why: Five open ANDA suits are the remaining exclusivity risk.

CLYM.datum: Budoprutug 200 mg cohort gave only 74% CD20 B-cell suppression at week 4 (vs 98% at 600 mg); high-proteinuria patients (median UPCR 6.8 g/g) clear drug 2x faster (Oct 24 2026).
CLYM.why_underappreciated: Headline 38% week-12 remission came from the 200 mg cohort; 600 mg effect is not yet reported.
CLYM.suggestion: Report 600 mg and 1000 mg week-12 immunologic remission and PLA2R reduction first; hold the rituximab-refractory cohort until dose is set, since proteinuric patients clear drug faster.
CLYM.why: Remission was seen at a dose giving 74% depletion; higher doses unreported.

JBIO.datum: JADE101 half-life 24.2 days at 700 mg (32 healthy volunteers, cutoff Apr 14 2026) vs reported 9.3 days sibeprenlimab and 2.8 days povetacicept; >90% free-APRIL suppression for median 85 days.
JBIO.why_underappreciated: Market sees a late anti-APRIL entrant; PK edge is healthy-volunteer, company cross-study comparison, not yet in patients.
JBIO.suggestion: In JUNIPER interim, report free-APRIL suppression and IgA by dosing interval alongside proteinuria, to show whether the 24-day half-life supports every-12-week maintenance versus atacicept.
JBIO.why: PK edge needs patient confirmation of every-12-week dosing.

NKTX.datum: ACR abstracts 0903, 1179, 2938 (Nov 8-11 2026): patients receive fludarabine plus cyclophosphamide (cyclophosphamide alone if cytopenic) before a 3-dose NKX019 cycle, so the regimen is not conditioning-free.
NKTX.why_underappreciated: Pitch frames NKX019 as no-chemo CAR-NK; the lymphodepletion regimen sits in the trial design text.
NKTX.suggestion: At ACR, show per-patient responses, B-cell depletion depth and duration, the lymphodepletion regimen and cytopenia rates. Drop any no-chemo claim; compare with CAR-T on outpatient feasibility.
NKTX.why: Differentiation versus CAR-T hinges on conditioning burden.

TVTX.datum: FSGS label (Apr 13 2026) covers only patients without nephrotic syndrome, ages 8+, under a liver-safety REMS; DUPLEX eGFR in that group was -11.3 vs -12.4 mL/min (1.1 difference, no p-value).
TVTX.why_underappreciated: 'First and only FSGS drug' headline and 30,000+ addressable pool ignore the nephrotic exclusion and REMS monitoring.
TVTX.suggestion: Split the 2,012 Q2 start forms between IgAN and FSGS, and report FSGS starts by nephrotic status and REMS-related discontinuations, to test the 30,000-patient addressable estimate.
TVTX.why: Label excludes nephrotic FSGS, which may shrink the addressable pool.

VERA.datum: ORIGIN 3 two-year: 11 progression events on Trutakna vs 38 on placebo; annualized eGFR decline 0.6 vs 5.6 mL/min/1.73m2; no dialysis, transplant or death vs 8 on placebo (Sep 15 2026).
VERA.why_underappreciated: Launch debate centers on proteinuria and orals; near-normal eGFR slope is newer than analyst models.
VERA.suggestion: File the full-approval sBLA in Q4 headlining the eGFR slope, and fund the launch from the debt facility (up to $425M available) rather than discounted equity.
VERA.why: Cash was $499M against $207M six-month operating cash use.

ATYR.datum: New Ph3 (FDA aligned Sep 24 2026): up to ~372 patients, 5.0 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for 17 doses, FVC week 48 primary; company says it needs additional capital; cites only subgroup FVC benefit.
ATYR.why_underappreciated: FDA alignment reads as de-risking; the FVC effect size is unquantified and subgroup-derived.
ATYR.suggestion: Secure a partner or non-dilutive funding before enrolling the 372-patient FVC trial; if none arrives, return capital, because the company itself says the trial needs additional capital.
ATYR.why: Subgroup-derived retry needs outside funding; cash is $59M.

CNTB.datum: Seabreeze STAT COPD (n=159): FEV1 at week 4 improved only 70 mL vs placebo, p=0.1607, not significant, despite 81% fewer 28-day treatment failures (p=0.0122); single dose (Sep 30 2026).
CNTB.why_underappreciated: Headline is 81% and 100% reductions; the FEV1 miss sits in the secondary endpoints.
CNTB.suggestion: Seek a Phase 3 partner after the FDA meeting and ask FDA to accept 28-day treatment failure as primary endpoint, since FEV1 missed; deprioritize asthma given the miss.
CNTB.why: FEV1 miss makes endpoint agreement the key gate; runway is under three quarters.

GENB.datum: ClinicalTrials.gov lists SOLAIRIA-1 (NCT07276724) at 786 patients, primary endpoint annualized exacerbation rate over 52 weeks, estimated primary completion Dec 2028, versus company topline guidance of 2H 2027.
GENB.why_underappreciated: Models use the 2H 2027 topline; the registry's estimated completion date sits a year later.
GENB.suggestion: Clarify SOLAIRIA-1 and -2 topline timing against the registry's Dec 2028 completion, and disclose the dose and eosinophil entry criteria, since cash lasts only into 1H 2028.
GENB.why: Cash lasts into 1H 2028; timing gap decides financing need.

SVRA.datum: FDA extended the molgramostim review three months on Apr 15 2026 after a major amendment from information-request responses; PDUFA now Nov 22 2026. Prior filing drew a 2025 refuse-to-file for CMC data.
SVRA.why_underappreciated: Efficacy is clean, so the market treats approval as safe; manufacturing history and the slip get little weight.
SVRA.suggestion: Before Nov 22, disclose manufacturing inspection status and CMC readiness; the review already slipped three months and an earlier filing drew a CMC refuse-to-file.
SVRA.why: Approval risk now sits in manufacturing, not efficacy.

SLBT.datum: H1 2026 (to Jun 30): revenue $1.39M, net loss $2.16M; GDT glioblastoma orphan-designation request DRU-2026-11528 only submitted, not granted; CD19 pre-IND still gated by FDA feedback.
SLBT.why_underappreciated: Headlines say FDA 'submission'; skim readers may infer progress; request needs no efficacy evidence.
SLBT.suggestion: Report the ODD decision and GLP animal tox plan together; split skincare/exosome margins from oncology R&D. Until then, treat cell-therapy claims as unevidenced.
SLBT.why: Credibility needs a decision and animal data

ALNY.datum: Q2 2026: underlying US TTR demand rose $129M q/q, masked by a $21M inventory drag; collaboration and royalty revenue guidance raised $150M at midpoint to $575-625M, offsetting part of the TTR cut.
ALNY.why_underappreciated: Headline is the TTR guidance cut; demand growth and royalty raise sit in call detail.
ALNY.suggestion: Disclose Amvuttra ATTR-CM patients on therapy and persistence, plus gross-to-net trend, to show demand outruns the mid-single-digit US net price decline.
ALNY.why: Patient counts are undisclosed; guidance cut hides demand

BBIO.datum: Three FDA actions inside 12 months: BBP-418 priority review, PDUFA Nov 27 2026, no adcom planned; encaleret priority review, PDUFA May 8 2027; oral infigratinib NDA filed, US launch targeted mid-2027.
BBIO.why_underappreciated: Coverage centers on Attruby sales; encaleret and achondroplasia filings are newer than most models.
BBIO.suggestion: Give BBP-418, encaleret and infigratinib launch-readiness and pricing plans, and say how the $879M deferred royalty obligation scales with Attruby sales.
BBIO.why: Three near-term launches dilute Attruby dependence

BRVE.datum: Partner Hengrui's Phase 2 oHCM study (n=42): 86% complete response at week 12, post-Valsalva LVOT gradient under 30 mmHg by day 5; two transient LVEF<50% in extension (S-1, 2026).
BRVE.why_underappreciated: Field text says efficacy data pending; China-run data in the S-1 already show activity.
BRVE.suggestion: Present Hengrui study 201 and 202 patient-level LVEF, PK and drug-interaction data, and state what the ex-China Phase 2 adds beyond them.
BRVE.why: Existing China data frame the US trial's value

CYTK.datum: MYQORZO patients dispensed rose to about 1,500 at end of Q2 2026 from about 400 at end of Q1; about 2,000 prescriptions written, over 80% of dispensed paid; Q2 revenue was only $25.3M.
CYTK.why_underappreciated: Q2 revenue reflects a patient base built mostly late in quarter; REMS and prior-authorization lag hides it.
CYTK.suggestion: Report REMS-to-dispense conversion time and the roughly 500 prescription backlog before Q3, and tie MAPLE-HCM label changes to lighter monitoring.
CYTK.why: Patient base is nearly 4x quarter-start; revenue lags

EWTX.datum: CIRRUS-HCM part D is open-label: 53 patients (20 oHCM, 33 nHCM), 12 weeks; two new-onset atrial fibrillation events (3.8%); no mean LVOT-G or LVEF values disclosed.
EWTX.why_underappreciated: 'Positive' headline hides no placebo arm, no absolute LVOT-G values and AF events.
EWTX.suggestion: Publish absolute LVOT-G, LVEF and atrial fibrillation details by dose, and make Phase 3 randomized and placebo-controlled in both oHCM and nHCM with LVEF safety pre-specified.
EWTX.why: Open-label n=53 needs absolute values before Phase 3

GLUE.datum: GFORCE-1 (Oct 1 2026): hsCRP median -85% in subjects with elevated CV risk (not established ASCVD); interim 4-week dosing, 24 completers, 94% reached hsCRP <2 mg/L, median baseline 6.3 mg/L.
GLUE.why_underappreciated: Headline CRP drop comes from short dosing in at-risk subjects, not residual-risk ASCVD patients.
GLUE.suggestion: Show hsCRP response in patients with ASCVD or gout and durability beyond four weeks; use it to partner before the Phase 2 starts.
GLUE.why: CRP effect not yet shown in target patients

GOSS.datum: Jul 27 2026: Chiesi collaboration terminated, worldwide seralutinib rights back; Chiesi pays $5M, keeps capped royalty plus milestones; cash about $57M (Jun 30); $181.1M of $200M 2027 notes swapped to $65.2M secured notes plus equity/warrants.
GOSS.why_underappreciated: Fields cite a Chiesi funding tranche; the release shows the partner left and debt was restructured.
GOSS.suggestion: Clarify which financing the $125M tranche belongs to now that Chiesi has left, and give runway through a Q3 2027 approval decision.
GOSS.why: Partner exit and debt swap change funding picture

HUMA.datum: V012 interim (n=80 women): infection rate 6 vs 23 per 100 patient-years for ATEV versus AV fistula, alongside 91 more catheter-free days (p=0.0007); dialysis sBLA planned 2H 2026.
HUMA.why_underappreciated: Catheter-free days dominate headlines; infection rate, a cost driver for payers, sits in the release.
HUMA.suggestion: Quantify dialysis-access cost savings from fewer infections for payers, and use V012 plus V007 to seek a dialysis partner before the sBLA.
HUMA.why: Infection savings support pricing and a partner deal

IKT.datum: IMPROVE-PAH Part A (n~140) is judged on week-24 pulmonary vascular resistance; 6-minute walk, the usual approval endpoint, is only the Part B primary (n~346); Phase 1 was in healthy volunteers.
IKT.why_underappreciated: Interim readout is hemodynamic, not functional; many assume it is an efficacy proof.
IKT.suggestion: State the Part A PVR threshold that triggers Part B and the sample-size re-estimation rules, and publish imatinib prodrug tolerability and exposure data.
IKT.why: Part A is not a pivotal test

KARD.datum: Phase 2a danicamtiv (open-label, n=41, 5-8 day periods): LVEF +8.8% in MYH7 (p=0.001), +5.9% TTN (p=0.005), +4.4% other causes (not significant); no serious adverse events (HFSA, Sep 2025).
KARD.why_underappreciated: Benefit concentrates in genetic subgroups; non-genetic cohort missed, so genotype selection drives Phase 3.
KARD.suggestion: Confirm KINSHIP-DCM stratifies MYH7 and TTN and powers each subgroup, and report longer-term LVEF, troponin and safety beyond the 5-8 day exposures.

LGVN.datum: ELPIS II secondary: MACE 8 events standard of care vs 1 on laromestrocel (p=0.043); total major cardiac events 22 vs 3 (rate ratio 0.16), despite missed RVEF primary and FDA saying RVEF alone is insufficient.
LGVN.why_underappreciated: Buried behind the missed RVEF primary; secondary, small trial (n=40), unadjusted for multiplicity.
LGVN.suggestion: Take MACE and event data to FDA to test a clinical-event endpoint for HLHS; otherwise out-license the Alzheimer's asset and stop HLHS spending.
LGVN.why: MACE signal is the only HLHS path with FDA

VIR.datum: ECLIPSE 3, the bulevirtide head-to-head, is a Phase 2b in bulevirtide-naive patients meant to support access and reimbursement; Phase 3 ECLIPSE 2 (bulevirtide non-suppressors switching) reads out Q1 2027 (Aug 5, 2026 release).
VIR.why_underappreciated: Market treats ECLIPSE 3 as a Phase 3 head-to-head win; it is a smaller Phase 2b.
VIR.suggestion: Guide ECLIPSE 3 endpoints and powering, and ECLIPSE 2 switch criteria, before ECLIPSE 1 reads out, so investors separate registrational evidence from access-supporting head-to-head data.
VIR.why: Sets expectations on which trial supports label versus reimbursement.

VXRT.datum: Dynavax oral COVID vaccine license (Nov 2025): $25M upfront, $50M due after Phase 2b results, up to $195M regulatory and $425M sales milestones, low-to-mid-teens royalties; market cap about $97M.
VXRT.why_underappreciated: Partner payments sit in the COVID program; the headline story is the norovirus pill.
VXRT.suggestion: Disclose Dynavax's Phase 2b readout timing, which triggers $50M, and tie norovirus Ph2b funding to that payment instead of an equity raise.
VXRT.why: Links a dated cash inflow to norovirus funding.

AKBA.datum: VOICE interim (n=2,116, Jun 2026): Vafseo beat ESA on mortality-plus-hospitalization hierarchical composite, win odds 1.16 (95% CI 1.06-1.28; p=0.0016), driven by fewer hospitalizations.
AKBA.why_underappreciated: Headline says 'safety'; the benefit is hospitalization reduction, relevant to bundled payment.
AKBA.suggestion: Present VOICE hospitalization reduction at a medical meeting before TDAPA ends 12/31/26, quantify savings for dialysis operators, and disclose refinancing terms.
AKBA.why: Hospitalization savings support volume as the TDAPA price reset hits.

ELOX.datum: Cash was $62.0M at Jun 30, 2026 (vs $4.8M Dec 2025) after a $66.0M gross raise at $11.00; no debt; runway guided to mid-2028, against a $54M market cap in our fields.
ELOX.why_underappreciated: Our fields show $6M cash and under two quarters of runway; the raise is newer.
ELOX.suggestion: Disclose EXACT Ph2b size, endpoints and powering, which the Q2 release omits; funded to mid-2028, the 2027 16-week readout is the key test.
ELOX.why: Cash risk removed; trial design now drives value.

MAZE.datum: Diabetic AMKD weak class-wide: inaxaplin UACR -17.3% (CI -36.3 to +7.2, n=14, Sep 2026); MZE829 diabetics 2 of 5 evaluable reached 30% cut; its 61.8% FSGS result rests on at most 5 patients.
MAZE.why_underappreciated: Inaxaplin's 43% comparator came from a mostly non-FSGS cohort; broad AMKD includes weak diabetics.
MAZE.suggestion: Report HORIZON uACR by FSGS, non-diabetic and diabetic cohorts with n and CIs, and size the pivotal on non-diabetic AMKD (48.6%) rather than the broad 35.6% label.
MAZE.why: Pivotal population choice drives probability of success.

MENS.datum: FDA declined (May 2024) to agree a new protocol without full API-2 CMC and a comparability plan; Jyong filed both Oct 16, 2024, and its FY2025 20-F reports no FDA feedback or demonstrated comparability.
MENS.why_underappreciated: Buried in 20-F risk factors; the headline is a 2029-2030 NDA target.
MENS.suggestion: Obtain written FDA feedback on the Oct 2024 API-1/API-2 comparability package and disclose it; no approval path or financing is credible until FDA agrees a confirmatory study.
MENS.why: Approval path depends on FDA agreeing comparability and a study.

PROK.datum: FDA Type B alignment (Jul 2025): eGFR-slope benefit of at least 1.5 mL/min/1.73m2/yr vs sham supports accelerated approval; ~320-patient cohort enrolled, topline Q2 2027; cash $181.6M funds to mid-2027.
PROK.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on runway, not the explicit 1.5 bar versus Ph2's 4.6 open-label gain.
PROK.suggestion: Raise or partner before PROACT 1 topline: cash fell $43M in Q2 to $181.6M and funds only to mid-2027; also disclose how the 1.5 mL/yr bar is powered.
PROK.why: Runway ends near readout; powering versus the bar decides accelerated approval.

TLPH.datum: FDA agreed to cut NEPHRO CRRT to 70 patients; 75% enrolled at Aug 12, 2026, completion by year-end 2026; primary endpoint post-filter ACT vs placebo over 24h; cash $17.1M at Jun 30.
TLPH.why_underappreciated: Pivotal completion is nearer than our mid-2027 catalyst date implies; funding gap remains.
TLPH.suggestion: Pre-fund the NEPHRO close-out and NDA with partner or non-dilutive capital now: $17.1M cash against year-end 2026 completion, and disclose the success threshold for filter ACT.
TLPH.why: Funding and success-threshold clarity are the open items before topline.

UNCY.datum: Resubmission accepted Oct 21, 2026 (Class II), PDUFA Mar 25, 2027; new drug-product vendor last FDA-inspected Mar 2024 (No Action Indicated); original vendor, cited after second CRL, not re-inspected.
UNCY.why_underappreciated: Newer than our Mar 29 date; approval no longer rests on the vendor that failed.
UNCY.suggestion: Disclose whether FDA plans a pre-approval inspection of the new vendor and the original vendor's inspection date.
UNCY.why: Inspection plans are the remaining approval risk.

BHC.datum: Larsucosterol Phase 3 (NCT07428538) is already recruiting: 350 patients, 84 sites, single 30 mg IV dose vs placebo, primary transplant-free survival at Day 90 (listing updated Jul 22, 2026).
BHC.why_underappreciated: Our fields say Phase 3 is still being planned; the registry shows active recruitment.
BHC.suggestion: Disclose Phase 3 enrollment pace and whether the Day-90 endpoint was powered on the AHFIRM US subgroup; value remains mostly Xifaxan and debt.
BHC.why: Minor asset; design transparency is cheap.

APMD.datum: LunAIRo (n=660) 26-week AHI -46.8% vs -6.8% placebo, about 40-point net effect; NDA and Q2 2026 releases give no discontinuation rates (PDUFA Feb 28, 2027).
APMD.why_underappreciated: Net-of-placebo effect is smaller than the -55.6% headline; dropout rates are undisclosed.
APMD.suggestion: Publish LunAIRo discontinuation rates for dry mouth and insomnia and net-of-placebo AHI before the Feb 28, 2027 PDUFA, so payers see tolerability against a ~40-point effect.
APMD.why: Tolerability, not efficacy, is the open launch question.

ARCT.datum: Aug 2026: CSL Seqirus sa-mRNA deal terminated; Arcturus regains global KOSTAIVE, flu, RSV and EBV rights, receives $12M cash, drops ~$16M R&D credit liability; Q2 collaboration revenue $0.9M vs $24.5M.
ARCT.why_underappreciated: Headline is ARCT-032's mixed data; rights reversion adds partnerable assets.
ARCT.suggestion: Seek a new KOSTAIVE partner outside Japan to fund ARCT-032 Phase 3; make the Q4 2026 go decision depend on cohort 4 (10 mg, 12-week) data.
ARCT.why: Rights reversion funds Phase 3 without self-funding a low-PoS trial.

KLRA.datum: Hengrui Ph3 T2D (NCT06649344): ribupatide 4 mg cut HbA1c 2.78% vs 2.29% semaglutide 1 mg, statistically superior; first ex-China Ph1 showed similar exposure in Asian and non-Asian participants (Kailera Q2 2026 release).
KLRA.why_underappreciated: Partner China data sit outside Kailera's own trials; market focuses on obesity magnitude.
KLRA.suggestion: Prioritise the U.S. Ph2b (264 patients, 10-20 mg, 48 weeks, data mid-2027) as the bridging readout; disclose interim safety and dose-response earlier.
KLRA.why: Ex-China dose-response is what makes partner data transferable.

MDGL.datum: F4c MAESTRO-NASH OUTCOMES now guided to read out in 2027 with no date or event count; F2-F3 MAESTRO-NASH in 2028 (Q2 2026 call, Jul 30 2026).
MDGL.why_underappreciated: Catalyst is dated Dec 2026 in our fields; management gave no date.
MDGL.suggestion: Disclose the OUTCOMES event count and expected event-accrual timing so investors can date the cirrhosis readout; pair with GLP-1 co-use data from the 49,000-patient base.
MDGL.why: Cirrhosis catalyst is later and less dated than assumed.

NAMS.datum: PREVAIL interim: event target expected by end-2026 but DSMB review in Q1 2027; stopping needs significance on both 4-point and 3-point MACE, else trial runs to end-2027 (Aug 2026 call).
NAMS.why_underappreciated: Fields list 4Q26 interim; dual-endpoint stopping bar and DSMB timing are buried.
NAMS.suggestion: Guide that the DSMB interim review falls in Q1 2027, and disclose the event target and stopping rule; continuation to end-2027 is the likely outcome.
NAMS.why: Interim is later and harder to pass than the 4Q26 label implies.

RANI.datum: Chugai deal (up to $1.085B, Oct 2025) covers a rare-disease antibody, not RT-114, with upfront undisclosed; Q2 2026 contract revenue was $1.7M and cash $53.4M funds 'at least through 2027'.
RANI.why_underappreciated: Headline $1.085B is mostly milestones on a different asset; current revenue is small.
RANI.suggestion: Disclose Chugai upfront and milestone amounts, and show the Ph1b obesity study (start end-2026, data 2027) is funded beyond the 'at least through 2027' runway.
RANI.why: Deal value overstates funding for the obesity asset.

SCTX.datum: Single 0.75 mg/kg STX-1150 dose cut LDL-C over 50% in primates, sustained two years; Australian TGA notification and ethics clearance for first-in-human obtained (IPO prospectus, 2026).
