SCTX.why_underappreciated: Prospectus detail; fields call it preclinical with undisclosed timing and no durability evidence.
SCTX.suggestion: Disclose the first-in-human start date, cohort design and when PCSK9 and LDL-C readouts arrive; the two-year primate durability already differentiates.
SCTX.why: Human dosing is cleared, so timing is the missing fact.

VANI.datum: SLIM-1 is a 4-week trial of 20 people (10 NPM-139, 10 Wegovy 0.25 mg) built for safety and PK (weight change also measured); Novo agreement (Jul 7 2026) is non-exclusive, no terms.
VANI.why_underappreciated: Topline headline will read as efficacy; the design is four weeks at low dose.
VANI.suggestion: Frame SLIM-1 as PK and safety only, and secure committed financing or a Novo option before the November topline; $20.8M cash covers about three quarters.
VANI.why: Topline cannot show efficacy, so financing needs its own catalyst.

VKTX.datum: VANQUISH-1/2 (78 weeks, about 5,500 patients) complete in 2027, extensions report 2028; oral SUNRISE Ph3 (two trials of 560, 27.5-55 mg, 68 weeks) is set (Q3 2026 8-K).
VKTX.why_underappreciated: Fields say no topline date guided; 2027 completion is a nearer catalyst than assumed.
VKTX.suggestion: Guide the VANQUISH topline quarter and report discontinuation rates from Ph2 and the maintenance study; both are missing and decide comparison with tirzepatide.
VKTX.why: Dated topline and tolerability decide the tirzepatide comparison.

ASND.datum: Aug 2026 binding term sheet with BioMarin: Ascendis pays royalties on YUVIWEL net sales, 20% US and 18% EU, South Korea, Brazil, through May 20 2030; all litigation dismissed.
ASND.why_underappreciated: Settlement royalty is absent from the launch-ramp narrative and margin models.
ASND.suggestion: Disclose definitive-agreement terms and any upfront payment, and show YUVIWEL net margin after the 20% and 18% royalty so peak-sales models reflect real economics.
ASND.why: Royalty cuts YUVIWEL profit through May 2030.

BEAM.datum: BEAM-302 60 mg: Part B total AAT 13.5 uM replicated Part A 14.4 uM, but infusion reactions hit 41% and one liver-disease patient had Grade 3 ALT/AST rise (ERS, Sep 2026).
BEAM.why_underappreciated: Headline is efficacy replication; liver-safety detail sits in secondary text while pivotal enrols liver disease.
BEAM.suggestion: Pre-specify and disclose liver-safety monitoring and a stopping rule for the pivotal AATD cohort, and report ALT/AST in patients with liver disease.
BEAM.why: FDA may not agree; liver safety is the open issue.

BMRN.datum: About 90% of US VOXZOGO patients stayed on therapy through July 2026 despite a February rival launch; under 100 switched in six months; most new starts are age 2 and under (Q2 call).
BMRN.why_underappreciated: Market fears YUVIWEL erosion; call detail shows little switching and a young-start niche.
BMRN.suggestion: Quantify expected YUVIWEL royalty income under the Ascendis term sheet and report switching and new-start share quarterly, so the competitor becomes a revenue line.
BMRN.why: Retention and royalty offset the competitive threat.

CUVL.datum: FDA issued a complete response letter on Feb 13 2026 for Disc's bitopertin in EPP (PPIX biomarker not tied to sunlight endpoints); APOLLO Ph3 topline Q4 2026, decision hoped mid-2027.
CUVL.why_underappreciated: Fields still call bitopertin an emerging threat; approval cannot come before mid-2027.
CUVL.suggestion: Disclose US patient and reorder retention and a dated vitiligo Phase 3 plan, using the window before bitopertin could be approved, no earlier than mid-2027.
CUVL.why: Competitive window is longer than the field implies.

DNLI.datum: DNL593 (FTD-GRN) Ph1/2 data (40 patients, NfL biomarker) slipped to 2027 from end-2026; Takeda terminated co-development in April 2026 for strategic reasons (Denali Q2 2026 release).
DNLI.why_underappreciated: Catalyst listed as year-end 2026; partner exit and delay are secondary to AVLAYAH news.
DNLI.suggestion: Set out DNL593 funding and partnering after Takeda's exit, and report AVLAYAH patient starts behind the $10-12M Q3 guide to offset the delayed readout.
DNLI.why: Partner left and readout moved a year.

AVIR.datum: C-BEYOND cirrhotic subset (n=184): SVR 95.4% for both bemnifosbuvir/ruzasvir and sofosbuvir/velpatasvir at 12 weeks; no drug-related serious adverse events (Jul 28 2026 topline).
AVIR.why_underappreciated: Headline is overall 93.9% vs 94.8% and the shrinking HCV market; cirrhotic subset is buried.
AVIR.suggestion: Present full C-BEYOND genotype and relapse counts at a medical meeting, and sign an ex-US partner before NDA filing; 8-week dosing applies only to non-cirrhotic patients.
AVIR.why: Relapse counts and genotypes are undisclosed; 8-week edge is non-cirrhotic only.

DCOY.datum: June 2026 $3.5M private placement at $5.91 carries Series A/B/C milestone warrants of $3.5M/$7.0M/$7.0M; cash $8.3M (incl. $2.7M restricted), ATM/ELOC barred 180 days (10-Q, Jun 30 2026).

IVVD.why: Sample-size increase signals fewer events; EUA ends June 2027.

NNVC.datum: NV-387 mpox Ph2: about 80 patients (IIa 20, IIb about 60, 2:1 vs standard of care); no primary endpoint named; investigator decides after 6 days whether to dose 6 more (Jul 2025 PR).

NNVC.why: No named endpoint and $2.8M cash against $7.7M annual burn.

SIGA.datum: Q2 2026 product sales $37.9M vs $79.1M; deliveries 'completed the last procurement order under the 19C contract'; no new US contract or backlog disclosed (Aug 2026 release).

SIGA.why: No order backlog after 19C; revenue falls without a new contract.

ABEO.datum: Q2'26: 5 patients treated, revenue recognized for 4; 2 of 12 lifetime treatments unrecognized for low yield or lot-release failure. NTAP (Oct 1 2026) reaches Medicare, about 10% of RDEB patients (8-K, Aug 13 2026).

ABSI.datum: HEADLINE SAD (n=32, cutoff Jun 8 2026) reported half-life of at least 65 days and no SAEs, but no prolactin-receptor target-engagement biomarker and no human hair data; regrowth evidence is mouse-only vs minoxidil.
ABSI.metric: No human efficacy or biomarker data

ABSI.why: Separates dosing failure from target failure before the binary readout.

CNXU.datum: Jul 7 2026 release: first 510(k) targets a wound-care device, with aesthetics only a later expansion; S-1/A says FDA may instead require De Novo or PMA, names no predicate; animal species and n undisclosed.

CNXU.why: Pathway decides timeline and cost for a cashless company.

DERM.datum: Emrosi high-quality formulary access covers only about 38% of commercial lives (34% in Q1) while Q2 TRx reached about 36,000 (+20% QoQ); July about 14,000 vs June about 13,000 (Q2 call, Aug 12 2026).

KRYS.datum: KB407 (cystic fibrosis): FDA alignment on registrational design now expected 4Q26 with study start 2027, versus 1Q26 alignment and 2Q26 start guided in Jan 2026; transduction 29.4-42.1% in 6 patients.

MANE.datum: Study 302 (n=519): placebo-adjusted TAHC about +23.0 (QD) and +25.7 (BID) hairs/cm2 at month 6 (my subtraction); safety only to month 6; heart rate and blood pressure not reported (Apr 27 2026).

MDWD.datum: FY26 revenue guide $24-26M reaffirmed with H1 revenue of $4.6M (needs about $19-21M in H2); Q2 revenue $3.1M (vs $5.7M), gross margin 10.9%; EMA-requested facility changes run to Q4 2026 (Aug 2026 release).

SGMT.datum: AURORA (Aug 25 2026): about 800 US patients, 2:1 denifanstat 50mg vs placebo, 12-week co-primaries, about 450 aged 12-17, enrolling over about 6 months from Q4 2026; NDA planned after 12-week phase, before 40-week extension.

EVMN.why: Partners will diligence SC exposure; IV efficacy alone does not transfer.

IMA.why: Cash exceeds market cap but burn leaves no Phase 3 funding after readout.

OKYO.why: Non-dilutive funding raises odds NEPTUNE completes.

OTLK.why: Shows whether branded demand exists versus off-label Avastin.

SRZN.why: Sets a clear bar for the 2H27 readout.

TARS.why: Separates durable XDEMVY demand from 2029 pipeline spend.

EPRX.why_underappreciated: Headline percentage rests on three open-label patients; the placebo-controlled test is still ahead.

EPRX.why: Resets expectations before a binary Ph2b readout.
