EYPT.suggestion: Publish LUCIA's statistical plan and FDA feedback on handling non-wet-AMD vision losses (6 GA, 2 glaucoma, 1 detachment in LUGANO) before Q4 topline; add the supplement-free analysis.
EYPT.why: LUCIA protocol is identical; handling of such losses decides filing.

FDMT.datum: Otsuka paid $85.0M nonrefundable upfront for 4D-150 in Asia-Pacific, with up to $335.5M regulatory/commercial milestones and tiered double-digit royalties (10-Q, June 30 2026).
FDMT.why_underappreciated: Buried in 10-Q partner section; models centre on US 4FRONT readouts.
FDMT.suggestion: Show Otsuka milestone triggers and timing, and state 4FRONT-1 non-inferiority margin (>500 patients, enrolled in about 11 months) so investors can model non-dilutive cash before topline.
FDMT.why: Partner cash offsets spend; margin defines readout bar.

HROW.datum: Management guides Tyrvaya 2027 revenue above $30M against $30M upfront, exclusivity assumed to 2034, but adding Viatris reps lifts SG&A about $20M annualized (Q2 2026 call).
HROW.why_underappreciated: Deal headlines the purchase price; net contribution after added SG&A is small.
HROW.suggestion: Disclose Tyrvaya's current net sales run-rate, the $70M milestone sales thresholds, and expected SG&A offset, so investors can judge the deal's net contribution against added leverage.
HROW.why: Net contribution after SG&A is unclear.

IRD.datum: OPGx-LCA5 registrational Phase 3 is FDA-aligned at only eight participants: six-month run-in as own control, then both eyes treated; dosing Q4 2026, topline end-2027 (Q2 2026 release).
IRD.why_underappreciated: Market focuses on BEST1 market size; tiny self-controlled pivotal is a low-cost filing path.
IRD.suggestion: Disclose LCA5 primary endpoint and success threshold agreed with FDA, plus Oberland tranche conditions ($25M on FDA acceptance by Mar 2028) and warrant overhang ($62.1M liability).
IRD.why: Eight-patient pivotal makes the endpoint definition decisive.

KLRS.datum: After one TH103 injection, 41% of treatment-naive patients first needed retreatment at 4 months or later and 29% needed no further anti-VEGF over six months; one transient IOI at 5 mg (Jul 17 2026).
KLRS.why_underappreciated: Release headline is 27-53x lower Cmax; durability signal sits further down.
KLRS.suggestion: Define retreatment criteria and masking used in the Ph1a cohort, and pre-state the MAD time-to-retreatment endpoint and IOI rate by manufacturing process before 1H 2027 data.
KLRS.why: Retreatment is investigator-driven in early studies; criteria matter.

KOD.datum: KSI-101 PEAK Pivotal Analysis 1 (300 patients) is fully enrolled with topline due December 2026; a second 600-subject cohort reads out 2Q 2027 (10-Q, Aug 2026).
KOD.why_underappreciated: Attention is on Zenkuda DAYBREAK and BLA; KSI-101 binary is weeks away.
KOD.suggestion: Disclose PEAK primary endpoint, success threshold and what a miss means for the Zenkuda BLA timeline; set funding plan before December given going-concern language.
KOD.why: PEAK binary lands before the BLA and cash runs short.

LCTX.datum: Three-year OpRegen data: Cohort 4 (12 patients, less advanced disease) mean BCVA stayed above baseline at 12, 24 and 36 months; five patients with extensive coverage improved (Aug 6 2026).
LCTX.why_underappreciated: Narratives cite the five-patient subgroup; the 12-patient cohort result is broader.
LCTX.suggestion: Ask Genentech to state GAlette data timing and whether new surgical delivery devices delay it; no Ph2 data date is guided, so the Dec 2026 catalyst is unsupported.
LCTX.why: Company guides no data date; devices may reset timelines.

LENZ.datum: Over 60% of ePharmacy VIZZ buyers bought more than one pack; Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 cohorts track about 5 packs per patient per year; 13,000+ prescribers, about 75% repeat (Q2 2026).
LENZ.why_underappreciated: Focus is on $1.7M quarterly sales; cohort refill behaviour is newer than models.
LENZ.suggestion: In Q3 results report cohort refill and persistence by quarter, net price per pack and gross-to-net, since neither price nor gross-to-net is disclosed.
LENZ.why: Net price and persistence set revenue per patient.

MGTX.datum: J&J reacquisition terms for bota-vec (Apr 15 2026): $25M upfront; $50M milestone only if US approval and cumulative US sales exceed $250M; mid-teens royalties begin on or after July 1 2029.
MGTX.why_underappreciated: Cheap rights with royalty-free launch years sit in the 10-Q, not the headline.
MGTX.suggestion: Disclose FDA pre-BLA feedback on the LUMEOS primary endpoint and the BLA filing date; confirm timing of the $95M Hologen payment, which the liquidity estimate excludes.
MGTX.why: Filing date and Hologen cash drive near-term value.

OCGN.datum: 10-Q (June 30 2026) states substantial doubt about going concern despite $100.1M cash, after issuing $130M 6.75% convertible notes due 2034; embedded derivative liability $33.7M.
OCGN.why_underappreciated: Coverage cites the re-funded balance sheet and enrollment, not the filing's going-concern language.
OCGN.suggestion: Secure partner or royalty funding to remove going-concern language before the Q1 2027 topline, and disclose FDA agreement on the genotype-agnostic endpoint for the rolling BLA.
OCGN.why: Doubt persists after the raise; filing needs funded runway.

OCS.datum: FDA granted a Special Protocol Assessment for PIONEER-1 (privosegtor, optic neuritis), covering design, size and endpoints; also Breakthrough designation; cash $277.6M into 2H 2029 (Q1 2026).
OCS.why_underappreciated: Market frames the story around the failed DME drops; SPA lowers filing risk.
OCS.suggestion: Disclose PIONEER-1 enrollment pace, an interim milestone, and the NAION trial designs, since the SPA covers optic neuritis only and no readout dates are given.
OCS.why: No PIONEER dates are guided; NAION unspecified.

OCUL.datum: FDA minutes (May 2026 Type C) support an AXPAXLI NDA on SOL-1 Week 52 plus interim SOL-R safety; SOL-R efficacy not required, topline moved to Q1 2028; Sept pre-NDA aligned.
OCUL.metric: FDA: SOL-R not needed for NDA
OCUL.why_underappreciated: Single-trial filing risk dominates commentary; FDA alignment is stated in minutes.
OCUL.suggestion: File the NDA on schedule and disclose the interim SOL-R safety count (target over 300 patients at one year) and any FDA safety-database expectations.
OCUL.why: Safety database size is the remaining filing question.

GANX.datum: 81% mean CSF GluSph reduction at 90 days applied only to participants with elevated baseline; 14 of 16 reached day 150 with stable MDS-UPDRS; subgroup size undisclosed (Feb-Mar 2026 release).
GANX.why_underappreciated: Headline biomarker claim sits in an undisclosed-size subgroup; Ph2 enrolls GBA1 and non-GBA1 patients.
GANX.suggestion: Disclose the size and baseline cutoff of the elevated-GluSph subgroup behind the 81% drop, and enrich the 1Q27 Ph2/2a for it; seek partner funding.
GANX.why: Subgroup size unknown; Ph2 enrollment design should follow it.

IGC.datum: Cash was $331K at Jun 30 2026 (from $900K), working capital deficit ~$2.0M; only backstop is an undrawn $12M O-Bank revolver with monthly draw limit, expiring May 31 2027 (10-Q).
IGC.why_underappreciated: Readout coverage focuses on 168-patient enrollment; revolver limits and sub-$0.5M cash get little attention.
IGC.suggestion: Confirm draw capacity under the O-Bank revolver and arrange renewal before CALMA topline; avoid warrant-heavy equity raised after a borderline readout.
IGC.why: Cash $331K; revolver limits and expiry bound post-readout options.

INMB.datum: MINDFuL Ph2 missed its primary endpoint in the overall population; the 100-patient ADi subgroup showed Cohen's d up to 0.27 with no p-values and no ARIA reported (2025-26 releases).
INMB.metric: Primary missed; ADi d up to 0.27
INMB.why_underappreciated: Releases lead with ADi subgroup and ARIA absence; overall-population miss and small effect sizes are buried.
INMB.suggestion: Publish ADi subgroup effect sizes with confidence intervals and a prespecified enrichment rule, then seek a partner for the unfunded Ph2b/3 using the zero-ARIA profile.
INMB.why: Subgroup effects are small; partner needs enrichment evidence.

KRSA.datum: Roche's trontinemab Ph1b/2: 91% of patients below 24 centiloids at 28 weeks, ARIA-E under 5%, now in Ph3; KRSA-028 has no human data until mid-2027.
KRSA.why_underappreciated: Valuation assumes shuttle advantage; benchmark already exists in humans at scale and leads by years.
KRSA.suggestion: Pre-declare end-2027 patient plaque-clearance and ARIA-E targets against trontinemab's 91% below 24 centiloids at 28 weeks and ARIA-E under 5%.
KRSA.why: Trontinemab sets the bar; KRSA-028 needs matching human data.

LRMR.datum: Anaphylaxis occurred in 10 of 43 participants in the open-label study (9 with prior exposure), all discontinued; supplied fields said 2 cases (Jun 29 2026 release).
LRMR.why_underappreciated: Fields and headlines cite 100% carrier-range frataxin; the ~23% anaphylaxis rate is deep in safety section.
LRMR.suggestion: Disclose anaphylaxis by dose regimen, rechallenge and premedication outcomes, and agree label and monitoring expectations with FDA before completing the rolling BLA.
LRMR.why: 10 of 43 anaphylaxis, mostly after re-exposure, drives approvability and label.

MNOV.datum: COMBAT-ALS (n=234, 12-month double-blind, primary CAFS composite of function and survival) finished its double-blind portion; topline by YE2026; cash $25.4M funds operations through Nov 2027.
MNOV.why_underappreciated: Survival-inclusive composite and no forced raise after readout are overlooked amid ALS-graveyard framing.
MNOV.suggestion: Pre-specify the CAFS analysis plan and survival sensitivity analyses before topline, and open ex-US partner talks now since cash lasts to Nov 2027.
MNOV.why: Binary CAFS readout; partner talks hedge a mixed primary.

NMRA.datum: Cash was $116.8M at Jun 30 2026 (not $147M in our fields), funding into 3Q27; market cap ~$68M is still below cash; Q4 2026 MAD data and YE Ph2 start.
NMRA.why_underappreciated: Market cap below cash after navacaprant failure; correct cash figure still ~1.7x market cap.
NMRA.suggestion: Present NMRA-511 Ph1b effect sizes (0.34, 0.51) against brexpiprazole's with the Q4 MAD data; cash of $116.8M exceeds the ~$68M market cap.
NMRA.why: Cash $116.8M versus $68M cap; benchmarking data can close gap.

PMN.datum: 6-month blinded interim (136 of 144 patients, Jul 28 2026): no ARIA-E, ARIA-H 4.4% all mild; data pooled across arms (3:1 active:placebo), so no active-versus-placebo comparison.
PMN.why_underappreciated: Blinded pooled safety is easily misread; ARIA-sparing claim holds only if active-arm dose cohorts stay clean.
PMN.suggestion: Report ARIA-E and ARIA-H by dose cohort and APOE4 status at unblinded topline, and pre-specify the CSF oligomer engagement threshold counted as success.
PMN.why: Pooled blinded safety needs arm-level confirmation by dose and APOE4.

PRTA.datum: A $55M milestone from BMS on PRX019 is decided by year-end 2026 and excluded from guidance; that is ~34% of EV ($164M). BMS tau Ph2 (n~310) completes 1H27.
PRTA.why_underappreciated: Milestone sits outside 2026 cash guidance, and buyback used only ~$22M of $100M in 1H.
PRTA.suggestion: Use remaining buyback authorization before it expires Dec 31 2026, and state the BMS PRX019 decision criteria and TargetTau-1 1H27 readout timing.
PRTA.why: $55M milestone is uncounted; buyback has expiry and unused capacity.

QURE.datum: BLA/MAA rest on the Jun 2025 36-month cut (12 patients, cUHDRS 75% slowing vs Enroll-HD A); updated 48-month primary vs Enroll-HD B shows cUHDRS 44% slowing, p=0.144 (Sep 29 2026).
QURE.why_underappreciated: Filing narrative cites 75% slowing; the newer primary comparator gives a non-significant composite.
QURE.suggestion: Pre-agree with FDA which external-control analysis governs, and show CSF NfL (4% above baseline at 48 months vs 10-15% annual rise) as concordant evidence.
QURE.why: Basis of BLA differs from newest primary analysis; FDA alignment needed.

SER.datum: SER-252-1b is a randomized, placebo-controlled 'registrational' Ph1b: cohort 1 n=8 (3:1), 5 SAD cohorts (n=40) plus up to 3 MAD cohorts (n=48); SAD topline 1H27 (Sep 9 2026).
SER.why_underappreciated: Market sees a micro-cap Phase 1; the filing-intent design and size are in the release body.
SER.suggestion: Confirm with FDA which endpoints in the registrational Ph1b can support a filing, and secure funding for the up-to-48-patient MAD portion before SAD topline.
SER.why: Registrational design needs FDA-agreed endpoints and funded MAD cohorts.

VYGR.datum: Net collaboration revenue excluding reimbursed costs was only $0.2M in Q2 2026 (total $3.2M vs $5.2M); Neurocrine FA trial is pending IND clearance; cash $148.8M funds into 2028.
VYGR.why_underappreciated: Negative EV is attributed to partnerships, but near-term partner cash is minimal and IND-contingent.
VYGR.suggestion: Pre-specify VY7523 tau-PET and CSF tau success thresholds before Q4 2026, and state which partner milestones follow Neurocrine's IND clearance.
VYGR.why: Partner cash is small; tau-PET thresholds carry the value case.

EQ.datum: EQ504 Ph1 is healthy-volunteer SAD/MAD starting Q4 2026 (was mid-2026), topline ~6 months later; UC patient study only afterward. Cash $57.2M, guided into 2029 (Q2 2026 release).
EQ.why_underappreciated: Prior guidance said mid-2026 start with tissue biomarkers; healthy-volunteer design and slip are newer.
EQ.suggestion: Use the healthy-volunteer Ph1 to confirm colon-targeted exposure and pharmacodynamic biomarkers; add pouchitis or lung cohorts only to the later patient study.
EQ.why: Ph1 cannot read across indications; sequencing saves cash.

ODTX.datum: Wk12 clinical remission 27% at 20 mg BID (n=41) but 16% in Mayo endoscopic score 3 patients (n=19); open-label, no placebo, 56 evaluable (UEG, Oct 2026).
ODTX.why_underappreciated: Headline remission is pooled; severe-endoscopy subgroup and absent placebo sit below the topline.
ODTX.suggestion: Stratify the randomized Ph2b by Mayo endoscopic score 3 and report placebo-adjusted remission in that group, since open-label remission there was 16% versus 27% overall.
ODTX.why: Severe-disease efficacy decides competitiveness against JAK and S1P agents.

PALI.datum: FSCD cohort (n=5): mean SES-CD fell 3.8 points (47.5%); 2 of 5 had endoscopic response and remission. UC cohort (n=5): 2 clinical remissions (Q2 2026 release).
PALI.why_underappreciated: Overshadowed by UC story; ASCENTRA-CD IND not yet submitted.
PALI.suggestion: Add a stricture-specific imaging endpoint alongside SES-CD in ASCENTRA-CD, whose IND is still unfiled, so the fibrostenotic claim is testable rather than inferred from five patients.
PALI.why: No approved stricture drug; imaging endpoint defines the claim.

STTK.datum: ADA 3.7% is 2 of 54 SL-325-treated healthy volunteers (Jun 8 2026); Ph2b RECEPTIVE-CD1 now ~232 patients, three doses plus placebo (Aug 2026), up from ~174 in June.
STTK.why_underappreciated: Immunogenicity headline rests on two events; larger, costlier Ph2b design is newer than models.
STTK.suggestion: Prespecify ADA incidence and trough concentration by dose in RECEPTIVE-CD1 and report them with the 1H 2028 readout, so the immunogenicity claim is tested in patients.
STTK.why: Cash funds into 2029, so evidence matters more than partnering.

SYRE.datum: SPY003 (IL-23) Part A, open-label n=44: Wk12 clinical remission 20%, endoscopic improvement 30%, versus SPY001 40%/51% and SPY002 33%/42%; headline RHI -10.0 (8-K, Sep 8 2026).
SYRE.why_underappreciated: Headline RHI hides lowest remission of the three components, two of three combos include IL-23.
SYRE.suggestion: Disclose the rationale for IL-23 (SPY003, 20% remission) in the SPY130 and SPY230 combinations and the Part B dose-selection rules, since a $10B cap assumes combinations beat monotherapy.
SYRE.why: Combination value depends on each component's contribution.

TRAX.datum: Cohort 1 efficacy set was 32 patients (17 ANB033, 15 placebo) after a 14-day gluten challenge; release reports no lymphocyte, NK-cell or lab safety data for this CD122 blocker (Oct 12 2026).
TRAX.why_underappreciated: Positive headline; absent lab data on an IL-2/IL-15 blocker is easy to miss.
TRAX.suggestion: Publish lymphocyte, NK-cell and laboratory safety data from Cohort 1 before a financing; five quarters of runway means the raise needs that scrutiny answered.
TRAX.why: Missing safety labs matter for a $1.6B valuation raise.

ADRX.datum: Intellia lonvo-z (one-time CRISPR) Ph3 HAELO, Apr 27 2026: 87% attack reduction, 62% attack-free vs 11% placebo (n=80); rolling BLA to finish 2H 2026, US launch 1H 2027.
ADRX.why_underappreciated: Gene-editing launch could precede STOP-HAE topline (by end 2027) by about a year.
ADRX.suggestion: State the STOP-HAE attack-free target against the approved ASO's 35-53% and Intellia's 62%, and disclose enrollment pace, since topline is guided only to the end of 2027.
ADRX.why: Sets a measurable bar for a $2B valuation on n=3.

AQST.datum: FDA classified the Anaphylm resubmission Class 2 with PDUFA goal date March 16, 2027 (announced Oct 15 2026), a roughly six-month clock; cash about $99M against $51M debt at Jun 30.
AQST.why_underappreciated: Fields still list a Nov 2026 classification catalyst; the Class 2 outcome is newer.
AQST.suggestion: Re-time launch spending and financing to the March 16, 2027 PDUFA date, and prioritize the Q4 2026 Canadian submission as a non-US revenue path.
AQST.why: Class 1 hope is gone; cash must cover a longer wait.

BCRX.datum: ORLADEYO Q2 2026 net revenue $158.2M, +1% y/y (+10% ex-Europe); FY guide $625-645M unchanged. Debt: $395.4M term loan plus $426.8M royalty obligation (Aug 5 2026).
BCRX.why_underappreciated: Narrative says growing toward $1B; guidance implies flat, with $822M of debt-like obligations.
BCRX.suggestion: Report US ORLADEYO new starts and persistence each quarter, and direct positive cash flow to the $395M term loan until navenibart topline in Q3 2027.
BCRX.why: A flat franchise funds debt service and the Phase 3.

CLDX.datum: EMBARQ Wk24 complete response on 300 mg every 8 weeks: 45.1% and 48.4% versus 49.0% and 54.0% on 150 mg every 4 weeks; placebo 15.4%/17.6% (Sep 22 2026, n=1,939).
CLDX.why_underappreciated: Dosing-interval parity is buried below headline response; matters against daily oral remibrutinib.
CLDX.suggestion: Seek a 300 mg every-8-weeks label as the lead regimen and report neutropenia and anaphylaxis by arm before the 2027 BLA.
CLDX.why: Convenience versus daily oral rival; safety by arm answers the overhang.

CUE.datum: CUE-221 Ph2 (China, licensor-run, n=145): Wk28, 12 weeks off drug, HSS7=0 in 60% at 4 mg/kg vs 24% omalizumab (n=17, post hoc) and 11% placebo (Sep 20 2026).
CUE.why_underappreciated: Market sees week-12 headline; durability is post hoc, newer, and from small arms.
CUE.suggestion: Seek FDA feedback on using China Ph2 data and include a 4 mg/kg extended-dosing-interval arm in the global Ph2b/3 to test durability off drug.
CUE.why: Durability is the differentiator; China-only data limits US reliance.

DBVT.datum: VITESSE safety: 3.2% vs 0.5% placebo discontinued for adverse events; 0.5% (n=2) treatment-related anaphylaxis; epinephrine use not reported. Going-concern doubt; cash $165.7M into Q3 2027 (Oct 28 2026).
DBVT.why_underappreciated: Efficacy headline dominates; systemic-reaction data are missing and going-concern language is new.
DBVT.suggestion: Disclose systemic-reaction and epinephrine-use rates and reasons for the 3.2% AE discontinuations ahead of the Q4 2026 filing decision; label risk, not efficacy, is the open question.
DBVT.why: Label risk shapes uptake and Priority Review odds.

SRPT.datum: ESSENCE (n=228) missed its primary endpoint at week 96: 4-step ascend velocity difference 0.06 steps/s vs placebo, P=.309; this is the confirmatory basis for the Feb 28 2027 conversion of AMONDYS 45/VYONDYS 53.
SRPT.why_underappreciated: Headline focus is ELEVIDYS; PMO franchise is ~70% of product revenue and rests on a missed confirmatory trial.
SRPT.suggestion: Publish the ESSENCE post-hoc and real-world evidence for exon 45/53 now, and quantify revenue at risk if the Feb 28 2027 traditional approval is refused.
SRPT.why: PMO franchise revenue depends on a missed confirmatory trial.

SRRK.datum: ISEMBYLD list price set at $11,659 per vial, about $310,000 per year (10 mg/kg IV every 4 weeks); company puts the immediate US eligible pool at about 6,600 patients (Sep 2026).
SRRK.why_underappreciated: Newer than models; supplied net price field ($150K) is roughly half the list price.
SRRK.suggestion: Report payer coverage decisions, gross-to-net and new patient starts for ISEMBYLD in the first two quarters, to test whether $310K list converts to net revenue.
SRRK.why: Price and pool are known; net realization is not.

TRDA.datum: ENTR-601-45 Cohort 1 (5 mg/kg x3 doses, n=6 treated) raised dystrophin only +0.10% from baseline (p=0.03) vs -0.02% placebo; assay quantification limit is 0.25% (Oct 14 2026).
TRDA.why_underappreciated: Company called it positive; the gain sits below the assay's 0.25% quantification limit; attention is on ENTR-601-44.
TRDA.suggestion: Disclose dose-matched muscle tissue exposure and dystrophin by dose across both EEV programs (44 and 45) before the 10 mg/kg ELEVATE-45 Cohort 2 data in 1H27.
TRDA.why: Two EEV exon-skippers show sub-quantifiable dystrophin so far.

VCEL.datum: MACI sold through two specialty pharmacies (Orsini, AllCare) was about $101.7M of $145.9M H1 2026 revenue (~70%); Vericel keeps the credit and collection risk; bad-debt allowance rose to $9.8M.
VCEL.why_underappreciated: Buried in 10-Q revenue note; narrative focuses on growth and no direct competitor.
VCEL.suggestion: Disclose specialty-pharmacy concentration, days sales outstanding and payer denial rates each quarter, and compare with the capacity limit when sizing MACI growth.
VCEL.why: Two channels carry ~70% of revenue and credit risk.

WVE.datum: Oct 1 2026: after FDA meeting, WVE-006 (AATD) can run a single two-year registrational trial with a one-year interim for accelerated approval, no separate confirmatory trial; FDA supports Wave's LC-MS assay.
WVE.why_underappreciated: Newer than models; headline story is DMD and obesity, and the release gave no efficacy numbers.
WVE.suggestion: Publish the WVE-006 registrational trial size, start date and the AATD biomarker for the one-year interim, alongside 600 mg multidose data due Q4 2026.
WVE.why: Registrational design drives cost, timing and runway use.

ABCL.datum: Licensing and royalty revenue fell to $0.15M in Q2 2026 from $10.4M in Q2 2025; partnered programs with downstream stakes fell to 35 from 44 at Dec 31 2025.
ABCL.why_underappreciated: Narrative says platform royalties plus cash fund owned drugs; royalty line is nearly gone.
ABCL.suggestion: Report which partnered programs hold royalty-bearing milestones through 2027 and their expected revenue; make clear value rests on ABCL635 and cash, not the platform.
ABCL.why: Royalty stream is near zero; value rests on ABCL635.

ALKS.datum: Takeda's ORZEYFUL label (Aug 5 2026) is NT1 adults only; insomnia 60% (2 mg BID) vs 1% placebo, urinary frequency 58% vs 5%, CPK >5x ULN 11% vs 5%.
ALKS.why_underappreciated: Market treats approval as pure threat; label is NT1-only with heavy tolerability events, leaving NT2 open.
ALKS.suggestion: Show alixorexton rates of insomnia, urinary symptoms, CPK and visual disturbance side by side with ORZEYFUL label rates, and lead with NT2 where Takeda has no label.
ALKS.why: Rival label sets the tolerability bar and leaves NT2 open.

CAMP.datum: CMP-002 ASCEND is randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled with three doses then six months follow-up; first patient by YE2026 but top-line not until 1H 2028; cash guided through end-2028.
CAMP.why_underappreciated: Newer than models; market anticipates early human data, but efficacy readout is about 18 months after first dosing.
CAMP.source: https://quartr.com/events/camp4-therapeutics-corp-camp-analyst-day-2026_FPnIuUSy (Sep 28 2026 Analyst Day, AI summary); Q2 8-K for cash
CAMP.suggestion: Specify the interim pharmacodynamic readout (SYNGAP1 protein or mRNA, EEG) and its timing before 1H28, so progress is measurable before the placebo-controlled top-line.
CAMP.why: No efficacy data for ~18 months after first dose.

DMAC.datum: Aug 10 2026: $43.5M cash funds operations only 'through 2027', while ReMEDy2 interim (200 pts, over 85% enrolled) is due Q1 2027 and may raise N from 300 up to 728; H1 cash use $17.2M.
DMAC.why_underappreciated: Runway is stated against a design whose sample size is still adaptive; US preeclampsia IND path also unsettled.
DMAC.suggestion: Disclose cost per added patient and funded runway at N=300, 500 and 728, and secure financing or an ex-US partner before the Q1 2027 interim.
DMAC.why: Runway is tested by the adaptive sample size.

DRUG.datum: BREAKTHROUGH Ph2 (Jan 6 2026): 24 enrolled, 6 stopped early (3 of 15 absence, 3 of 9 DEE); the 73.1% median absence reduction (p=0.012) is in 11 evaluable patients.
DRUG.why_underappreciated: Headline 73% omits that 6 of 24 enrolled patients stopped during titration.
DRUG.suggestion: Run the global Phase 2/3 with a slower titration, an intent-to-treat primary analysis and a placebo arm, and publish the early-discontinuation reasons by dose step.
DRUG.why: Tolerability in titration decides intent-to-treat results.

FLNA.datum: Sep 22 2026: Phase 2a (40 pts, 13 US sites, 16 weeks) compares two simufilam doses; primary endpoints are safety, tolerability and PK, not seizures; Dec 2025 FDA hold cited preclinical data.
FLNA.why_underappreciated: Headline is hold lifted and price under cash; trial cannot show efficacy against placebo.
FLNA.suggestion: Add a placebo arm or pre-specify seizure frequency as a key secondary with a power estimate, and disclose which preclinical data lifted the hold.
FLNA.why: No placebo-controlled efficacy test is planned.

GRCE.datum: Type A minutes received Jul 28 2026: current CDMO facility needs FDA reinspection and NDA cannot be approved while it is non-compliant; second US CDMO tech transfer under way; no resubmission date.
GRCE.why_underappreciated: Supplied fields say Type A not yet held; CRL is called fixable but depends on a third-party facility.
GRCE.suggestion: Name the date the second US CDMO's data support resubmission and the FDA reinspection timing; fund this through a bridge or partner given $17M cash.
GRCE.why: Approval hinges on a CDMO reinspection with no date.

HRMY.datum: Pitolisant GR is bioequivalent to WAKIX (AUC ratio 108.5%, Cmax 99.7%); 46 of 46 patients started at 17.8 mg without titration; pending patents could extend exclusivity to 2044 (PR Nov 24, 2025).
HRMY.why_underappreciated: Market models orexin erosion, not a titration-free reformulation with patent filings to 2044.
HRMY.suggestion: At the Nov 4 print, disclose pitolisant GR patent status and the planned WAKIX-to-GR conversion path, with revenue modeled past 2030, ahead of any acquisition or buyback.
HRMY.why: Shows how GR extends the franchise despite orexin competition.

NGEN.datum: CONNECT SCI GRASSP QtP gain was 3.7 vs 0.4 (difference 3.3) against a 2-point minimally important difference; 4.4 vs 1.2 persisted at week 16 after dosing stopped; PGIC 75% vs 33%.
NGEN.why_underappreciated: Coverage focuses on small n; MID margin and post-dosing persistence sit in secondary detail.
NGEN.suggestion: Disclose RESTORE's powering assumptions (treatment difference, variance, power) relative to the 3.3-point Ph2a result and the 2-point MID, since none are published for the ~150-patient trial.
NGEN.why: Powering is undisclosed; it sets Phase 3 odds.

NGNE.datum: Embolden's FDA-agreed success bar is a 33% responder rate (CGI-I of 3 or less plus at least 1 of 28 milestones, blinded raters, 12 months); Breakthrough Therapy was granted Feb 2026 (10-Q).
NGNE.why_underappreciated: Low pre-set bar and already-granted Breakthrough are buried in the 10-Q; dashboard treats BTD as unconfirmed.
NGNE.suggestion: Use Breakthrough status to open a rolling BLA now, with the PPQ campaign finishing end-2026; the 24-patient 12-month analysis then triggers filing without waiting for topline.
NGNE.why: Breakthrough is granted; rolling submission shortens time to market.

OVID.datum: Phase 1 ophthalmic testing (OCT, fundus, visual-field perimetry) showed no retinal changes with OV329 at any dose; 7 mg cohort had no treatment-related adverse events (PR Mar 18, 2026).
OVID.why_underappreciated: Efficacy-unproven narrative dominates; ophthalmic results sit inside an indication-expansion release and are short healthy-volunteer exposure.
OVID.suggestion: Build longer-exposure OCT and perimetry monitoring into the OV329 focal-epilepsy Ph2 and publish the schedule beside the seizure endpoint, since Phase 1 exposure was brief.
OVID.why: Retinal safety is the thesis; Phase 1 exposure is short.

PRAX.datum: FDA mid-cycle meetings for both NDAs found no major safety or efficacy concerns, no advisory committee is planned, and BIMO inspections ended with no Form 483; relutrigine PDUFA is Dec 27, 2026 (Q2 2026 PR).
PRAX.why_underappreciated: Buried in the Q2 update; headline is trial data, while two PDUFAs land within 5 weeks.
PRAX.suggestion: Publish ESSENTIAL3 adverse-event discontinuation rates next to the 55% vs 33% maintenance response, with payer positioning against propranolol and primidone, before the Jan 29, 2027 PDUFA.
PRAX.why: Tolerability, not approval odds, decides first-line use.

RAPP.datum: Mania Ph2 (n=253, 0.75 mg, 3 weeks): placebo-adjusted YMRS gain widened 0.9, 2.2, 3.1 at weeks 1-3 (p=0.045); CGI-BP p=0.024; psychiatric TEAEs 34.9% vs 33.1% (PR Oct 20, 2026).
RAPP.why_underappreciated: Headline is the marginal p=0.045; weekly trajectory suggests the 3-week trial ended before plateau.
RAPP.suggestion: At the Q1 2027 FDA meeting, propose a longer-than-3-week mania Ph3 given the widening weekly effect, or deprioritize it; keep FOCUS epilepsy funding ahead of mania.
RAPP.why: Effect was still growing at week 3; epilepsy Phase 3 comes first.

STOK.datum: After FDA feedback, EMPEROR cognition/behavior is four prespecified Vineland-3 subdomains analyzed jointly by multivariate MMRM through week 52; the Q2 release had listed five, including coping skills.
STOK.why_underappreciated: Narrowing and joint-test design is new since Q2 and absent from analyst models.
STOK.suggestion: Disclose success criteria and effect-size assumptions for the four-subdomain multivariate MMRM, using the 81-patient 4-year OLE, so the Q3 2027 readout has a known cognition bar.
STOK.why: A cognition label hinges on one multivariate test.

SUPN.datum: Supernus holders get 43.5% of the combined company at a fixed 1.5401 ratio, but only Indivior holders receive the $1.0B pre-close dividend, partly funded by a $650M term loan; break fee $101M (8-K Aug 2026).
SUPN.why_underappreciated: Ratio gets attention; dividend to Indivior holders only and new leverage are treated as irrelevant.
SUPN.suggestion: Ask for pro forma net debt, interest cost and the SPN-817 funding plan for the combined company before the Supernus shareholder vote.
SUPN.why: Leverage is undisclosed; SPN-817 funding is unaddressed.

TSHA.datum: BLA would include only 3+ months of safety from 4 patients aged 2 to under 4 (ASPIRE) with efficacy extrapolated from REVEAL (ages 6 to under 22, single-arm); interim threshold undisclosed (PR Aug 11, 2026).
TSHA.why_underappreciated: Label breadth below trial age range rests on an FDA position the company has not confirmed.
TSHA.suggestion: Publish the REVEAL interim responder threshold and FDA's stated position on extrapolating efficacy to ages 2 to under 6, so the 1H27 readout is judged against known bars.
TSHA.why: Interim acceptance and label breadth depend on undisclosed FDA positions.

XENE.datum: Psychiatry enrollment paused after neuropsychiatric adverse events not seen in Phase 2 X-NOVA; the release gives no epilepsy neuropsychiatric rates, while the NDA rests on X-TOLE/X-TOLE2 with 1,500+ patient-years (PR Sep 17, 2026).
XENE.why_underappreciated: Epilepsy safety is called consistent but unquantified, so label risk cannot be priced.
XENE.suggestion: Publish psychiatric adverse events by dose and timing versus placebo from X-TOLE and X-TOLE2, and the planned dosing change for psychiatry, before the mid-Nov filing decision.
XENE.why: Quantified epilepsy psychiatric safety bounds label risk.

ABOS.datum: Sep 30, 2026: cash $78.6M vs debt $26.3M ($20.4M short-term), net about $52M; runway only 'into early 2027'; ALTITUDE-AD topline now November 2026, extension data excluded (Q3 8-K).
ABOS.why_underappreciated: Fields-only cash is stale; debt due within a year is not netted and runway ends right after readout.
ABOS.suggestion: Before the November ALTITUDE-AD topline, disclose debt amortization and seek a lender extension plus contingent financing, so a positive result is not diluted at weak terms.
ABOS.why: $20.4M debt is due within a year against $78.6M cash.

ACAD.datum: RADIANT 60 mg: key secondary CGI-S-ADP effect size 0.37 (p=0.0077 nominal) vs primary SAPS-H+D 0.26 (p=0.0603); gap widened over 6 weeks; 30 mg flat and dropped from Ph3 (PR Sep 24, 2026).
ACAD.why_underappreciated: Headline is the narrow primary miss; widening 60 mg effect and clean safety get less weight.
ACAD.suggestion: Disclose Phase 3 powering for the 60 mg-only design versus RADIANT's 0.26 effect size, with go/no-go criteria, before the Nov 16-19 CTAD presentation.
ACAD.why: RADIANT effect size sets Phase 3 power and spend.

UPB.datum: VALIANT (ERS Sep 2026): exacerbation reduction 87% in eosinophils >=300 cells/uL vs 56% overall at 100 mg q12w; no significant reduction below 150 cells/uL.
UPB.why_underappreciated: Headline is 56% all-comers; eosinophil split sits in a conference interview, not the release.
UPB.suggestion: Pre-specify an eosinophil-stratified Phase 3 and secure partner or non-dilutive funding before the Q1 2027 start, leading with the 87% high-eosinophil effect.
UPB.why: Enrichment sharpens Phase 3 odds; funding gap remains.

ANNX.datum: Matched real-world comparison of Phase 3 tanruprubart patients vs IGOS registry IVIg/plasma exchange: ~10-point MRC sumscore advantage at week 1; ~3x likelihood of better GBS disability state at weeks 4, 8, 26.
ANNX.why_underappreciated: Phase 3 was placebo-controlled; the indirect standard-of-care comparison is in conference material, not headlines.
ANNX.suggestion: Submit the IGOS-matched analysis methods and subgroup data with the Q4 2026 BLA, since payers will benchmark against IVIg rather than placebo.
ANNX.why: Payers price against IVIg, not placebo.

DNTH.datum: Phase 2 MaGic (n=65, q2w): placebo-adjusted MG-ADL gain 1.8 points at 300 mg (p=0.0013), 2.6 at 600 mg; Phase 3 EMERGE tests 300 mg q2w and q4w, topline 2H28.
DNTH.why_underappreciated: Headline is 'positive'; modest effect size and untested q4w dosing hide behind a $4.5B valuation.
DNTH.suggestion: Explain why q4w dosing is expected to work given the 1.8-point placebo-adjusted gain at 300 mg, and publish the EMERGE power assumptions and CAPTIVATE Part B date.
DNTH.why: Effect size and dosing interval drive Phase 3 risk.

IMUX.datum: ENSURE interim analysis (Oct 2024, ~half of planned first-relapse events): futility not met, no sample-size increase; 2,221 randomized; primary is time to first relapse up to 72 weeks; topline end-2026.
IMUX.why_underappreciated: Event-driven design passed futility with no upsizing; market focuses on binary readout, not this.
IMUX.suggestion: Before ENSURE topline, secure a partner or funding for the progressive-MS Phase 3, anchored on CALLIPER and 144-week EMPhASIS data, so a win does not force dilution.
IMUX.why: Runway of 6.2 quarters limits leverage after readout.

KYTX.datum: FDA asked for extra analysis of a 153-patient SPS natural-history study to contextualise single-arm KYSA-8 (n=26); rolling BLA to complete Q4 2026 (Q1 2026 report).
KYTX.why_underappreciated: Single-arm n=26 relies on external control; FDA request surfaced only in earnings commentary.
KYTX.suggestion: Include the 153-patient natural-history comparison with 12-month KYSA-8 data in the BLA, then raise capital or partner ex-US rights once the submission is complete.
KYTX.why: External-control acceptance gates priority review and financing terms.

RNAC.datum: K2 facility (May 26 2026): up to $150M but only $50M funded; $25M (2027) needs clinical and financing milestones; $25M (2028) needs approval and sales milestones; AURORA topline Q1 2027.
RNAC.why_underappreciated: Headline 'up to $150M non-dilutive' overstates committed cash; later tranches depend on results.
RNAC.suggestion: Disclose K2 interest, maturity and tranche-two milestone definitions, and stage BLA readiness so the mid-2027 filing follows the Q1 2027 AURORA topline without a gap.
RNAC.why: Only $50M is committed; milestones decide the rest.

TGTX.datum: Subcutaneous BRIUMVI Phase 3 (quarterly dosing, fully enrolled) topline now 'year-end 2026 or early 2027'; Q2 2026 guide adds ~$100M subQ and second-source manufacturing costs.
TGTX.why_underappreciated: Dated 2026-12-31 catalyst; company wording allows early 2027 and extra $100M spend.
TGTX.suggestion: Disclose the subcutaneous Phase 3 primary endpoint and readout date, and show the ~$100M manufacturing spend against $612M cash, ahead of ocrelizumab biosimilar pricing.
TGTX.why: Timing and spend are unquantified for investors.

TLSA.datum: INFORM-MS (n=48) is 12-week, double-blind, three-arm (two doses vs placebo) with 4-6 month extension; release does not name a primary endpoint; going-concern warning, cash ~$3.9M at Oct 16.
TLSA.why_underappreciated: Press releases stress imaging and biomarkers; no primary endpoint stated and cash is minimal.
TLSA.suggestion: State INFORM-MS primary endpoint and per-arm size before topline, and announce financing or partnership terms alongside it; roughly 16 patients per arm and under $4M cash limit credibility.
TLSA.why: Undefined endpoint plus no cash undermines any readout.

VOR.datum: Telitacicept already approved in China incl. gMG; global UPSTREAM MG (placebo, 24-wk MG-ADL change) enrolled Sep 2026, topline 1H27; RemeGen license owes >$4B milestones plus undisclosed tiered royalties.
VOR.why_underappreciated: Valuation treats telitacicept as unproven; China approval exists, but royalty and milestone burden is undisclosed.
VOR.suggestion: Disclose royalty tiers and milestone triggers owed to RemeGen and the UPSTREAM sample size, so investors can model economics before the 1H 2027 topline.
VOR.why: Economics of a $1.8B bet are not modelable.

CABA.datum: Rese-cel BLA filing planned 2027 and contingent on success in either of two independent registrational cohorts (DM/ASyS or IMNM); myositis topline guided mid-2027.
CABA.why_underappreciated: Two shots on goal for one BLA sits in disclosures, not the 80% headline.
CABA.suggestion: Publish cohort sizes, primary endpoints and read order for DM/ASyS and IMNM; use warrant cash to open systemic sclerosis without delaying the myositis BLA.
CABA.why: Cohort design sets BLA odds and timing.

CRDL.datum: MAVERIC blinded review (Sep 23 2026) showed fewer recurrences than expected; enrollment raised from 110 to up to 150; topline slips Q1 to mid-2027; runway into Q1 2028.
CRDL.why_underappreciated: Event-driven primary (time to first recurrence); delay and lower pooled event rate mean power risk.
CRDL.suggestion: Disclose the pooled recurrence rate, events required and any interim look for the 150-patient MAVERIC; runway to Q1 2028 leaves little cushion after mid-2027 topline.
CRDL.why: Power and cash both tighten after expansion.

HCM.datum: ESLIM-02 (n=90): in rituximab-pretreated wAIHA, durable response 69% vs 16% (p=0.0022); transfusion 11% vs 43%; grade 3+ events 43% vs 59% (EHA 2026).
HCM.why_underappreciated: Subgroup is the real second-line population; headline is 66% vs 15% and no ex-China partner named.
HCM.suggestion: Seek an ex-China partner for sovleplenib after NMPA decisions, leading with 69% vs 16% in rituximab-pretreated wAIHA and lower transfusion need; none is named.
HCM.why: Ex-China rights unlock value beyond a China filing.

JSPR.datum: 18 complement-naive PNH patients on KP104 (Phase 2, ASH 2024): 16/18 reached Hb >=12 g/dL, no transfusions through week 84/85; LDH <1.5x ULN in 17/18.
JSPR.why_underappreciated: Older private-company data; headline is micro-cap distress and the unreported renal basket.
JSPR.suggestion: Report Q4 2026 renal interim proteinuria and hemolysis markers against iptacopan; disclose the PNH end-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting outcome, since PNH next steps are guided for 1H 2027.
JSPR.why: PNH data is strong; renal data and FDA path decide re-rating.

KNSA.datum: Only ~21% of roughly 14,000 multiple-recurrence pericarditis patients were on ARCALYST at end Q2 2026; average therapy duration is about 3 years (Q2 2026 release, Jul 28).
KNSA.why_underappreciated: Attention is on the guidance raise and KPL-387; low penetration headroom sits in a footnote metric.
KNSA.suggestion: Report penetration by prescriber depth, new starts and persistence beyond 3 years, and show how PASTORALE monthly KPL-387 converts weekly patients ahead of 2028-29 launch.
KNSA.why: Penetration and persistence set durability of near-$1B revenue.

LKFT.datum: Gilead deal: only up to $150M of the $500M flexible cash can fund buybacks; Galapagos funds gamgertamig development to registrational start; year-end 2026 cash guided EUR 1.975-2.05B (May 6, 2026).
LKFT.why_underappreciated: Market sees EV below net cash; contract caps returns and earmarks cash for development.
LKFT.suggestion: State how much of the $500M is earmarked for development and deals versus return, given the $150M buyback cap, and give gamgertamig Phase 1b data timing.
LKFT.why: Return capacity is capped, so the discount may persist.

MIRM.datum: VISTAS PSC (n=111): placebo-adjusted ItchRO -1.64 (p<0.0001), but diarrhea 40.3% vs 8.6%, jaundice 5.2% vs 1.2%, ALT rise 9.1% vs 3.7% (pooled safety, May 2026).
MIRM.why_underappreciated: Headline is the primary-endpoint win and Breakthrough status; liver signals sit in slide-deck safety tables.
MIRM.suggestion: Disclose the FDA-recommended PSC Phase 3 design with a liver-safety monitoring plan; sequence PBC VANTAGE topline (Q1 2027) first and show timeline impact on volixibat peak sales.
MIRM.why: Liver signals and new Phase 3 drive volixibat odds.

NVCT.datum: No US IND exists yet: Nuvectis expects a pre-IND meeting then IND submission in 4Q 2026, with no FDA feedback reported on using the China eculizumab-controlled Phase 3 (Q2 2026 release).
NVCT.why_underappreciated: Market prices the 59.5% vs 8.3% China data, not the absence of any FDA interaction.
NVCT.suggestion: Disclose pre-IND feedback on whether the China Phase 3 supports a US filing or an iptacopan-controlled trial is required, and name US/EU funding or partner plans.
NVCT.why: Pre-IND feedback decides cost, timeline and US value.

PRQR.datum: AX-0810 Phase 1 in healthy volunteers: total serum bile acids rose up to 8-fold at 6 mg/kg versus a 2-fold threshold; 8-week half-life; no SAEs or pruritus (Jun 2026).
PRQR.why_underappreciated: Dismissed as healthy-volunteer data; 8-week half-life implies infrequent dosing and strong target engagement.
PRQR.suggestion: Plan funding beyond mid-2028 runway, since first Phase 2 interim data (mid-2028) arrive as cash ends; use Lilly relationship for milestones or partnership before Phase 2 starts mid-2027.
PRQR.why: Runway ends when first patient interim data arrive.

ADMA.datum: Q2 2026 gross margin 69% vs 55% a year earlier despite BIVIGAM -48.5%; ASCENIV +23.5% to $102.9M; FY26 guidance reiterated at $530-560M revenue (Aug 2026).
ADMA.why_underappreciated: Focus is BIVIGAM collapse and pricing pressure; ASCENIV mix and yield-process margin gains are overlooked.
ADMA.suggestion: Report ASCENIV, BIVIGAM and margin separately, and disclose how revolver-funded buybacks (debt $193M vs $69M at year-end) fit the $200M repurchase target.
ADMA.why: Margin mix and rising debt shape equity value.

ELDN.datum: Phase 3 (~600 patients, start late 2026) primary endpoint is non-inferiority on BPAR, graft loss or death, not eGFR; cash $88.8M at Jun 30, 2026 (post-EOP2 meeting).
ELDN.why_underappreciated: Tegoprubart's main edge, eGFR 71 vs 58, is not the primary endpoint; headline stresses eGFR.
ELDN.suggestion: Ask FDA whether eGFR can be a labeled key secondary, and secure Phase 3 funding or a partner before the late-2026 start; cash $88.8M, going-concern doubt.
ELDN.why: Primary endpoint hides the main advantage; funding is short.

MESO.datum: Revascor case rests on a 70-patient LVAD trial: mortality months 2-12 was 4.9% vs 26.9% (p=0.02); FDA minutes cite possible benefit against mortality (Mar 2024 release). No BLA filing found.
MESO.why_underappreciated: Small secondary-endpoint mortality signal behind accelerated-approval hopes; market focuses on Ryoncil sales.
MESO.suggestion: Disclose Revascor BLA filing status, the confirmatory trial design FDA aligned on in 2025, and mortality adjudication detail so investors can price accelerated-approval odds.
MESO.why: Filing status and mortality evidence set Revascor odds.

OMER.datum: CHMP negative opinion on narsoplimab (Jun 26, 2026) followed an oral explanation with four transplant experts; grounds not disclosed; Omeros will seek re-examination by an Ad Hoc Expert Group.
OMER.why_underappreciated: US launch beat dominates; undisclosed CHMP grounds make re-examination odds opaque.
OMER.suggestion: Publish the CHMP grounds and re-examination timeline, and pursue an ex-US partner in parallel; US launch is strong but EU approval odds are unclear.
OMER.why: Undisclosed CHMP grounds obscure EU approval odds.

PHAR.datum: 132 US patients were on paid Joenja therapy vs 298 identified APDS patients (60 aged 4-11) at Q2 2026; Joenja revenue $17.9M, +40% (Jul 30 call).
PHAR.why_underappreciated: Attention is the $30M total-revenue guidance cut; the 44% paid-to-identified gap is overlooked.
PHAR.suggestion: Report conversion from identified to paid US patients and pediatric starts after the Sep 2026 approval, to show whether growth is identification-limited or access-limited.
PHAR.why: Conversion gap shows headroom or access barriers.

ACRS.datum: Ph2 ADMIRATION (n=109, 2:1) tests 300 mg every 2 weeks with EASI change at week 24 primary, though Ph2a showed 23-day half-life and 94% EASI-75 (open-label).
ACRS.why_underappreciated: Extended-dosing thesis rests on half-life; the controlled trial does not test longer intervals.
ACRS.suggestion: Before Q4 2026 topline, design a longer-interval dosing study using the 23-day half-life, and secure partner funding for Phase 3; asthma is only planned via partner.
ACRS.why: Longer dosing is the differentiator; partner funds Phase 3.

NXTC.datum: NextCure's estimated net cash at closing is about -$2.3M and its holders get ~1.21% of Avere; the ~$400M cash is Avere's new financing, not legacy NextCure's (S-4/A, Jul-Aug 2026).
NXTC.why_underappreciated: Negative EV compares $26M legacy market cap with cash that mostly belongs to incoming Avere investors.
NXTC.suggestion: Value NXTC as ~1.2% of Avere plus the CVR (90% of net monetization proceeds for two years), not against $400M cash; track the final exchange ratio at closing.
NXTC.why: Cash is Avere's; legacy holders get a small stake and a CVR.

ORKA.datum: Week-28 PASI 100 was 71.4% (63.5% at wk16) after only two 600mg doses (wk0, wk4), n=63 vs 21 placebo; wk28 PASI 100 responders are re-randomized to no dosing vs 300mg q6m (2025 design).
ORKA.why_underappreciated: Focus is on dosing-interval promise; the untreated-observation arm directly measures relapse timing and is not yet reported.
ORKA.suggestion: Report time to loss of PASI 100 in the no-further-dosing arm versus 300mg every six months at week 52, with a pre-stated relapse definition.
ORKA.why: Relapse timing off drug sets the real dosing interval.

PTGX.datum: Icotrokinra royalty is tiered 6-10%, versus rusfertide 14-29% (~21% weighted at $1.5B sales); J&J milestones still due total $155M plus up to $425M sales milestones (10-Q, Jun 30 2026).
PTGX.why_underappreciated: Story is framed around icotrokinra's blockbuster scale; rusfertide earns far more royalty per sales dollar.
PTGX.suggestion: Model royalties separately by drug, showing rusfertide at ~21% weighted versus icotrokinra's 6-10% tiers, plus the $155M of remaining J&J regulatory milestones.
PTGX.why: Royalty rate per sales dollar differs about threefold by drug.

QTTB.datum: In the placebo-controlled SIGNAL-AA analysis, the planned week-24 primary analysis was dropped; post-hoc per-protocol (n=27) showed SALT -16% vs -2% placebo, Wilcoxon p=0.045 (Dec 10 2024).
QTTB.why_underappreciated: Attention is on 2026 open-label data; the only controlled evidence is a marginal post-hoc analysis.
QTTB.suggestion: Seek FDA agreement on a placebo-controlled registrational design with a prespecified week-24 SALT primary and analysis population, before launching the pivotal program in 1H 2027.
QTTB.why: Only controlled data rely on a post-hoc analysis.

TRXB.datum: Two cynomolgus monkeys died on TRB-061 at 3 mg/kg: non-GLP IV day 29, and GLP 6-month SC day 22 with cause undetermined; the S-1/A warns of a possible clinical exposure cap (Oct 5 2026).
TRXB.why_underappreciated: Buried in risk factors; headline is IPO and Treg expansion in 65 healthy volunteers.
TRXB.suggestion: Disclose the GLP study cause-of-death findings and any exposure cap relative to the 24 mg and 50 mg Phase 1b doses before the mid-2027 readout.
TRXB.why: An undetermined GLP death could cap exposure below efficacious levels.

TTRX.datum: Interim (n=50, Jun 2 2026): vehicle EASI-50 was 65.2% at wk4 (GX-03 92.6%); EASI-90 wk8 51.9% vs 34.8% vehicle; no p-values, no EASI-100 reported, vehicle response above expectations.
TTRX.why_underappreciated: Headlines quote 65.2% as if drug effect; it is the vehicle rate, and no statistics were given.
TTRX.suggestion: Publish Stage 1 vehicle-adjusted EASI-75/90/100 with confidence intervals and the tightened baseline-EASI criteria, then secure financing; cash is $11M against Q3 2027 runway guidance.
TTRX.why: Unadjusted rates with high vehicle response cannot support financing.

ZURA.datum: TibuSHIELD (n=247, 1:1:1 two doses vs placebo) primary endpoint is week-16 percent change in abscess and nodule count; HiSCR50/75 are only key secondaries (Zura PR, Jun 29 2026).
ZURA.metric: Primary is AN count, not HiSCR
ZURA.why_underappreciated: Investors benchmark HiSCR against bimekizumab; HiSCR is secondary here, so a primary win may not translate.
ZURA.suggestion: Disclose pre-specified HiSCR50 and AN-count thresholds that would justify Phase 3, and the placebo rate assumed, before the Q4 2026 topline.
ZURA.why: HiSCR is secondary; success definition for Phase 3 is unstated.

ARTV.datum: All 51 evaluable patients cleared B cells by Day 13 using cyclophosphamide/fludarabine plus AlloNK plus rituximab; 71% ACR50 is 5 of 7 at six months (EULAR, Jun 8 2026).
ARTV.why_underappreciated: 'Off-the-shelf' framing hides lymphodepleting chemotherapy; the 71% rests on seven patients.
ARTV.suggestion: At the Nov 9 webcast, define Phase 3 eligibility, show per-patient six-month ACR50 for at least 10 patients, and state whether Phase 3 keeps cyclophosphamide/fludarabine.
ARTV.why: Small-n response and chemo conditioning drive Phase 3 risk.

AUTL.datum: AUCATZYL gross margin was 55% in Q2 2026 versus 6% in Q1 and negative in every 2025 quarter; revenue $45.7M; management targets 65-70% (Q2 release).
AUTL.why_underappreciated: Lupus narrative dominates; the commercial unit-economics inflection is only one quarter old.
AUTL.suggestion: Publish the quarterly gross-margin path to 65-70% and the revenue milestones unlocking the extra $150M credit tranches, to size self-funding of lupus development.
AUTL.why: Margin trajectory decides how much lupus funding is internal.

ENLV.datum: 135 of 182 planned Phase 2b knee OA patients are randomized and dosed (74%) as of Oct 28 2026; topline six-month data expected mid-2027 (6-K).
ENLV.why_underappreciated: Crypto treasury dominates the story; fast enrollment on a clean readout path goes unnoticed.
ENLV.suggestion: State cash, RAIN holdings and what funds the remaining 47 patients and the six-month readout, and ring-fence trial funding from treasury volatility.
ENLV.why: Trial funding is unstated beside volatile RAIN exposure.

FATE.datum: RECLAIM-LN is single-arm, ~53 patients, 900M cells after bendamustine conditioning, week-26 complete renal response; enrollment completes 1H 2028; no-conditioning data are FT836/FT839, not FT819 (Q2 2026).
FATE.why_underappreciated: Thesis cites conditioning-free dosing, but the pivotal FT819 trial uses bendamustine and reads late.
FATE.suggestion: Report FT819 renal responses by conditioning regimen, and confirm with FDA whether single-arm RECLAIM-LN can support filing, given runway into 2028 precedes enrollment completion.
FATE.why: Runway ends before pivotal enrollment completes.

SPRO.datum: After HCRx repays its $105M non-recourse loan from GSK UTEBZI milestones and royalties, Spero keeps only 35% of later GSK payments; pledged share and loan terms undisclosed (Jul 2026).
SPRO.why_underappreciated: Royalty stream is framed as exceeding market cap, but most is pledged to the lender.
SPRO.suggestion: Disclose the pledged share, interest rate and repayment schedule, so investors can value Spero's retained UTEBZI cash flows; runway guidance is into 2H 2029.
SPRO.why: Retained royalty share and loan terms are undisclosed.

LQDA.datum: Oct 13 2026 settlement: Liquidia pays United Therapeutics $380.7M in total through April 2027, accepts the '327 loss and filed to remove PH-ILD from YUTREPIA's label; June 30 cash was $284.2M.
LQDA.why_underappreciated: Post-quarter event; PH-ILD (over 60,000 US patients) is lost and payments exceed June 30 cash.
LQDA.suggestion: Disclose YUTREPIA's PH-ILD share of patients and revenue, and how the $380.7M settlement, due through April 2027, will be funded from operating cash flow.
LQDA.why: Settlement removed the litigation overhang, not the funding and PH-ILD revenue questions.

LXEO.datum: FDA recommended dropping the cardiac frataxin co-primary, calling proof of mechanism 'no longer necessary'; SUNRISE-FA2 is open-label, 13 treated vs 13 untreated, powered for an LVMI effect of 15% or more at 6 months.
LXEO.why_underappreciated: Buried in pivotal design detail; frataxin no longer gates approval, but small n rests on LVMI alone.
LXEO.suggestion: Disclose the pre-specified LVMI analysis for the 13 vs 13 comparison, the FDA-reviewed bias safeguards, and the 12-month confirmatory endpoints under discussion, before H2 2027 topline.
LXEO.why: Single-endpoint open-label design makes control and confirmatory evidence the approval risk.

LXRX.datum: SONATA-HCM enrollment closed 'substantially exceeding' the 500-patient target (Q2 2026 release); the primary symptom endpoint covers non-obstructive and obstructive HCM together, most patients non-obstructive; topline Q1 2027.
LXRX.why_underappreciated: Exact enrollment undisclosed; larger trial raises power, and the mix is mostly non-obstructive HCM.
LXRX.suggestion: Disclose final SONATA-HCM enrollment, the obstructive versus non-obstructive split, and the conditions for Hercules' $20M and $25M loan tranches before the Q1 2027 topline.
LXRX.why: Undrawn debt tranches decide funding through the readout.

MIST.datum: Sep 3 2026: China's NMPA approved etripamil via partner Everest, triggering a $2.0M milestone; Milestone is eligible for up to $98.0M more milestones and tiered royalties up to 18% in Greater China.
MIST.why_underappreciated: Ex-US approval is overshadowed by the weak US launch ($0.56M Q2 revenue) and royalty financing.
MIST.suggestion: Disclose Everest's China launch timing and milestone schedule, plus royalty-financing ($81.8M) and convertible note terms, to show runway beyond the stated second half of 2027.
MIST.why: Runway is guided only into 2H 2027; China cash flows could extend it.

MLYS.datum: Q2 2026: Mineralys paid Tanabe $200.0M upfront to eliminate royalty obligations; up to $255.0M of commercial milestones remain, and $100.0M of a Pharmakon term loan was drawn in June.
MLYS.why_underappreciated: Buried in Q2 release; royalty eliminated for launch economics, but cash and debt carry the cost.
MLYS.suggestion: Disclose final Tanabe termination terms, the $255.0M remaining milestone triggers, and Pharmakon covenants, so investors can model net launch economics before the December 22 PDUFA.
MLYS.why: Net economics after the buyout and debt are unmodeled ahead of PDUFA.

PTCT.datum: Novartis starting INVEST-HD (Phase 3, about 770 early symptomatic HD patients) triggered a $50M milestone to PTC in Q2 2026; PIVOT-HD 24-month data showed 52% cUHDRS slowing at 10 mg.
PTCT.why_underappreciated: Partner-funded Phase 3 and milestone are overshadowed by Sephience; PTC gets HD upside without trial cost.
PTCT.suggestion: Break out Sephience patient persistence and ex-royalty profitability; clarify retained Evrysdi royalty economics given the $2.3B liability for sale of future royalties.
PTCT.why: Release gives no persistence data; royalty liability obscures ex-royalty economics.

PVLA.datum: SELVA Ph3: no drug-related serious adverse events and systemic rapamycin below 2 ng/mL at all timepoints for all participants; all six efficacy endpoints p<0.001; NDA completed Aug 31 2026.
PVLA.why_underappreciated: Low systemic exposure is the edge over oral sirolimus, but sits behind the efficacy headline.
PVLA.suggestion: Present SELVA's systemic rapamycin exposure (<2 ng/mL) and zero drug-related serious events against oral sirolimus, with the FDA filing and priority-review decision due around October 30.
PVLA.why: Safety edge supports orphan pricing against ~$100/yr generic sirolimus.

RCKT.datum: Sep 15 2026: FDA aligned on pivotal Danon Ph2: 12 males at 3.8e13 GC/kg; co-primaries are myocardial LAMP2 expression and 10% LVMI reduction at 12 months, intended to support accelerated approval; dosing done mid-2027.
RCKT.why_underappreciated: Surrogate co-primaries on a 12-patient cohort are buried behind gene-therapy safety history.
RCKT.suggestion: Disclose Hercules facility tranche triggers and covenants, and rituximab/sirolimus regimen safety in the first nine patients, showing runway reaches the mid-2028 topline.
RCKT.why: Runway versus topline timing and immunosuppression safety drive financing risk.

RNA.datum: Second $15M BMS milestone earned Aug 2026; cash $263.9M at Jun 30 funds operations through mid-2028, versus about $142M market cap; first participant guided only 'by end of 2026'.
RNA.why_underappreciated: EV is negative: cash is about double market cap, and BMS milestones add non-dilutive cash.
RNA.suggestion: Guide Part A to report PRKAG2 mRNA knockdown or other pharmacodynamic data, and name the first-participant date, ahead of the H2 2027 proof of concept.
RNA.why: Start is guided only 'by end of 2026'; PD data de-risk delivery.

TECX.datum: July 2026 IDMC reviewed unblinded APEX data covering about 80% of expected exposure and recommended continuing without modification; cash runway guided into Q1 2029; topline early Q1 2027.
TECX.why_underappreciated: Buried in Q2 release; no safety-driven change at about 80% exposure counters the graveyard narrative.
TECX.suggestion: Pre-announce the APEX statistical analysis plan for the CpcPH PVR>3 WU primary and the PVR effect size that would match sotatercept's CADENCE result.
TECX.why: A defined success bar before the early Q1 2027 binary reduces ambiguity.

TENX.datum: LEVEL baseline 6MWD <333 m subgroup (n=119): NT-proBNP fell 47% vs placebo (post hoc, p<0.0001), RVSP -4.9 mmHg (post hoc, p=0.009), plus 6MWD +26.3 m (p=0.0112); ESC Aug 2026.
TENX.why_underappreciated: Overall-failure headline hides consistent post hoc biomarker effects, though subgroup findings are exploratory.
TENX.suggestion: State whether the 333 m cutoff and NT-proBNP/RVSP analyses were prespecified, the multiplicity plan, and FDA's response on LEVEL-2 enrichment.
TENX.why: Subgroup credibility, not cash, determines whether LEVEL-2 is fundable.

TNYA.datum: Mar 5 2026 Alnylam research deal: up to $10M upfront and up to $1.13B milestones across up to 15 cardiovascular targets; Alnylam funds all development and commercialization of resulting therapeutics.
TNYA.why_underappreciated: Platform deal is overshadowed by TN-201; the $10M upfront is small against the cash burn.
TNYA.suggestion: Disclose SVB loan covenants, and pair Q4 2026 MyPEAK-1 data and FDA pivotal feedback with TN-201 ex-US partnering; cash lasts only through Q3 2027.
TNYA.why: Cash runs to Q3 2027; durability data is the financing moment.

ANIK.datum: Q2 2026 call (Jul 2026): FDA deficiency letter on Hyalofast PMA turns on the co-primary clinical endpoints; 2027 outlook now drops only ~$3M of implied US Hyalofast sales.
ANIK.why_underappreciated: Models carry large US cartilage peak sales, but guidance implies only ~$3M, and the cause is endpoint adequacy.
ANIK.suggestion: Disclose the FDA's co-primary endpoint deficiencies, whether new analysis or a new study is needed, and a dated resubmission, before using Hyalofast in peak-sales models.
ANIK.why: Endpoint adequacy, not timing, decides Hyalofast approval.

DWTX.datum: Dec 22 2025 independent review of 97 completers found Halneuron separating from placebo; dropout 4.3% in first 116 completers vs >20% duloxetine (company). Ph2b n=239 is 80-85% powered.
DWTX.why_underappreciated: Dropout and power detail sit in financing-era notes; attention is on cash, not tolerability versus duloxetine.
DWTX.suggestion: Open Ph3 partner talks before the November topline and pre-state the Week 4 pain effect size that justifies Ph3; $3.28 warrants could add $14.4M.
DWTX.why: Tolerability edge plus 80-85% power makes a pre-readout partner credible.

HRTX.datum: Q2 2026: a June 2026 Delaware ruling on CINVANTI patents made generic entry unforecastable; CINVANTI is $21.8M of $37.7M revenue (-9.7%); company is considering strategic alternatives.
HRTX.why_underappreciated: Headline is ZYNRELEF +35%, but 58% of revenue sits in CINVANTI facing generic-entry risk.
HRTX.suggestion: Disclose the ruling's generic-entry window and Hercules covenant levels, then run the strategic-alternatives process with ZYNRELEF ($11.1M, +35%) as the core asset.
HRTX.why: CINVANTI is 58% of sales and the ruling clouds it.

LTGO.datum: S-1 abdominoplasty Ph2: high-dose onzotrigine placebo-adjusted SPID48 62.1 vs 40.9 for hydrocodone/APAP (low dose 37.8); lower adverse events than the opioid arm; ~51% stayed opioid-free.
LTGO.why_underappreciated: Narrative is Journavx fast-follower; an active opioid comparator arm beating hydrocodone/APAP is rarely cited.
LTGO.suggestion: Design the bunionectomy Ph3 with an active opioid arm and publish SPID48 against hydrocodone/APAP next to suzetrigine data, to support more than fast-follower positioning.
LTGO.why: Opioid-beating SPID48 is the differentiator behind a $1B value.

MIRA.datum: Cash fell to $3.6M at 6/30/26 (10-Q, secondary summary) vs ~$9M in fields incl. $4.5M Telomir stake; Nasdaq $1 bid-price notice Jul 27 2026; Ph2a sites start Q1 2027.
MIRA.why_underappreciated: Supplied cash includes a Telomir stake; liquid cash is far lower than the Q1 2027 start requires.
MIRA.suggestion: Plan a reverse split, sell part of the Telomir stake and seek a grant or partner so liquid cash reaches Ph2a site initiation in Q1 2027.
MIRA.why: Liquid cash is about $3.6M, short of the Ph2a start.

NTRB.datum: FDA Type C meeting (Sep 18 2025; minutes Oct 28 2025) confirmed a 505(b)(2) path for AVERSA Fentanyl: in vitro studies plus a HAP study under an IND not yet filed; no efficacy trial.
NTRB.why_underappreciated: Labelled preclinical with no efficacy data, yet the required package is in vitro work and one HAP study.
NTRB.suggestion: File the AVERSA IND and publish HAP study cost, design and start date; use the efficacy-light 505(b)(2) path to pitch a co-development partner.
NTRB.why: Short regulatory path makes a partner deal plausible.

SCLX.datum: Jun 15 2026 Semnur dividend (1:1) distributed ~10.7M Semnur shares of ~186M Scilex held (~6%), leaving ~175M shares retained; Scilex still calls Semnur majority-owned.
SCLX.why_underappreciated: Headline 'carve-out' reads as asset separation, but Scilex kept ~94% of the Semnur stake.
SCLX.suggestion: Use the ~175M retained Semnur shares to restructure debt via debt-for-equity or share sales so SEMDEXA NDA funding is no longer gated.
SCLX.why: Retained stake is the main lever against going-concern risk.

TNXP.datum: Q2 2026: Tonmya refills +207% QoQ vs new-patient Rx +36%; total Rx 12,592 includes non-revenue bridge fills; $11.0M net sales is about $870 per Rx.
TNXP.why_underappreciated: Headline Rx doubling mixes bridge fills; refill growth, not total Rx, shows persistence building.
TNXP.suggestion: Report bridge-versus-paid Rx split, persistence and gross-to-net quarterly, so investors can judge launch quality ahead of financing needed by early Q2 2027.
TNXP.why: Persistence evidence sets financing terms before runway ends.

EXOZ.datum: Jun 2026 units at $18.00: 366,130 investor warrants ($11.24 strike) reset to $0.001 if stock is sold below $18 before Jun 5 2027; liability-classified at $1.9M (10-Q).
EXOZ.why_underappreciated: Cash $5.65M and burn headlines hide a down-round trap that punishes any cheaper raise in the next year.
EXOZ.suggestion: Fund via partner upfront or grants rather than equity below $18 until June 5, 2027, or obtain a warrant waiver, to avoid the $0.001 reset.
EXOZ.why: Any raise below $18 triggers warrant reset dilution.

HALO.datum: May 12 2026 PTAB final decision invalidated Halozyme MDASE patent US 11,952,600 (claims 1-4, 8-21) in Merck's PGR; 13 more Merck PGRs instituted 2025 pending; Qlex suit asserts 15 patents.
HALO.why_underappreciated: Overhang is treated as routine litigation; the first final ruling went against Halozyme and 13 more are pending.
HALO.suggestion: Quantify Keytruda Qlex royalty exposure as the remaining PGR final decisions arrive, and settle with Merck by license only if terms exceed invalidity-adjusted value.
HALO.why: First PTAB ruling went against Halozyme; 13 pending.

ROIV.datum: Lisraya (brepocitinib) approved Aug 27 2026 with list price $35,000 per 30-day supply (~$420K/yr, BioPharma Dive) and a boxed warning; VALOR 55% vs 30% on placebo.
ROIV.why_underappreciated: Price is days old and far above the $70K net-price input; market focuses on Immunovant readouts.
ROIV.suggestion: Report Lisraya net price and early enrollment to price a Priovant partial sale or spin, then use the $3.8B cash to narrow the sum-of-parts discount.
ROIV.why: Price and net realization set Priovant's standalone value.

ACHV.datum: Jul 2026 Sopharma AD arbitration demand over cytisinicline supply rights challenges move to new manufacturers (Adare); no liability recorded; outcomes could delay manufacturers or raise royalties.
ACHV.why_underappreciated: Headline is a manufacturing-only CRL; the licensor dispute over the manufacturer switch is newer than models.
ACHV.suggestion: Disclose the arbitration claim scope and whether Adare tech transfer and Q4 NDA resubmission are exposed; seek settlement locking supply and royalty terms before resubmission.
ACHV.why: Supplier dispute could touch the Adare switch behind resubmission.

AMRN.datum: Europe in-market demand rose 69% in Q2 2026 (11 countries live) while reported Europe revenue fell 17% to $5.4M on the Recordati model switch; Q3 is first comparable quarter.
AMRN.why_underappreciated: Reported decline hides demand growth; Recordati-model comparisons only start Q3 2026.
AMRN.suggestion: Disclose Recordati supply price and royalty run-rate at Q3 results, then close the Barclays review with a sale or cash return; shares trade below $315M cash.
AMRN.why: Gives buyers a valued ex-US stream; mc $252M versus cash $315M.

ARWR.datum: In SHASTA-3/4 pooled analysis, the subset with TG >880 mg/dL and prior pancreatitis had 100% fewer acute pancreatitis events versus placebo (subset size undisclosed); Jul 22 2026 release.
ARWR.why_underappreciated: Buried in a subgroup line; event counts and subset size not yet disclosed.
ARWR.suggestion: Disclose event counts and size of the TG >880 mg/dL prior-pancreatitis subset in the sNDA, and aim payer messaging and label at that group.
ARWR.why: Highest-risk group gives clearest pricing argument against monthly olezarsen.

BIOA.datum: Novo's ziltivekimab ZEUS (over 6,300 patients, ASCVD plus CKD, hsCRP at least 2) missed 3-point MACE, HR 0.99 (95% CI 0.88-1.11), announced Jul 31 2026.
BIOA.why_underappreciated: Undercuts the hsCRP-to-events premise; market sees the readout as non-catalytic.
BIOA.suggestion: At QUELL-CV readout, pair hsCRP with IL-1β and IL-6 suppression and advance QUELL-DME; start outcomes-linked Phase 3 only with a funded partner, given ZEUS HR 0.99.
BIOA.why: ZEUS miss favors non-CV indications and partner-funded Phase 3.

CLLS.datum: First-in-human for .HEAL-101 (APOC3) and .HEAL-201 (PCSK9) will be Phase 1 investigator-initiated trials in China, data 2H 2027 and 1H 2028; pivot approved Sep 11 2026.
CLLS.why_underappreciated: Buried in pivot announcement; Western regulators and partners may discount China IIT data.
CLLS.suggestion: File a US or EU IND/CTA for .HEAL-101 alongside the China trial and seek a lipid partner, so human data suit Western regulators.
CLLS.why: Western-acceptable human data widens partner pool before cash runs out.

CRSP.datum: CTX310 Phase 1a enrolled 15 patients across four lipid groups; at 0.8 mg/kg mean triglyceride reduction was 48% (max 78%) and 40% of patients were on PCSK9 inhibitors.
CRSP.why_underappreciated: Headline is ANGPTL3 -79%; small cohort and modest mean TG effect get less attention.
CRSP.suggestion: At AHA, report TG reduction by baseline TG band in the sHTG cohort, with liver-enzyme and infusion-reaction tables; mean 48% TG effect is the open question.
CRSP.why: TG magnitude decides sHTG position against APOC3 siRNAs.

EDIT.datum: EDIT-401 Strive Phase 1/2 (HeFH) has Australia approval; dosing starts later 2026, initial safety Q1 2027, dose-finding efficacy later in 2027 (Oct 8 2026 report).
EDIT.why_underappreciated: Market treats YE26 first dosing as proof of concept; human efficacy is a 2027 event.
EDIT.suggestion: Pre-specify Q1 2027 Part 1 disclosure: safety plus early LDL-C and Lp(a) response in HeFH patients with high baseline LDL-C.
EDIT.why: Earlier efficacy signal shortens the wait inside 8 quarters of runway.

GALT.datum: FDA Type C feedback (Jun 23 2026 release): Phase 3 tests a single 2 mg belapectin dose, composite liver outcome including large varices over 5 mm, size comparable to NAVIGATE.
GALT.why_underappreciated: Newer than analyst models; focus stays on missed NAVIGATE significance.
GALT.suggestion: File the Phase 3 protocol and sign a partner or non-dilutive funding before enrolment; only $13M cash against $341M market cap risks heavy dilution.
GALT.why: Four quarters of runway; Phase 3 must be funded.

GPCR.datum: Phase 2b ACCESS discontinuation rate was 10.4% per the Q2 2026 results release, versus the 2-3% adverse-event discontinuation quoted from later-dosing and extension data.
GPCR.why_underappreciated: Headline tolerability uses subsets; full-population dropout appears only in a results-release line.
GPCR.suggestion: At ObesityWeek, show ACCESS discontinuation by cause and dose for all randomized patients, not only late-dosing subsets, alongside 44-week weight loss.
GPCR.why: Tolerability claim rests on subsets; full-population rate decides class standing.

GYRE.datum: Q2 2026 revenue was $29.1M (Q1 $22.5M), FY2026 revenue guidance $100.5-111.0M, and cash was $103.2M at Jun 30, double the $50M in our fields.
GYRE.why_underappreciated: Headline is the China NDA; existing product revenue and larger cash are overlooked.
GYRE.suggestion: Prioritize the hydronidone NDA decision and MASH Phase 2 start, funded from $103M cash and product revenue; use a regional partner for launch rather than diluting.
GYRE.why: Existing revenue funds MASH Phase 2 without equity.

IBIO.datum: IBIO-610 (activin E) in obese monkeys: two every-8-week doses cut visceral fat 6.7% and total fat mass 5.2%; study small and not powered (Q3 FY2026 release).
IBIO.why_underappreciated: Modest unpowered preclinical effect sits beside the headline anti-myostatin asset.
IBIO.suggestion: Release IBIO-600 SAD half-life and myostatin suppression when available, and run a powered IBIO-610 monkey study with GLP-1 before committing cash.
IBIO.why: Tests whether the fat-selective activin E effect is real.

IONS.datum: TRYNGOLZA US net sales were $5M in Q2 2026 versus $19M a year earlier after a lower net price from Apr 1 2026; 2026 product sales guidance $100-110M.
IONS.why_underappreciated: Price cut and flat guidance sit beside sHTG launch enthusiasm and peak-sales narrative.
IONS.suggestion: Disclose sHTG net price, prescriptions and payer coverage by quarter, since the April 2026 price cut sets what peak sales can reach against plozasiran.
IONS.why: Net price, not volume, decides the $1.8B peak.

IVA.datum: NATiV3 main cohort has 1,009 F2-F3 patients, 90% power under assumptions more conservative than Phase IIb; 72-week last visit done Sep 2026, topline Q4 2026.
IVA.why_underappreciated: Conservative power assumptions rarely modeled; readout priced as a coin flip.
IVA.suggestion: Before NATiV3 topline, line up milestone-linked financing and a lanifibranor partnership option, since runway ends Q2 2027 and Tranche 3 warrants depend on positive data.
IVA.why: Runway to Q2 2027 and warrant overhang make dilution the risk.
